# dsh-sidebar-toggle

简体中文 · English

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web GUI 提供侧边栏分组模式的快捷切换：无需展开视图选项菜单，通过 **`Alt+R` 快捷键**或**直接点击侧边栏分组标题**（`会话` / `工作区` / `Sessions` / `Workspaces`），即可在**按工作区分组**（`workspace`）与**平铺会话列表**（`flat`）之间一键来回切换。 ## 功能与交互 1. **全局快捷键 `Alt+R`**： - 在页面任意位置按下 `Alt+R` 即可切换侧边栏分组模式（`workspace` ↔ `flat`）。 - 自动避让输入法组合输入状态（`e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229`），不影响中文等 IME 选词。 2. **点击侧边栏分组标题**： - 为侧边栏顶部标题文本（`[class*="sectionHeader"] [class*="sectionLabel"]`，即中文界面的「会话」/「工作区」或英文界面的 `Sessions` / `Workspaces`）注入手型指针（`cursor: pointer`）与悬停透明度反馈（`hover: opacity: 0.8`）。 - 单击标题文本即刻切换分组视图（若标题处于隐藏态 `sectionLabelHidden` 则忽略点击）。 每次切换时，插件调用宿主 `sidebar.workspaces` 槽位的原生 `setGroupBy` action，并在浏览器控制台输出一行状态日志： ```text [dsh-sidebar-toggle] groupBy: workspace -> flat [dsh-sidebar-toggle] groupBy: flat -> workspace ``` ## 安装 从 npm 安装（预构建，免额外配置）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-toggle ``` 安装后无需手动修改配置文件，插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会自动挂载生效；刷新 Web 页面即可使用。 从 GitHub 直装（源码安装，包内含 `prepare` 构建脚本，pnpm ≥ 10 首次安装需放行构建）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:john-walks-slow/dsh-sidebar-toggle # 若 pnpm 拦截构建脚本，按提示执行 pnpm approve-builds 或将 dsh-sidebar-toggle # 加入 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds / onlyBuiltDependencies 后重跑 ``` ## 权限与兼容 - **纯客户端插件**：Host 侧 `apply` 为空实现，**零 npm 运行时依赖**；全部交互逻辑在浏览器端（`lib/client.js`）运行。 - **零外部权限**：无外部服务、无网络请求、无本地文件系统读写、不读取任何会话内容。 - **复用宿主原生状态**：通过 Cordis `slots` 服务解析 `sidebar.workspaces` 槽位的 `WorkspaceViewStoreHandle`，直接调用宿主原生的 `getSnapshot().groupBy` 与 `actions.setGroupBy()`，与侧边栏自带的视图切换菜单完全同步。 - **卸载与热重载干净**：通过 `ctx.effect` 与 `window.__dshSidebarToggle.dispose()` 管理生命周期，插件停用或重载时自动移除键盘/点击事件监听与注入的 `

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: manage MCP servers — list, probe, add from pasted project references, toggle, remove, rotate credentials. Official dsh-mcp-client contract compliant.
plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-contrib/dsh-mcp-manager [English](README.en.md) | 中文 对登记在 DSH patch 文件中的 MCP 服务器条目提供搜索、查看、探测、安装、编辑、启停、删除与凭据轮换。条目格式遵循官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的配置契约，全部写入经过同一条带守卫的管线。 ## 概述 在 DSH 中新增一台 MCP 服务器通常意味着手工编辑 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`：新增条目必须置于 `insert:` 列表内，`serverName` 在作用域内唯一，凭据不得以明文写入 patch。任一处不符都会导致条目不被挂载，或使配置重载失败。 本包把这一过程收敛为受校验的操作。写入先经过 DSH 自身加载器与官方字段规则校验，通过后才以原子方式落盘并保留 `.bak` 备份；未通过校验的候选内容不会触及实际文件。 同一套引擎驱动三个界面：Agent 工具（`mcp_manager_*`）、命令行（`cli/mcp.js`）与 Web 面板。凭据轮换仅在 Agent 工具与命令行中提供，面板不允许写入原始 `!!js` 表达式。 **市场**以官方 [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) 为唯一目录源：搜索、看详情、安装，写入走的仍是同一条管线。市场不引入任何绕过路径，也不假装条目经过审核——registry 是任何人可发布的。 ## 目录 - [使用本包](#use-this-package) - [理解实现](#understand-the-implementation) - [进一步探索](#further-exploration) - [已知限制与延期工作](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [失败行为](#failure-behavior) - [开发备注](#dev-note) ----- ## 使用本包 安装：把下面一行交给 agent，或在 Web 侧边栏的**插件**页中安装同一地址。 ``` plugin_manager install_bundle https://github.com/shiliu153/dsh-mcp-manager ``` 安装完成后 `mcp_manager_*` 工具即可用。验证方式是调用 `mcp_manager_list`：**该调用返回列表即表示插件已挂载**，列表为空同样算通过——本包不预设用户已登记任何服务器，新环境下的空列表是正常结果。 ### 支持的输入格式 `mcp_manager_add` 与命令行 `add` 接受四种粘贴形式，`serverName` 由输入自动推导，可在预演阶段调整。 | 粘贴内容 | 示例 | |---|---| | npm 包名 | `@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory` | | GitHub 仓库 | `https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers` | | MCP 端点 | `https://mcp.example.com/mcp` | | JSON 配置 | `{"command":"npx","args":["-y","@upstash/context7-mcp"]}` | ### Agent 工具 安装后以下九个工具对 agent 可用。写入类工具默认只执行预演：先返回将要写入的内容与各项校验结果，确认无误后再以 `confirm: true` 重新调用。 | 工具 | 用途 | 需确认 | |---|---|:---:| | `mcp_manager_list` | 列出已登记服务器，凭据值已掩码 | — | | `mcp_manager_search` | 搜索官方 MCP Registry，报告可安装性、执行面与缺口 | — | | `mcp_manager_probe` | 对单台或全部服务器执行真实握手 | — | | `mcp_manager_validate` | 按官方 mcp-client 规则校验条目 | — | | `mcp_manager_credential` | 定位、掩码显示或轮换凭据文件 | — | | `mcp_manager_add` | 从粘贴的地址新增服务器；`source: "registry"` 时输入按 registry 名解释 | 是 | | `mcp_manager_update` | 替换某条目的 `config:` 子树 | 是 | | `mcp_manager_toggle` | 启用或禁用条目 | 是 | | `mcp_manager_remove` | 移除条目 | 是 | ### 命令行 零外部依赖，与 Agent 工具共用同一套引擎，无需 harness 即可运行。 ```sh node cli/mcp.js list [--json] node cli/mcp.js probe [--id ] [--timeout 60] node cli/mcp.js search [--limit 20] [--cursor ] [--json] node cli/mcp.js install [--version ] [--yes] [--no-probe] node cli/mcp.js add "" [--yes] [--no-probe] node cli/mcp.js show [--json] [--masked] node cli/mcp.js edit [--config ] [--yes] # 省略 --config 时读取 stdin node cli/mcp.js enable|disable --yes node cli/mcp.js remove --yes node cli/mcp.js credential get|set node cli/mcp.js validate node cli/mcp.js schema ``` | 参数 | 含义 | |---|---| | `--file ` | 指定 patch 文件；缺省为 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` 或 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`。 | | `--json` | 输出机器可读结果（`list`、`show`、`search`）。 | | `--yes` | 跳过确认。 | | `--masked` | `show` 时以占位符替换 `!!js` 表达式。 | | `--registry-base ` | `search` / `install` 使用的 registry 基址，缺省为官方 registry。 | 退出码：`0` 成功，`1` 失败，`2` 用法错误。 ### Web 面板 启用本包后，侧边栏**插件**页下的 **DSH MCP 管理器** 列出已登记服务器。每行显示状态点、id、serverName、传输方式，以及命令行或 URL。 状态点直接读取 harness 的 MCP 资源注册表，因此「已配置」与「实际已连接」在界面上是两个不同的状态： | 显示 | 悬停提示 | 含义 | |:---:|---|---| | 绿色圆点 | 已连接 | 服务器进程存活，可正常调用 | | 橙色圆点 | 已启用 · 未连接 | 条目已启用，但未连上 | | 灰色圆点 | 已禁用 | 条目被停用 | | 空心圆环 | 连接状态不可用 | 无法读取 harness 的实时注册表 | 每行可执行的操作： - **探测**——执行真实握手，报告工具数量或失败原因。列表不做自动探测，因此可以即时打开；面板头部的**一键探测**可一次并发探测全部服务器。 - **编辑**——展开文本域，内容为该行自身的 `config:` 子树 YAML，含注释、键序与 `!!js` 引用。**校验并预览**按官方规则预演变更，**写入**通过带守卫的管线应用变更并探测结果。 - **启用 / 禁用开关**，以及一次内联确认的**删除**。 - **新增服务器**——粘贴上述四种格式之一，点击**解析**生成预览，确认将要追加的 YAML 内容后再写入。 - **刷新**——重新读取 patch 文件与实时连接状态。 ### 市场 面板顶部有两个标签：**已安装**（上述视图）与**市场**。市场是只读的发现面，不触盘写。 搜索走官方 registry。**它只匹配名称**（反域名，如 `ai.ankimcp/anki-mcp-server`），不匹配描述——所以搜 `anki` 也会带回 `banking-*`。返回页会在本地按标题与描述重排，把精确命中提上来，界面上也如实标注这一点。 点开一条结果，**执行面是不可折叠的**： - stdio 条目逐字显示将要执行的完整命令行，等宽字体，例如 `npx -y @ankimcp/anki-mcp-server@0.27.0`； - 远程条目逐字显示将要连接的 URL； - 运行时不在 PATH 上时红字标注。 同一屏还列出出处（发布者、registry 名、版本、仓库与主页链接、是否已弃用）与**还缺哪些凭据**。 **勾选框只在 stdio 条目上出现。** `npx -y <任意包>` 是在本机执行任意代码；远程 URL 只是把查询发给第三方，与使用任何 Web API 同级。对两者都要求勾选，只会训练用户无脑点过，反而削弱真正重要的那一道。需要凭据、运行时缺失、条目已弃用都用醒目警告表达，不额外加闸。 **市场不写入凭据。** 需要秘密的条目照常可装，但秘密字段被**省略**而不是填占位值——patch 里永远不会出现假凭据。装完后首次探测会返回 401，这正是"你还没补凭据"的准确信号；用 `dsh-mcp credential set <值>` 或让 agent 调用 `mcp_manager_credential` 补上。 **不支持的条目直接不显示**：`sse` 传输（DSH 的 mcp-client 不认），以及 `cargo` / `nuget` / `mcpb` 包类型。 **已安装标记与版本漂移**：市场按推导出的 `serverName`（首选）或执行面（用户改过名字时）认出已经装过的服务器，并标出「已安装」。漂移只在条目**钉住版本**时才可能判断——市场安装的条目会钉版本，而 `add` 路径写的是不钉版本的 `npx -y `，后者会如实显示「版本未钉住，无法比对」，不会假装已是最新。更新走既有的 `mcp_manager_update` 管线，仍需确认。 面板通过 `ctx.connection.registerFetchRoute` 在 `/api/dsh-mcp-manager/` 下注册精确的 Fetch 路由，因此 harness 自身的 Host/Origin 校验与浏览器会话认证先于任何处理函数执行。面板自身不实现信任边界，所有写入都经过与命令行相同的带守卫管线。 ----- ## 理解实现
实现细节——点击展开 ### 写入的配置条目 条目严格遵循官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 契约： ```yaml - insert: - id: mcp- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: # [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}，需唯一 transport: stdio # 或 streamable-http command: npx # 仅 stdio args: ['-y', ''] failOnStartupError: true # 本包写入的条目默认值 ``` 新增服务器必须置于独立的 `insert:` 列表内。顶层裸条目用于按 id 覆盖**已有**条目；若其不匹配任何现有条目，加载器会告警并跳过，因此追加一个裸条目不会挂载新服务器。 密钥不写入 patch：工具将其存入凭据文件，并以 `!!js` 表达式引用，与官方 GitHub 条目采用同一模式。DSH 会热重载 patch，新增或修改的服务器在当前会话即可使用。 编辑操作只替换指定条目的 `config:` 子树，其余内容保持不变：条目上方的注释块、`- id:`、`name:` 与 `disabled:` 行，以及其他所有条目都逐字节一致。读出一个子树后原样写回可精确复现文件内容，这一点由测试套件断言。 ### 安全模型 - **写入目标**为 home 覆盖层 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`。官方组合顺序：bundle patches → profile patch → home patch → `--patch`。 - **显式确认**：每次变更都要求 `confirm: true` 或 `--yes`；删除、启停与编辑保留前一份文件的 `.bak`。 - **四重校验**：候选内容须能在 DSH 自身加载器下解析、符合官方字段规则、不含硬编码密钥，且所有 `serverName` 保持唯一。 - **写入前后双重把关**：新增操作在写入前后各校验一次——候选行必须位于 insert 列表内、能通过加载器解析出 `serverName`、且不与已登记项重名。写入后针对已持久化的行再次执行同一检查，因此 `probe OK` 只可能描述确实存在于文件中的条目。 - **并发写入保护**：面板在编辑期间以原始文本持有内容，写入时回传所读文件的 `mtime`；文件在此期间被修改则以 `file_changed` 拒绝，不覆盖对方的改动。 - **探测只读**：探测不启动浏览器，也不将凭据发送到服务器自身端点之外的任何位置。 - **`!!js` 求值**：探测按 harness 的方式先解析 `!!js` 值再发送。加载器返回的是惰性的 `{ __jsExpr }` 标记对象，直接转发会使以表达式写入的凭据以 `Authorization: [object Object]` 到达服务器并返回 `400`，将有效凭据误报为格式错误。无法求值的表达式按名称报告，不转发。 所有写入共用同一条带守卫的管线： ``` 读取原文件 → 在候选副本上执行文本手术 → DSH 加载器校验 → mtime 复核 → .bak 备份 → 原子替换 ``` ### 项目结构 `lib/` 为共享实现，`cli/`、`index.js` 与 `client.js` 是它的三种入口。 ``` index.js 宿主插件入口：在 ctx.tools 注册 mcp_manager_* 工具， 并在存在 web profile 时通过 ctx.connection 注册面板路由 client.js 浏览器端面板（单文件，由 /plugins//client.js 直接提供） cli/mcp.js 命令行入口 lib/ 共享引擎 dump.js 经 DSH 自身加载器结构化读取 patch 文件 jsexpr.js !!js 值的运行时求值 patchfile.js 带守卫的写入管线（手术 → 校验 → mtime 复核 → .bak → 原子替换） surgery.js 保留注释的文本手术：增删条目、启停、替换 config 子树 rules.js 官方 dsh-mcp-client 条目字段规则 resolve.js 将粘贴的项目地址解析为官方 patch 条目 registry.js 与官方 MCP Registry 对话（超时、响应体上限、重试、TTL 缓存） market.js registry 条目 → 候选条目；已安装识别与版本漂移（纯函数） probe.js 真实 MCP 握手（stdio 与 streamable-http） rows.js 行筛选与凭据掩码（命令行、宿主工具与面板共用同一实现） update.js 编辑策略：!!js 占位符协议与语义闸门 server.js 面板的 Fetch 路由 tools-bridge.js 官方工具定义形态与管理器库之间的桥接 subprocess.js 最小化同步子进程辅助 locale/ 面板文案（en / zh） assets/skills/ 随包提供的 Agent 技能定义（置于 ~/.dsh/skills/ 后生效） cordis.patch.yml 本包自身的 patch，用于注册 dsh-mcp-manager docs/official/ 从已安装的 DSH app.asar 中提取的官方规则 ``` `rows.js` 的掩码实现只有一份：若出现漂移副本，凭据会泄漏到浏览器。`lib/` 保持零外部依赖，便于测试与在命令行中独立运行。
----- ## 进一步探索 - 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 条目规则——`docs/official/`。 - 本包的设计与实施计划——`docs/specs/`、`docs/plans/`，端到端实测记录见 `docs/records/`。 - 随包 Agent 技能——`assets/skills/dsh-mcp-manager/SKILL.md`。 ----- ## 已知限制与延期工作 - 面板不写入 `!!js` 表达式。Loader 在运行时对表达式求值，等同于在 harness 进程中执行代码，因此面板只提交不透明占位符（`Authorization: !!js «0»`），由宿主原样回填

plugins.description: Focus the DeepSeek Harness approval panel automatically, so Enter approves and Esc rejects without reaching for the mouse.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-approval-enter

Focus the DeepSeek Harness approval panel automatically, so **Enter approves and Esc rejects** without reaching for the mouse.

`dsh` 的审批面板弹出时自动获取焦点，**回车批准、Esc 拒绝**，不用再点鼠标。

---

## The problem · 问题

DeepSeek Harness ships Enter/Esc shortcuts for approvals, but the panel inserts itself alongside the composer **without taking focus**:

```js
// @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval/lib/client.js
if (event.defaultPrevented
    || !event.currentTarget.contains(document.activeElement)   // ← requires focus inside
    || element.closest("input, textarea, ...") !== null) return;
```

Focus stays in the composer, whose Enter means "send", so Enter never reaches the panel. You have to click the card first — or press `Tab`.

This plugin makes the focus follow the panel.

## What it does · 行为

| Composer state | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| **Empty** | Focus moves into the panel → `Enter` approves, `Esc` rejects |
| **Has a draft** | Focus is **left alone** — your Enter still means "send"; `Tab` reaches the panel |
| Same request | Decides once, does not fight you for focus |
| Panel closes | Focus returns to where it was |

The draft rule is deliberate: stealing focus mid-sentence loses typing, and a reflexive Enter afterwards could approve a destructive command.

## Install · 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:YOUR-USER/dsh-approval-enter
```

Or pin a local clone (edits take effect immediately — the profile links it):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USER/dsh-approval-enter ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-approval-enter
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$HOME/dsh-plugins/dsh-approval-enter"
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards.

## Uninstall · 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-approval-enter
```

## Compatibility · 兼容性

- DeepSeek Harness desktop app, or `dsh web`
- Verified against the panel markup as shipped in dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`
- No API key, no login, no runtime dependencies

If a future build renames the panel's `data-approval-key` / `data-approval-scroll` attributes the focus target is not found; the plugin then falls back to the panel root and grants it a programmatic tab stop. If the panel cannot be focused at all, the plugin does nothing and the shipped behaviour returns.

## How it works · 原理

The official panel renders two hooks this plugin uses:

- the panel root carries `data-approval-key` and owns the `keydown` handler
- the detail area carries `data-approval-scroll` and `tabIndex: 0`

A `MutationObserver` watches for the panel, and — only when the composer holds no draft — moves focus to the detail area. The official `keydown` guard then sees focus inside the panel and lets Enter and Esc through. Nothing else is patched, and no official file is modified: the browser half ships through `exports["./client"]`, the way any dsh client plugin does.

## License

MIT

DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计插件：跨会话汇总累计用量、连续使用天数、年度活动热力图、每日分模型趋势与模型占比
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-usage-stats

DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计面板。

点侧栏里的「使用统计」，中间区域显示这份看板：累计 Token 数、峰值 Token 数、最长聊天时长、
当前与最长连续使用天数、Token 活动热力图、每日分模型趋势折线，以及按模型分列的用量占比。

## 它显示什么

| 区块 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 累计数字 | 全部历史累计 Token、单日峰值 Token、最长单次会话时长、当前与历史最长连续使用天数 |
| Token 活动 | 按天的活动热力图，可切换「每日 / 每周 / 累计」三种口径；指针停在某一天上显示当天用量与轮消息数 |
| 时间范围 | 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 全部，决定趋势图与模型占比看哪一段 |
| 每日 Token 趋势图 | 范围内每个模型一条折线；指针移上去画出竖线与当天的点，并列出当天合计与分模型明细 |
| 模型用量 | 环形图与排名列表，含每个模型的占比与 Token 数 |

顶部五个数字始终描述全部历史，不随时间范围变化。

「最长聊天时长」量的是**单次连续活动**最长的一段，不是会话从建立到最后的跨度：
会话里的活动时间排好序，两次活动相隔超过 1 小时就算断开、另起一段，取最长的那一段。
会话可以隔几天再回来接着聊，用首末时间相减会把中间的空档也算进去（跨一周的会话会报成 170 多个小时），
这不是「聊了多久」。阈值写在 `host/usage.js` 的 `IDLE_GAP_MS`。

## 数据从哪来

宿主没有发布「按天分桶的全局用量」这样的服务：`tokenUsage` 投影只覆盖单个会话，
会话列表也只带每个会话自己的合计。所以插件的宿主半边自己读会话日志：

- 用宿主的 `sessionQuery.readSession()` 读取每个会话的完整事件（会话日志是多帧 zstd，
  `node:zlib` 只解第一帧，解码必须交给宿主的读取器）；
- 折叠 `assistant/message` 与 `assistant/attempt` 上携带的使用量样本，
  同一 `turn`/`step` 上的重试替换而不是叠加，四个桶 input / output / cacheRead / cacheWrite 互不重叠；
- 在这之上补日期与小时两个维度，让界面能画热力图与趋势线，并按范围重新求和。

自算结果按「日志大小 + 修改时间」缓存在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-usage-stats/usage.json`，
热启动只重读变过的日志。汇总结果有 60 秒保鲜期，过期后下一次请求会在后台重算。

汇总通过私有路由 `GET /dsh-usage-stats/usage` 交给界面，该路由只接受同源只读请求，
并与宿主的 `/api` 使用同一道来源校验。

### 刷新时机

面板挂载时取一次，之后每 20 秒取一次；窗口重新可见或重新获得焦点时立即取一次。
面板被切走即停止，不留后台轮询。

宿主侧的汇总有 30 秒保鲜期：保鲜期内直接返回上一次的结果，过期后的第一次请求会在后台重算，
界面先拿到旧值、稍后自动补上新值。重算只重读「大小或修改时间变了」的会话日志，
所以这个频率的代价是一遍目录遍历加上当前会话日志的一次读取。

## 安装

插件是一个普通的 cordis bundle：包放进 profile 的 `node_modules`，再让 profile 认得它。
本机开发时用 `link:` 依赖最省事——源码改了不用重新拷贝。

以桌面 profile（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`）为例：

1. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖并挂进 bundle 清单：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "dsh-claude-style",
        "dsh-usage-stats"
      ]
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-usage-stats": "link:D:/BigModel/DSH_PLUGIN/dsh-usage-stats"
  }
}
```

2. 装依赖：

```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm install
```

3. 重启 DSH。插件包内的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会自己把 `ui-usage-stats` 这一行插进 Web 客户端清单，
   不需要另外改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

如果不想走 bundle 清单，也可以只把包拷进 `node_modules`，再在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾加一条：

```yaml
- id: ui-usage-stats
  name: dsh-usage-stats
  disabled: false
```

两种方式都需要重启 DSH 才会装载：profile 的 bundle 清单与 patch 文件在启动时读取。

## 开发

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs      # src/ → lib/client.js
node scripts/build.mjs --check
node --test test/usage.test.mjs test/routes.test.mjs
```

`test/` 覆盖两处不能靠界面看出来的接缝：宿主半边的折叠规则（重试替换、按天与按模型分桶、
连续天数、缓存往返、会话日志遍历），以及宿主路由（路径、方法、来源校验、冷启动应答）。

`lib/client.js` 是拼装产物，不要手改。源码在 `src/` 下，片段共享同一个作用域，
不使用 import/export，拼装顺序由 `scripts/build.mjs` 的 `FRAGMENTS` 决定。
不引入任何运行时依赖与打包器：DSH 的浏览器模块加载器没有相对 require，
插件 bundle 必须是一个自包含脚本。

宿主半边在 `host/` 下，是普通的 ESM：`index.js` 负责挂载，`usage.js` 负责汇总，
`routes.js` 负责路由，`home-path.js` 解析 harness home。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-theme-endfield-style

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A theme in the style of *Arknights: Endfield* for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web UI.
Unofficial fan work, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's publisher.


| Light | Dark |
|---|---|
| ![light](assets/screenshot-light.png) | ![dark](assets/screenshot-dark.png) |

## What it changes

- Fluorescent-yellow sidebar header and a signal rail on the right edge.
- A masthead with a large `DEEPFIELD` background word and procedurally drawn contour lines.
- Engineering grey-white and graphite-black palettes that follow the built-in light / dark / system setting.
- Small corner radii, thin lines, and a shortcut to the built-in Appearance settings in the sidebar.

All artwork is generated in code. There are no image files from the game, no network requests, and no animation loop.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-endfield-style
```

Or install it from the Themes tab of [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market). Refresh the page afterwards.

If the package is not on npm yet, install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Xiaoli-Asuna/dsh-theme-endfield-style
```

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-endfield-style
```

The theme only adds a `<style>` tag, a few decorative elements, and a `data-endfield-theme` attribute on `<html>`. Removing the plugin removes all of them.

## Compatibility

Selectors use DSH's hashed component class names (for example `.hHd-Xa_root`). They were verified against DSH `0.1.5-rc.3`. A newer DSH may rename them, and parts of the theme may stop applying until the selectors are updated. Please open an issue with your DSH version if that happens.

## Build

```sh
npm install
npm run build   # regenerates lib/client.js from src/client.ts and src/styles.css
```

## License

MIT. The theme is a visual homage; "Arknights: Endfield" and related names belong to their respective owners.

# ![dsh-rewind](./icon.svg) dsh-rewind



[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-YIYuNCU%2Fdsh--rewind-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/YIYuNCU/dsh-rewind)

**DeepSeek Harness 的按轮回退插件。** 把文件改回某一轮开始时的内容，并另开会话。原来的会话记录保持不变。

- 每一轮开始时，记下工作区里符合条件的文件。快照放在工作区外面，不写进仓库的 Git 对象。
- 回退会撤掉这一轮之后的文件工具改动，以及两轮之间的手改和脚本改动。
- 回退对话时另开一个会话，不截断原来的记录。

界面语言为简体中文和 English。

## 安装

这是一个 DSH Profile Bundle。安装使用仓库里已经构建好的 `lib/`，不需要在本机再构建。

### 网页或桌面端

在 **添加插件** 的输入框填：

```text
github:YIYuNCU/dsh-rewind
```

`desktop` 这个 profile 由桌面端独占，不要运行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop`，也不要手改 profile 的 `package.json`。第一次启用如果提示无法导入，完全退出并重新打开客户端，再启用一次。

### 命令行

网页 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YIYuNCU/dsh-rewind
```

本地检出可以用相对路径或绝对路径：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-rewind
```

## 使用

每个用户回合末尾有 **回退这一轮**。打开后可以选择：

| 操作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 回退代码和对话 | 恢复文件，并另开一个会话 |
| 只回退代码 | 只恢复文件，当前会话不动 |
| 只回退对话 | 只另开会话，文件保持现状 |

没有可回退的文件时，仍然可以只回退对话。文件恢复失败时不会另开会话。同一工作区还有代理在跑时，默认不允许改文件。

设置在插件详情页，不在客户端的设置面板里。改完立即生效。

## 设置

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 跳过生成目录 | 开 | 不记录「生成目录」里列出的目录，回退时也不删除它们 |
| 生成目录 | 常见语言的生成目录和临时目录 | 目录名用逗号分开，按路径中的一整段匹配。`*.egg-info` 匹配以 `.egg-info` 结尾的目录。这里填的是完整名单。`build`、`bin`、`obj`、`out`、`vendor`、`Library` 这类较宽的名字可以删掉 |
| 记录回合之间的改动 | 开 | 每轮开始时记下工作区。之后的手改和脚本改动，回退到这一轮时撤掉 |
| 记录子代理 | 开 | 子代理改的文件算到父会话当前这一轮 |
| 命令工具 | 标明跑过命令 | 只标明这一轮跑过命令，不给命令做快照。合格文件仍回到这一轮开始时的内容。另一项是「不标明」 |
| 文件冲突 | 询问 | 文件已经和记录不一致时：询问、跳过，或覆盖 |
| 删除本轮新建的文件 | 开 | 关闭后，这一轮新建的文件留在原地 |
| 把原话放回输入框 | 开 | 回退对话后，把当时的用户消息放进新会话的输入框 |
| 运行中禁止改文件 | 开 | 同一工作区还有代理在跑时，不允许回退代码 |
| 保留天数 | 30 | `0` 表示不按天数删除 |
| 最大存储空间 | 2048 MiB | 全部会话加在一起的上限。超出后丢掉最旧的一轮，至少保留一轮 |
| 最大存储轮数 | 1000 | 全部会话加在一起最多保留这么多轮 |
| 保存地址 | 默认目录 | 留空使用默认目录。保存后把已有文件转移到新地址。新地址须为空或不存在，且不能位于工作区内 |

生成目录、符号链接、硬链接，以及超过大小或数量上限的文件，不会自动撤掉。单个文件默认不超过 8 MiB，一轮默认最多记录 2000 个文件。

默认保存地址是 `$DSH_HOME/rewind/v1`。没有该变量时用 `~/.dsh/rewind/v1`。在插件详情页改地址时，已有文件会一起转移。

## 兼容

`package.json` 声明的 DeepSeek Harness 版本：

```text
>=0.1.0-rc.8 <0.2.0 || ^0.1.7-rc.1 || 0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.2
```

Node.js：`^22.19.0 || >=24`。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
```

`pnpm test` 会先构建 `lib/`，再运行测试。测试覆盖修改前记录、失败工具、命令缺口、冲突、新建文件、排除路径、符号链接、保留上限、回合之间的手改，以及中断回退后的启动补偿。

## 许可证

[BSD-3-Clause](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 插件：会话在 Obsidian 库里工作时自动把库打开——这样你装的同步插件（坚果云同步等）就会开始跑，AI 改的东西才能真正同步出去。已开着的库跳过，新窗口不抢焦点。（是 DSH 插件，不是 Obsidian 插件）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-open-obsidian

**这是一个给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（简称 DSH）用的插件，不是 Obsidian 插件。**
装进 Obsidian 里没有任何作用，Obsidian 也不会加载它。

English speakers: [jump to the English version](#english).

---

## 它做什么

两件事，都是为了同一个目的：**让 AI 写进库里的东西真的落盘、真的同步出去。**

**一、库会被自动打开。** 当一个 DSH 会话的工作目录位于某个 Obsidian 库文件夹内时，你在那个会话里
**发出第一条消息**的那一刻，插件会帮你在 Obsidian 里打开这个库。因为**同步插件（坚果云同步、
Obsidian Sync、Git 插件）只有在 Obsidian 开着的时候才会跑**。

这是它解决的实际问题：AI 在库里写了东西，可 Obsidian 没开着，同步就不会跑——等到
你哪天自己打开 Obsidian，改动才姗姗来迟。现在库会在对话开始时就打开，同步从那一刻起就在走。

它尽可能不打扰你：

- 库**已经开着** → 什么都不做（不新开窗口，也不抢焦点）；
- Obsidian **已经在运行** → 新窗口压到后面，焦点立刻还给你；
- Obsidian **没在运行** → 正常启动（这时候窗口弹出来正是你要的）。

**二、同一个库同一时刻只让一个对话写。** 两个对话同时往一个库里写，同步客户端会把两边的改动
拼在一起，结果是同一段话出现两遍、两个标题粘成一个。插件为此加了一把**写锁**：别的对话想写时，
那一次写入会被**真正拦下**（工具不执行、一个字节不写），等前一个写完才放行。详见下面
[写锁](#写锁一个库同时只让一个对话写)。

全程在 DSH 进程内完成、不经过模型：**零 token、零轮询。**

这个插件的设置面板是**中文界面**（本来就是给中文用户做的），所以这份说明也以中文为主。

> **关于作者**：本插件的作者没有编程背景，代码是在 DSH 的 AI 助手协助下完成的。

---

## 运行要求

| | |
|---|---|
| 系统 | **仅支持 Windows。** 它依赖 Windows 的进程/窗口接口、`%APPDATA%\obsidian` 注册表，以及 Obsidian 注册的 URL 协议；在 macOS / Linux 上无法工作。 |
| DSH | 需要暴露了本插件所用内部接口的 DSH 版本（见下面「已知限制」）。写锁还要求宿主提供 `tools/pre-execute` 钩子。 |
| Obsidian | 桌面版 1.x。开发与实测用的是 **1.14.4**。 |

---

## 安装

一条命令装好（`--profile` 是必填的，填你实际在用的 profile 名，默认是 `desktop`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NOOBnoob163/dsh-open-obsidian
```

> `dsh` 命令不在 PATH 里时，先在应用标题栏的 **应用** 菜单点 **管理 dsh 命令…** → **安装**。
> 它只是在桌面创建一个指向 DSH 自带命令行的小快捷方式，不会安装别的东西。

本包声明了 `dsh.bundle`，所以 DSH 装完会**自动启用**它，不需要手工改任何配置。
**装好后冷启动一次 DSH**（刷新页面不够），然后到 **设置 → Obsidian 助手** 里勾选你要管的库。

<details>
<summary>也可以手工装（不进 bundle 机制）</summary>

把仓库放进 profile 的插件目录：

```sh
# 如果你用的不是默认的 "desktop" profile，把 <profile> 换成你自己的
git clone https://github.com/NOOBnoob163/dsh-open-obsidian.git \
  "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\plugins\dsh-open-obsidian"
```

然后**二选一**：

- **走标准方式**：把 `dsh-open-obsidian` 加进 profile `package.json` 的
  `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表，由它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 负责挂载；**或者**
- **手工挂载**：在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` 里加一段：

  ```yaml
    # Obsidian 助手（本地插件 plugins/dsh-open-obsidian）
    - insert:
        - id: obsidian-launch
          name: 'dsh-open-obsidian'
  ```

  （`config` 段可以省略——实际设置存在
  `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\storages\dsh-open-obsidian.json`，面板上改的就是它。）

</details>

### 配置

打开 **设置 → Obsidian 助手**，勾选你想让它管的库。
**一个都不勾 = 完全不触发。**

### 长这样

![设置面板（浅色）](assets/panel-light.png)
![设置面板（深色）](assets/panel-dark.png)

---

## 设置项

所有开关**改一下就立即保存**，没有"保存"按钮。

| 设置项 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **自动打开 Obsidian** | 开 | 总开关。关掉 = 插件永远不打开任何东西。 |
| **检测到的知识库**（逐个库） | 全不勾 | 勾选要管的库。每个库的「已打开」状态都会拿**正在运行的** Obsidian 核实，所以关着的库不会被显示成开着。 |
| **目标库已打开时跳过** | 开 | 已经在屏幕上的库，完全不碰。 |
| **静默打开新窗口** | 开 | 新开的窗口压到后面，而不是让它抢走焦点。 |
| **写锁：一次只让一个对话写** | 开 | 同一个库同时只允许一个对话写入，其他对话的写入会被拦下、排队。见下文[写锁](#写锁一个库同时只让一个对话写)。 |
| **高级选项** | — | 可选的自定义启动命令。`{vault}` 会替换成解析出的库文件夹路径。留空 = 用 Obsidian 自己的 `obsidian://` 协议。 |

每一次"打开"和"跳过"都会记进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\logs\dsh-open-obsidian\decisions.log`
（有大小上限），所以插件但凡动过手，事后都能查是哪次触发的。面板上有按钮直接打开它。
写锁的每一次抢锁、拦下、放行也都记在同一份日志里（行首 `writelock`），排查"为什么这次没写进去"时
就靠它。

---

## 写锁：一个库同时只让一个对话写

**为什么要这个**：库如果交给网盘同步（坚果云、Obsidian Sync 之类），两个对话同时往里写的时候，
同步客户端会把两边的改动拼在一起——结果就是**同一段话出现两遍**、**两个标题粘成一个**、
**数字被接成一串乱码**。不是丢文件，是文件被拼坏，而且不容易发现。

**它怎么管**：

- 一个库，同一时刻只有一个对话能写。锁按**一整轮对话**持有，不是按一次写入——一轮里 AI 要写很多次，
  中间放开就会让两边混着写。
- 第二个对话想写的时候，**这一次写入会被直接拦下**：工具根本不会执行，一个字节都不会写进去。
  它会收到一句普通的工具报错，说明"现在另一个对话在写"。
- 被拦下的对话才会排进队列，等前一个写完。
- 前一个放锁后，会**当场**通知排在最前面的那个"轮到你了"。

**几条你可能想知道的**：

- **通知有可能过时**，所以通知里写的是"先自己核对一下，别急着重做"：如果你看到工作区是干净的、
  改动已经在文件里了，就别再写一遍（不然就变成重复写入了）。
- 只有当 AI 正**在这个库里干活**时才会被管；开个对话只在搜索资料、读文件、一个字没写，
  不会被排队，也不会被打扰。
- 子代理不参与——它是它所在那一轮的一部分，不能被自己的助手挡住。
- 一个对话卡死不动超过 **30 分钟**，锁会自动判定为"人已经不在了"，让下一个接手。
  这个时间可以在设置里改（`writeLockStaleMinutes`），设成 0 就是永不接管。
- 判断不清楚的时候**一律放行**：认不出的工具、解析不了的调用、插件内部出错，都会让这次调用过去。
  宁可偶尔漏拦一次（锁还会照常记录），也不要把正常的工作卡住。
- 不想要的话，把设置里的**「写锁：一次只让一个对话写」**关掉就行。

---

## 触发时机

插件只在**两种时机**打开 Obsidian，且都带去重和节流：

1. **会话的第一条真人消息**（工作目录在已启用的库内）。每个会话只判定一次。
2. **写入时兜底** —— 已启用的库里有文件变动，**但必须**满足"代理（AI）最近确实在这个库里干活"
   且"Obsidian 没在运行"。

DSH 的生命周期事件**故意不作为**触发条件。0.7.0 之前的版本会在 `session/created` 时也尝试打开，
而这个事件在**每次会话发布**时都会触发（界面加载、断线重连、宿主启动恢复上次工作区），
结果就是你什么都没干、Obsidian 自己弹出来了。0.7.0 已移除。无关的文件变动
（同步客户端、编辑器、`git` 维护）同样不会触发。

---

## 已知限制

**1.「打开一个没开的库、同时完全不打扰你」做不到。**
Obsidian 自己没有实现这个能力：它新建窗口用的是会抢焦点的 `show()`，而不是不抢焦点的
`showInactive()`，并且全程序没有任何跟焦点相关的开关（这是读它自己的 `app.asar` 确认的，
`showInactive` 出现 0 次）。

插件的做法是"新窗口压到后面 + 把焦点抢回来"。所以当被打开的库原本没开着时，**大约三次里
有两次会闪一下，约 0.1 秒**。没有第三条路——外部程序拦不住 Obsidian 自己激活窗口，只能事后纠正。

**接受不了可以关掉「静默打开」，就变回"正常打开、会跳到前台"。**

**2. 插件用了 DSH 的内部接口**（Web 路由注册、会话事件、设置页插槽、`__ModuleLoader__`）。
DSH 迭代很快，它一升级，插件有可能失效，需要跟着更新。欢迎提 issue。

---

## 目录说明

```
package.json                        插件清单（简介保持一句话，版本历史在 CHANGELOG.md）
lib/index.js                        宿主半 —— 库识别、触发判定、启动、写锁与写入闸门
lib/client.js                       浏览器半 —— 设置页的「Obsidian 助手」面板
bin/dsh-open-obsidian-silent.exe    编译好的助手程序：枚举窗口 + 静默打开
src/silent-open-helper.cs           上面那个 exe 的 C# 源码
test/behaviour.mjs                  行为回归测试（12 项）
test/panel.mjs                      设置面板测试（28 项）
test/writelock.mjs                  写锁测试（19 项）
test/writelock-gate.mjs             写入闸门测试（32 项）
```

**`bin\*.exe` 是故意一起提交的**——多数人没有 C# 编译器，而"静默打开"和"枚举 Obsidian 窗口"
都离不开它。源码一并在库里，方便审计和自行重新编译。

重新编译那个助手程序（Windows，用 .NET Framework 自带的 `csc.exe`）：

```powershell
& "$env:WINDIR\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe" /nologo /optimize+ /target:winexe `
  /out:bin\dsh-open-obsidian-silent.exe src\silent-open-helper.cs
```

---

## 测试

```sh
node test/behaviour.mjs        # 12 项
node test/panel.mjs            # 28 项
node test/writelock.mjs        # 19 项
node test/writelock-gate.mjs   # 32 项
```

四套测试都用假的宿主和假的 Obsidian，不需要真的开 Obsidian，也不联网。但需要先
`npm install`（宿主那半要 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 来定义配置项）。

> 测试要在**装好依赖的地方**跑。从源码仓库直接 `node test/...` 会找不到
> `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`——先 `npm install`，或者把仓库放进 profile 的 `plugins/` 里再跑。

---

## 许可证

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

设计上的一点说明：**插件的设置面板只有中文界面**，没有做多语言支持。这个插件主要是为
中文用户做的，说明文档因此也以中文为主。

---
---

# English

**This is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin — NOT an Obsidian plugin.**
Installing it inside Obsidian does nothing, and Obsidian will not load it.

*Note: the plugin's own settings panel is Chinese-only (it was built for Chinese users
first). The English documentation below is kept complete, but the UI you see after
installing will be in Chinese.*

## What it does

Two things, both for the same reason: **so that what the agent writes into a vault actually
lands on disk and actually gets synced.**

**1. The vault gets opened.** When a DSH conversation's working directory sits inside an
Obsidian vault folder, this plugin opens that vault in Obsidian for you — automatically, once
per conversation, when you send your first message. Because **a sync plugin (Nutstore sync,
Obsidian Sync, Obsidian Git) only runs while Obsidian is open.**

**Why that matters:** without it, the agent writes into the vault while Obsidian is closed,
nothing syncs, and the changes only travel the next time you happen to open Obsidian yourself.

It is deliberately quiet about it:

- If the vault is **already open**, nothing happens — no new window, no focus jump.
- If Obsidian is **already running**, the new window is pushed to the back and focus is handed
  straight back to whatever you were doing.
- If Obsidian is **not running**, it starts normally (the window appearing is the point).

**2. Only one conversation may write a vault at a time.** Two conversations writing at once get
their edits spliced together by the sync client — the same paragraph twice, two headings glued
into one. The plugin keeps a **write lock**: another conversation's write is **actually refused**
(the tool never runs, not a byte is written) until the holder is done. See
[Write lock](#write-lock-one-conversation-per-vault-at-a-time).

Everything runs inside the DSH process, outside the model loop: **zero tokens, zero polling.**

> **About the author:** the author has no programming background; the code was written with the
> help o

plugins.description: Proxmox VE VM control for DeepSeek Harness: see and click inside a VM console over VNC, plus commands, files and Unicode text through the QEMU guest agent.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pve-vm

**Proxmox VE VM control for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness): see a VM's screen and click in its console over VNC, plus commands, files and typed text through the QEMU guest agent.**

Almost every computer-use plugin drives the desktop the agent itself runs on — and therefore needs
X11 or Wayland, a screenshot tool and an input injector on that host. This plugin does something
different: it drives **the console of a virtual machine on a Proxmox VE node**, over one ssh
connection. The host can be a headless server, a Wayland desktop or a laptop in another country;
the guest can be Windows, Linux with any GUI, or a machine that has not booted yet.

```
agent ──► plugin ──► ssh ──► node: qm vncproxy ──► unix socket /var/run/qemu-server/<vmid>.vnc
                      └────► node: qm guest exec ──► qemu-guest-agent inside the VM
```

## What you get

* **Pixels** — `console_shot` returns the VM screen as an inline image (with `region` and `scale`
  to keep the token cost sane), and mouse/keyboard tools operate in VM screen coordinates: move,
  click, double click, drag, wheel, type, key combinations, and a batch runner that performs a
  chain of actions and returns a single frame at the end.
* **Commands** — `vm_exec`, `vm_file_read`, `vm_file_write`, `vm_status` through the QEMU guest
  agent. Deterministic and cheap: use pixels only where a GUI really is in the way.
* **Reliable input** — uppercase goes through Caps Lock (`qm monitor` → HMP `sendkey`), shifted
  symbols through RFB keysyms with a settle delay. This is what makes typing a password on the
  Windows login screen work instead of producing `xxXX` → `xxxX`.
* **Unicode text** — a Windows guest gets a scheduled task in the logged-in user's session
  (`SendKeys`), a Linux guest gets `xdotool`/`wtype` through the guest agent. Layout and
  modifiers stop mattering.
* **Clipboard** — `console_paste` writes UTF-8 text into the guest clipboard over RFB and presses
  Ctrl+V; `console_clipboard` reads the guest clipboard back, so text can leave the VM without OCR.
* **A settings card** in the web UI (English, Russian and Chinese labels), backed by the profile patch
  layer.
* **A live screen panel** — the “VM screen” tab in the right sidebar shows the frames the agent
  sees, taken from the very same VNC session, while the agent works. It follows the agent's VM
  automatically or stays on the VM you pick by hand. Watching only: the panel never clicks or types.
* **Zero runtime dependencies** — RFB, DES authentication, keysym tables and PNG encoding are
  implemented in this package on top of `node:crypto` and `node:zlib`. There is nothing to install
  on the host, and nothing to install on the node either.

Verified against `pve-manager 8.4.21` with Windows 11 / Windows Server 2025 and Linux guests, on
DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`.

## Requirements

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness **≥ 0.2.0-rc.2** | The plugin uses the 0.2.x plugin contract (`defineTool`, `ctx.tools`, `ctx.subprocess`, `ctx.attachments`, the `computerUse` slot, client-side `configForms`). It does not load on 0.1.x. |
| Node.js **≥ 22** | The harness runtime. |
| A **Proxmox VE** node with the `qm` CLI | `/usr/sbin/qm vncproxy`, `qm guest exec`, `qm monitor`. Containers (LXC) are not supported. |
| **SSH access to that node as `root`** (or an account that may run `qm`) | `qm` needs root on the node. Key-based access is expected (`BatchMode`, no password prompts). |
| **`AcceptEnv LC_*` in the node's `sshd_config`** | The VNC password is handed to `qm` as the `LC_PVE_TICKET` environment variable via `SendEnv`, so it never appears in `ps`. Without `AcceptEnv`, ssh silently drops it and the console cannot authenticate. |
| Host key already accepted | Connections run with `BatchMode=yes`; an unknown host key fails. Run `ssh <node>` once by hand, or add `StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new` to `sshExtraOptions`. |
| `qemu-guest-agent` **inside the guest** (optional) | Only the `vm_*` tools need it. Console tools work without any agent at all. |

## Install

```bash
# 1. Add the bundle
dsh plugin --profile web add github:taxah92/dsh-pve-vm

# 2. Make sure the bundle is enabled in the profile: dsh.profile.bundles must list "dsh-pve-vm"
#    (the plugin manager / market toggle does the same thing)

# 3. Restart the harness:  the host half of a plugin is loaded once per process
```

The plugin adds one row to the profile patch layer:

```yaml
- id: pve-vm
  name: dsh-pve-vm
```

The row id `pve-vm` **is** the settings namespace — do not rename it, or the settings card and the
patch layer will stop finding each other.

## Configure

Settings ▸ Plugins ▸ **Proxmox VE** in the web UI. Everything is written into the profile patch
layer, and the same values can be edited there by hand:

```yaml
- id: pve-vm
  name: dsh-pve-vm
  config:
    sshHost: proxmox            # alias from ~/.ssh/config, or an address
    sshUser: root
    sshPort: 22
    sshKeyPath: ''              # empty — default keys
    sshConfigFile: ''           # like `ssh -F`
    sshExtraOptions: []         # extra -o options, one per item
    allowVmids: [100, 101]      # VMs the plugin may touch; empty list forbids everything
    enableConsole: true
    enableGuest: true
    inputChannel: auto          # auto | hmp | vnc
    sendkeyDelayMs: 80
    consoleTimeoutMs: 20000
    sessionIdleMs: 300000
    guestTimeoutMs: 60000
    guestTypeCommand: ''        # script for typing non-ASCII text into a Linux guest
    viewAutoOpen: false         # open the "VM screen" tab by itself when the agent touches a console
    viewFollowAgent: true       # the panel follows the VM the agent works with
    viewFps: 2                  # frame pace in the panel, 1–4
    viewScale: 2                # frame resolution divisor: 1 native, 2 half, 4 quarter
```

**First run checklist**

1. `allowVmids` is empty by default — **nothing is allowed until you list a VM id**. This is the
   only gate the plugin has.
2. `ssh <alias> 'qm status <vmid>'` should work from the host without a password prompt.
3. `ssh <alias> sshd -T | grep -i acceptenv` must include `LC_*` (see Requirements).
4. Call `vm_status` — it reports whether the VM is allowed, whether the guest agent answers, which
   guest OS was detected, and whether a console session is open.

## Tools

### Console (VNC)

| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `console_shot` | `vmid`, `region?`, `scale?`, `drawCursor?`, `wake?` | Frame as an inline image. `scale` 1 / 0.5 / 0.25, `region` in VM pixels. Nearly uniform frames are flagged as `blank` (a blanked display or a locked screen). |
| `console_move` | `vmid`, `x`, `y`, `observe?`, `wake?`, `settleMs?`, `scale?`, `region?` | Move the pointer. |
| `console_click` | `vmid`, `x`, `y`, `button?`, `count?`, `observe?`, … | Click (2 = double click); returns a frame by default. |
| `console_drag` | `vmid`, `fromX`, `fromY`, `toX`, `toY`, `button?`, … | Drag — move a window, select a region. |
| `console_scroll` | `vmid`, `x`, `y`, `delta`, … | Wheel: positive scrolls up, negative down. |
| `console_type` | `vmid`, `text`, … | Printable ASCII only, `\n` presses Enter. Capitals go through Caps Lock, so expect ≈0.1 s per character. |
| `console_key` | `vmid`, `combo`, … | `enter`, `esc`, `tab`, `ctrl+alt+del`, `win+r`, `alt+f4`, `ctrl+shift+esc`, `f5`, and modifier-only combinations such as `alt+shift` (layout switch). |
| `console_paste` | `vmid`, `text`, `submit?`, … | Put any Unicode text into the guest clipboard and press Ctrl+V. Needs the clipboard-enabled VGA device and a SPICE agent. |
| `console_batch` | `vmid`, `actions[]`, `observe?`, … | A chain of actions (`move`, `click`, `drag`, `scroll`, `type`, `key`, `wait`) and one frame at the end. |
| `console_clipboard` | `vmid`, `timeoutMs?` | Read the guest text clipboard (extended VNC clipboard). Empty means "no text". |
| `console_release` | `vmid` | Close the console session (emergency brake: releases the ssh child and the QEMU connection). |

Every action tool accepts a common tail: `observe` (return a frame after the action, default true),
`wake` (Shift + poin

plugins.description: dsh 插件：把 DeepSeek Harness 的原生「标准模式」完整汉化——覆盖 preset-standard，不新增预设条目。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-yayan-preset

把 **DeepSeek Harness（dsh）** 的原生 **标准模式（standard）** 汉化：装上本包之后，标准模式
本身就说中文——系统提示词与全部工具描述汉化，模型以中文思维链工作，工具仍按 standard 的方式
**直接调用**（没有 `run_code` 这层中介，每个工具都是独立 schema）。

本包**不新增预设条目**，而是按 Loader 行 id **覆盖**随 dsh 出货的 `preset-standard`：预设列表里
仍然只有原生的「标准模式」，名字、位置、`config.id` 全部照旧，被换掉的只是它加载的插件列表
（多一个中文化层 `yayan-zh`）。停用或卸载本包即恢复原版。

和仓颉模式（[dsh-cangjie-preset](https://github.com/Alm-Allen/dsh-cangjie-preset)）是同一套汉化机制、同一张翻译表。
差别只在**挂载对象**：雅言覆盖原生 `standard`（标准模式），仓颉覆盖原生 `ptc`（PTC 模式）。
前者按 `mode: native` 把每个工具的 schema 直接发布给模型；后者按 `mode: ptc` 把工具包成
TypeScript SDK，模型写一段程序来调用它们。

本仓库是一个 **dsh 插件（bundle）**，不是安装脚本：`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch`
指向包内的 `cordis.patch.yml`，后者覆盖 `preset-standard` 那一行。安装、更新、卸载都交给
dsh 自己的插件管理。

## 安装

**插件页**：打开 dsh 的 **插件** 页 → **添加插件** → 输入

```
github:Alm-Allen/dsh-yayan-preset
```

**命令行**（`--profile` 换成你的 profile 名，网页端通常是 `web`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alm-Allen/dsh-yayan-preset

# 锁死到某个 commit —— 后续推送就改不了你装到的东西
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alm-Allen/dsh-yayan-preset#<commit-sha>
```

装完重启 dsh、刷新页面即可——**不需要再选预设**：`standard` 本来就是默认预设，被覆盖之后它
自己就是中文的。到 **设置 → Agent 预设** 里看到的仍是原生「标准模式」，不会多出条目。

- **桌面端**：桌面应用的 profile 是 `desktop`，CLI 对它有额外限制（要先完全退出应用再执行）。
  桌面端直接用**插件**页添加最省事。
- **本地改着玩**：`dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本仓库绝对路径>` 装的是符号链接，
  改完重启即生效。
- **不用它了**：`dsh plugin --profile web remove @alm-allen/dsh-yayan-preset`，
  或直接在插件页停用/卸载。

升级到最新：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @alm-allen/dsh-yayan-preset
```

## 装过更早的版本的话

更早的版本靠一键安装脚本装本预设，它和本包**不要同时用**：那套装法会在 profile 的**用户层**留下
同 id（`preset-yayan`）的声明。本包自「覆盖原生 standard」这版起不再声明 `preset-yayan`，所以
两者并存不会撞行 id，但那条旧声明会继续往预设列表里塞一个独立的「雅言模式」条目——要的就是
单一入口的话，先用那套脚本自带的回滚方式把它卸干净。

## 包结构

```
dsh-yayan-preset/
├── package.json                插件清单：name、exports、dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml            本包贡献的组合层：覆盖原生 preset-standard 声明
└── plugins/
    ├── yayan-zh.mjs            汉化层插件本体（零外部 import），同时也是包的入口
    ├── self-test.mjs           离线自测：翻译覆盖率、纪律注入、缓存契约
    ├── audit-coverage.mjs      覆盖率审计：扫 DSH 源码原文，列出漏译条目
    ├── audit-runtime-tools.mjs 运行时工具集审计（对照实际发布给模型的工具 schema）
    └── append-entries.mjs      维护工具：把译文安全追加进 PROSE 表（转义 + node --check + 失败回滚）
```

## 装进 profile 之后发生了什么

1. dsh 把包装到 `<profile>/node_modules/`，并把包名写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`——这一步由
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` 完成，`dsh plugin` 与插件页是同一条路径；
2. 启动组合时，本包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 作为一层，在 profile 自有 `cordis.patch.yml`
   **之前**应用（顺序见 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 的 profile 装载：各 bundle 的 patch →
   profile 自己的 patch → launcher 的 `--patch`）。本包排在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`
   **之后**，所以能覆盖后者 `insert` 出来的 `preset-standard`；dsh 的组合结果里会标注
   `# == @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app, patched by @alm-allen/dsh-yayan-preset`；
3. 预设内部那一行按**包名**解析到包入口 `plugins/yayan-zh.mjs`：它挂在
   `system-prompt/assemble` 瀑布（提示词与工具 schema）与 `agent/pre-step`（技能目录等注入块）
   上，只做文本替换；
4. 预设是 **agent 平面**的组合：它在 roster 的 standing scope 下挂载一次，选择本预设的会话按
   scope 父子关系加入；各注册表、沙箱与审批栈、持久化、模型路由仍留在宿主组合里，不受影响。

装本包不动你的默认预设**设置**，但它改的是默认预设的**内容**：只要默认（或当前会话所选）的是
「标准模式」，装完重启就是中文的，不需要额外操作。要回退就在插件页停用/卸载本包。

## 自测

```sh
# 用一份系统提示词快照验证翻译覆盖率（不给参数则用内置样本）
node plugins/self-test.mjs <一份系统提示词快照.md>
# 换个方向：扫 DSH 源码里的英文原文，列出没被翻到的条目
node plugins/audit-coverage.mjs <DSH 源码检出目录>
# 对照实际发布给模型的工具 schema 审计
node plugins/audit-runtime-tools.mjs <工具 schema 快照文件>
```

装进 profile 之后，路径换成：

```powershell
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\@alm-allen\dsh-yayan-preset\plugins\self-test.mjs"
```

`self-test.mjs` 列出**仍为英文的行**：正常情况下只剩 TypeScript 类型声明、枚举字面量，以及那条
**故意保留英文**的工作目录上下文（它属于用户消息里的运行时上下文，不是系统提示词）。它同时断言
section 数量不变、无未注册变量、翻译幂等，以及**换一个工作目录后 sections 与 tools 逐字节不变**
（前缀缓存契约）。

## 汉化是怎么做的

`yayan-zh.mjs` 监听 Cordis 的 `system-prompt/assemble` 瀑布：`await next()` 拿到下游全部贡献
之后的最终装配结果，本插件只做**文本替换**，不改结构、不改顺序、不增删 section。

相对仓颉版，本文件只做两件事：删掉只可能在 PTC 提示词里出现的 `run_code` / `tools:sdk` 专有条目；
其余条目与全部机制原样保留——尤其是逐工具翻译 schema 的 `translateTool`，它正是标准模式下翻译
生效的主路径。

替换分三层：精确段落映射 → 正则映射（含路径、URL、数字的动态文本）→ 长段落内的子串替换。
**只替换已知的英文原文**，未知文本原样保留，所以 dsh 升级后新增的工具或段落会以英文出现，
而不会被破坏或丢失。

这里没有 JSDoc 映射：那一层只服务 PTC 的 `tools:sdk` 段，而标准模式下工具说明直接作为独立
schema 的 `description` 发布，永远不会以 `/** ... *\/` 的形态出现。

身份段（行为纪律、提问纪律、文件与调用纪律）是唯一的例外：它由插件按 section 名
`harness:identity` 直接写入，不依赖英文原文匹配——上游改写那句话也不会让纪律静默消失。
身份段正文是**与环境无关的常量**：不写工作目录、时间、时区，也不引用任何提示词变量，
写进 section 时钉 `interpolate: false`，所以同一部署内系统提示词前缀恒定。

## 兼容性

- 零第三方依赖、零构建步骤：仓库里放的就是最终产物，所以 `github:` 直装不需要任何构建授权。
- 翻译表按 **0.2.1-rc.1** 的提示词逐条核对并适配；上游再次改写提示词时，未知文本原样保留为
  英文，用上面的自测（看真实提示词）或审计（看源码全量）自查。
- **基准版本是 0.2.1-rc.1**（Web 的全局 npm 包与 Desktop 内置运行时都是它）。`cordis.patch.yml`
  以该版 shipped `standard` 逐行重述：收录 `tool-schedule` 与 `tool-plugin-market`，不再保留
  rc.2 时代的 `tool-subagent-codex` / `tool-subagent-claude-code` / `tool-ralph` 三行。
- **升级 dsh 后要回头核对**：override 冻结整份 `config`，shipped 文件若新增或改动了插件行，
  本包不会自动跟随。升级后把 `cordis.patch.yml` 与 `dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml`
  对一遍（桌面端该文件在 `app.asar` 内，shell 打不开，但 dsh 自己的 read 工具能读）。
- 本包不声明任何 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 peer，因此不会被 dsh 的插件兼容性预检拦下；
  它也不注册服务、不碰沙箱与审批栈、不写任何全局配置。

## 更新记录

每个版本的更新记录在 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)——打标签发布时，Release 报告就是从它里面抽的。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — npm: dsh-tavily-cxykyw
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tavily-cxykyw

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes from a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request. Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. > Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is published as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`. ## What it does - registers a search provider with the stable id **`tavily`** on `ctx.web`; - maps Tavily's response to DSH's normalized `WebSearchResult` — `results[].url/title/content` become `sources[].url/title/snippet`, and Tavily's optional `answer` becomes the result `content`; - resolves the API key on **every** search, in this order: literal `apiKey` → credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) → launch environment / `process.env`; - `available()` is a cheap local check (key + base URL present) with no network calls — a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` at search time; - then truncates to `request.maxResults` through the seam, exactly like any other provider. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw ``` If your DSH profile is a pnpm workspace root (the default `~/.dsh/profiles/web` is), the add must target the workspace root: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding the package also registers it as a profile bundle: the provider row is inserted **and** `web.searchProvider` is set to `tavily` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — bundle changes are not hot-reloaded. From a checkout instead of npm: ```sh git clone https://github.com/cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-search-tavily -w ``` ## Configure the API key Get a key at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) (there is a free tier). Then pick **one** of: **1. Credentials file (recommended — outside every repository):** ```yaml # ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` **2. Environment variable** of the process that launches DSH: ```sh TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx dsh web ``` **3. Literal key in your own profile patch** (works, but keeps the secret in a plain file — prefer 1 or 2): ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: apiKey: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` > **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarball contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine at search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`. ## Options Configurable on the inserted `web-search-tavily` row: | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. | | `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. | | `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). | | `searchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). | | `maxResults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. | Example, overriding just the depth and result count: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: searchDepth: advanced maxResults: 5 ``` ## Switching providers The bundle patch already pins the seam: ```yaml - id: web config: searchProvider: tavily fetchProvider: http ``` To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no pin, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`). > Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice. ## Notes and limitations - No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is configured through the profile patch only. - `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`. - Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set. ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` ## License MIT © cxykyw

plugins.description: Sign in to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other subscription model routes inside the DeepSeek Harness — the sign-in button the Harness never shipped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subscription-signin

[![tests](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

**The sign-in button the DeepSeek Harness never shipped.**

Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for — ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max,
GitHub Copilot, and more — as model routes inside the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Adds a
**Subscriptions** settings page plus a compact extension on every provider card
in **Settings → Models**.

```text
Settings → Subscriptions → ChatGPT (Codex) → [ Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex) ]
                                    ↓
                    github.com/login/device  ·  code ABCD-1234
                                    ↓
                    ✓ Signed in — draws on your plan
```

No password is ever collected or stored by this plugin. The vendor runs the
sign-in on its own page; the Harness credential store writes the token.

## Repository layout

The **installable package is the `dsh-subscription-signin/` directory.** The
tests, license and documentation sit beside it and are not part of the package:

```text
dsh-subscription-signin/   ← the package; this is what you install
  host.js                  ← the Host half (tool + HTTP route)
  client.js                ← the Client half (settings page + provider card)
  cordis.patch.yml         ← the accounts, as configuration
  locale/en.json           ← package metadata strings
  package.json
smoketest/                 ← five dependency-free suites (run from the root)
docs/FINDINGS.md           ← what was measured vs inferred
```

---

## Why this exists

The Harness already ships everything needed to *use* a subscription as a model
route. Its LLM adapter registers OAuth flows for eight providers — the transport
works, the token exchange works, the credential store works.

What it has no surface for is **starting** one. Nothing in the GUI or CLI ever
calls the authorization seam's `begin()`. This plugin is that missing surface.

It implements **no OAuth**. It does not touch PKCE, state, device codes, or token
parsing — all of that lives in `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, shipped by DeepSeek. This
plugin asks the Harness to begin a flow, shows you the URL and code, and reports
the result.

## Supported providers

Configured out of the box, driven through the Harness's own authorization seam:

| Provider | Credential | Login style |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT (Codex) | `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | device code |
| Claude (Pro/Max) | `llm-pi-ai/anthropic` | OAuth |
| GitHub Copilot | `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot` | device code |
| xAI | `llm-pi-ai/xai` | device code |
| Meta | `llm-pi-ai/meta` | device code |
| OpenRouter | `llm-pi-ai/openrouter` | OAuth + paste fallback |
| Radius | `llm-pi-ai/radius` | browser callback |
| Kimi For Coding | `llm-pi-ai/kimi-coding` | device code |

**Honest status.** Sign-in is verified end to end for **ChatGPT (Codex)** and
**Claude (Pro/Max)**; Claude's route was observed authenticating successfully and
then being rate-limited by the account (HTTP 429 with Anthropic's own
`request_id` — a quota answer, not a credential failure). Copilot's flow is
verified and completes. xAI, Meta, OpenRouter, Radius and Kimi hold credentials
that have been written successfully, but **no request has been served on those
routes in the session where this was verified**, so treat them as untested rather
than broken. `docs/FINDINGS.md` records what is measured versus inferred.

## Install

**Requirements.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later. Developed and verified
against `0.2.0-rc.2`, the release this plugin's two seams were checked on
(`ctx.authorization` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization`, and the client
`slots` service). Every Harness service it consumes is reached with a defensive
`ctx.get(...)` plus an undefined check, so a missing one degrades to a reported
message instead of a crash — but a Harness that has moved a seam will still need
a matching plugin release.

The plugin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this directory:

```text
install_bundle: link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subscription-signin
```

Or, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-subscription-signin"] } }
```

Then **restart DSH once.** This matters and is explained under
[Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) — the client half is composed into the
browser's boot graph at startup, so a freshly installed bundle has no page until
the process restarts.

## Use

From the GUI: **Settings → Subscriptions**, pick an account, press *Sign in*.

For an agent, or a headless harness, the same implementation is exposed as a tool
with actions `status`, `start`, `poll`, `cancel`, `signout`, `submitCode` and
`diagnostics`. Read `status` first; `start` returns the URL and, for device
grants, the code you enter on the vendor's page.

## Safety

This section is the reason to trust the plugin, so it is specific rather than
reassuring.

**It never sees a secret.** No password, token, API key or refresh token is read,
written, logged, or forwarded. The token is produced and stored by the Harness
credential seam (`ctx.authorization` / `ctx.credentials`), not by this code.
Audit it yourself — it is two files:

- **`host.js`** — zero imports. No filesystem access, no network requests, no
  child processes. It asks the credential store *whether* a record exists, and
  can delete one on explicit `signout` with `confirm: true`; it never reads a
  token value. The one `process.env` write is the documented per-account `env`
  field (used so a provider that selects its endpoint from the environment can be
  configured per account), and it is restored when the attempt settles.
- **`client.js`** — one dependency, `react`, supplied by the page. Its only
  `fetch` calls go to the plugin's own `/plugins/subscription-signin` route on
  your local Harness. Nothing is rendered from a credential.

**The one network-bearing route is trust-gated.** The panel reaches the Host half
over an HTTP route that inherits the Harness's own checks
(`connection.requestRejection`: Host/Origin validation and browser
authentication). On top of that, every mutating call must be a JSON `POST`, which
forces a CORS preflight and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `nosniff`.

**Not sanctioned by the vendors — read this.** For ChatGPT-plan usage, the
Harness targets the ChatGPT/Codex backend
(`chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`), which OpenAI's developer documentation tells
third-party apps not to target for plan usage. **This plugin surfaces behaviour
the Harness already ships; it does not introduce it and cannot change it.** The
sanctioned path for third-party apps is *Sign in with ChatGPT*, which the Harness
does not implement. Using a subscription outside a vendor's intended client may
conflict with that vendor's terms, and vendors may rate-limit or block such
traffic. You are choosing to do that with your own account. Do not use this to
resell access, and do not use it to reach credentials that are not yours.

**No credentials are in this repository.** If you ever find one here, that is a
bug — please open an issue. The repository was scanned for tokens, private keys,
home paths and email addresses before its first commit. `docs/FINDINGS.md` does
cite exact package versions and source symbols from the Harness, which is
deliberate: a claim about a specific build is only useful if it names the build.

**Found a vulnerability?** Report it privately via
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue. That file also lists what
is and is not in scope — worth reading first, because the unofficial-backend
caveat above is a documented trade-off rather than a defect, and the two are easy
to confuse.

## Configuration

Accounts are configured, not hardcoded. They live in this package's own
[`cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-subscripti

plugins.description: 去掉 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）「当前模型不支持图片」的拒绝限制：不改 app.asar，用运行时接缝放行未声明多模态能力的模型
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vision-unlock

去掉 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）「当前模型不支持图片」的拒绝限制，让未声明多模态能力的模型也能发送和读取图片。

不修改 `app.asar` 里任何一行代码，也不改配置树——纯运行时接缝，随 DSH 升级继续可用。

## 为什么会被拒绝

DSH 判定一条路由能否吃图片，依据两处能力声明：

- **`LlmModelInfo.inputModalities`**（可选字段）。缺这个字段，或数组里没有 `"image"`，
  就被当成纯文本模型。这是**所有门禁**的唯一判定来源：

  | 位置 | 表现 |
  |---|---|
  | 会话控制器 `prompt()` | 发送时弹「当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型」 |
  | 子代理 `assertImageCapable` | 向子代理发图被拒 |
  | `read_file` 读图 | `does not declare image input` |
  | MCP / ACP 图片注入 | 同上 |

- **适配器自己持有的模型表**（不经过上面那处）。pi-ai 在发请求前查
  `model.input.includes("image")`；deepseek 适配器序列化前查
  `connection.models[].inputModalities`。

**典型触发场景**：自定义/本地网关路由（如 Agent2API、自建 OpenAI 兼容网关）在配置里只写了
`id / name / contextWindow / maxTokens`，没写 `input`，于是落到默认值 `["text"]`，
被判定为不支持图片——哪怕上游模型其实支持。

## 本插件怎么做

只用两个运行时接缝：

1. 包装 `llm.resolveModelInfo`，给结果补上 `"image"` → 拆掉上表中所有门禁。
2. 遍历 `llm.adapters`，把适配器模型表里的 `input` / `inputModalities` 补上
   `"image"` → 拆掉 pi-ai 的自检。适配器换快照（配置热更新）时自动重做。

## 安装

### 方式 A：用 `plugin_manager` 安装（推荐）

在 DSH 里让 agent 执行：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock
```

或在 Web UI 的 **设置 → 插件** 面板里，把上面这串填进安装框。

`target` 也可以写完整 URL，两种等价：

| 写法 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock` | GitHub 简写，推荐 |
| `https://github.com/wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock` | 完整 git URL |

锁定版本用 `#` 加 ref：

```
github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock#v1.0.0
```

> 若本机访问 GitHub 不畅，DSH 走的是它自己的网络栈；必要时先确认你的代理环境
> 能被 DSH 进程继承（例如 Clash Verge 的 TUN / 系统代理）。

### 方式 B：手动安装（CLI 或插件管理不可用时的降级方案）

1. 把本仓库放到一个稳定的路径，例如 `D:\workbench\dsh-vision-unlock`。
2. 在你的 profile 目录（默认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/`）的 `node_modules` 下建立指向它的链接：

   ```powershell
   cmd /c "mklink /J `"%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-vision-unlock`" `"D:\workbench\dsh-vision-unlock`""
   ```

3. 编辑该 profile 的 `package.json`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组加入 `"dsh-vision-unlock"`，
   并在 `dependencies` 加入 `"dsh-vision-unlock": "link:D:/workbench/dsh-vision-unlock"`。
4. 重启 DSH。

> Windows 上用 **junction**（`mklink /J`）而不是符号链接——后者需要管理员权限。
> 注意 desktop profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop`
> 会拒绝执行，所以才有这里的手动步骤。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `config`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: vision-unlock
      name: 'dsh-vision-unlock'
      config:
        providers: []   # 留空 = 所有 provider；否则只放行列出的
        models: []      # 留空 = 所有模型；否则只放行列出的
```

两个白名单都为空时全部放行；非空时需**同时**命中才放行。

## 已知边界

- deepseek 适配器的模型表来自它自己的 plugin config，不经由 `llm.adapters` 暴露，
  本插件改不到。该路由如需图片，请在设置页给模型勾选 Image（等价于写
  `inputModalities: [text, image]`）。
- 放行后图片**真的会发出去**。若上游实际不支持多模态，报错会从模型侧返回，
  不再是 DSH 本地拒绝——这是预期行为，不是 bug。

## 卸载

从 profile 的 `package.json` 中删掉 `dsh-vision-unlock`（`bundles` 与 `dependencies` 两处），
删除 `node_modules/dsh-vision-unlock`，重启 DSH。

## 适用版本

针对 DSH 桌面版（含 `dsh-llm` / `dsh-llm-pi-ai` / `dsh-api-session-controller`）验证。
依赖的是 `llm.resolveModelInfo` 与 `llm.adapters` 这两个接口，若上游改动需要同步调整。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

# Artifact Center · 产物中心

Find the file a DSH conversation produced, together with its workspace and conversation history.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Requirements](docs/requirements.zh.md) · [Acceptance record](docs/acceptance.zh.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

## Features

- A global sidebar panel that works without an active conversation.
- Historical backfill from complete session events, including file writes, edits and explicitly presented deliverables.
- Live workspace snapshots at turn end to detect shell and subprocess outputs. Large output bursts are summarized rather than flooding the list.
- Workspace/tag/date filters, favorites, notes, bounded text-content search and a virtualized list. Check or uncheck extensions directly under “Readable formats” to control visibility; the choice is saved in this browser.
- Native image, PDF, Markdown, Mermaid, text/code, CSV/TSV, sandboxed HTML and media previews. Office files and binaries use the system's applications; no format conversion takes place.
- Conversation links, path/link copying, file-handler selection, provenance history and CSV/Markdown export.
- Missing-file checks and confirmed moves to the system trash. Retrieve a file using your file manager, then check files to restore its index status.
- A read-only `artifact_search` Agent tool and Chinese/English UI.

History records provenance and metadata; it **does not preserve old file contents**. Snapshot results are labeled as inferred because filesystem changes cannot prove which concurrent task caused them. Historical shell outputs that have no recorded path cannot be reconstructed from current files alone. Starting with 0.1.2, a separate provenance table preserves recorded outputs and annotations when the derived list cache is rebuilt. Persisted turn checkpoints survive restarts; completed turns are recovered without including files modified after their recorded end time. Removing the entire storage domain also removes provenance and annotations. `enableBetterSidebar` is reserved; delegation to that optional plugin is not implemented. The built-in Markdown and Mermaid renderers work independently.

## Install

From npm (published baseline: 0.1.0):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artifact-center
```

Or install the repository while directory review is pending:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YQing0123/dsh-artifact-center
```

Restart the Host and refresh the browser. The Electron-managed `desktop` profile must be installed through its plugin manager; do not manage it with CLI commands. Market availability depends on acceptance of the [directory entry](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin).

## Configuration

The plugin ID is `artifact-center`. Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- update:
    artifact-center:
      config:
        backfillOnStart: true
        snapshotOnTurnEnd: true
        burstThreshold: 500
        maxIndexedFiles: 50000
        previewMaxBytes: 20971520
        textMaxBytes: 1048576
        validationIntervalMs: 300000
        readableExtensions:
          - md
          - txt
          - json
          - yaml
          - yml
          - csv
          - js
          - ts
          - png
          - jpg
          - pdf
        autoTags:
          - name: Deliverable
            kind: glob
            value: outputs/**
          - name: Spreadsheet
            kind: ext
            value: xlsx
```

Automatic tag rules accept `glob`, `ext` and `session` (conversation-title substring). `readableExtensions` is a whitelist of extensions without the leading dot; the Artifact Center navigation shows the active list under “Readable formats”. An empty list uses all built-in supported formats. Files outside this whitelist are not indexed or content-read. Default ignored directories: `.git`, `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `.next`, `__pycache__`, `.venv`, `target`, `.cache`, `.dsh`. `ignorePatterns` replaces the default list when explicitly supplied. State is held through the Host's `storageDomain` API under `artifact_center`.

HTTP routes under `/artifact-center/*` require the Host's browser authentication and same-origin request guard. Only indexed files inside their registered workspace can be read or opened; outside symlinks are rejected. HTML previews cannot execute scripts or access the network. Text search reads at most `textMaxBytes` per candidate; it is not a semantic or binary-document search engine.

## Agent tool

`artifact_search(query, workspace?, type?, tag?, since?, limit?)` returns matching metadata and paths. `workspace` accepts an ID or title; types include `doc`, `sheet`, `slide`, `image`, `web`, `data`, `code`, `media`, `archive` and `other`. `since` is an ISO timestamp and `limit` is at most 100. Missing and trashed files remain labeled in results.

## Development

Host and UI are plain JavaScript. Only the lazy Mermaid renderer is independently bundled; no Harness build preset or internal UI package is imported.

With the isolated development Host and authenticated `artifact-p0` browser running, `npm run test:ui` checks fixture-only previews, tag errors and a 10,000-record virtual list. API writes are intercepted and never reach real storage or system actions. `npm run test:locale` checks the English UI and restores the original language preference.

Search refreshes the current registered workspace boundaries before reading content. Removed workspaces and paths outside a workspace's changed root are excluded without deleting their recorded provenance. After committing the release source, pack into `.cache` and run `npm run release:check` to compare the archive with both the working files and Git HEAD and generate a local integrity receipt. This command does not publish or authenticate.

```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build:vendor
npm run check
npm test
npm pack
```

Renderer bundles and license notices are committed and shipped, so installation does not run a compiler. Test probes are excluded from the npm package and load only through a separate development overlay. Read [development notes](docs/dev-notes.zh.md) and [implementation corrections](docs/implementation.zh.md) before changing the integration.

The reference acceptance Host is DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`. Desktop `0.2.0` compatibility is declared in the optional native-opener peer range, but desktop installation must also pass that Host's plugin manager and browser acceptance. Older sessions rejected by the Host's migration are reported individually; their raw logs are never modified by this plugin.

## License

MIT. Browser renderers and their dependencies retain their own licenses; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and `vendor/`.

plugins.description: 自动识别本机所有工具的 MCP 配置，并且能进行修改
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-global-manager

DSH 侧栏面板：把散落在本机各编程工具里的 MCP 配置收进一处——扫描差异 → 一键采纳进 DSH → 需要时写回原工具 → DSH 侧直接增删改停用。

*A DSH sidebar panel that scans MCP configs from the tools it knows (28 built-in sources plus custom ones), syncs diffs into DSH, and lets you import, write back, or edit MCP servers.*

MIT · Windows / macOS / Linux · DSH ≥ 0.1.6-alpha · 不出网 · 不执行命令

## 界面速览

> 以下截图中的本机绝对路径已做模糊处理，仅保留 `~` / `%APPDATA%` 通用占位。

**① 扫描总览** —— 顶部状态徽章（条目 / 一致 / 存在的文件）+ 按工具分组的差异账本，新/变/缺/同四态一目了然：

![扫描总览](assets/screenshot-1.png)
