A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-douyin-publish（视频发布器 · 抖音 / B站）

**把一段本地视频，一路送到投稿页的"待发布"状态。**

打开投稿页 → 版式自检 → **把文件直接塞进页面自己的上传控件** → 填标题 → 填文案/话题 → 设可见性 → **默认停手**。

> 这是九个作品里唯一的"功能"（其余多是工具）：它不止给 AI 加一个动作，
> 而是替使用者跑完一条链 —— 开页面、交文件、填表、判断该不该发。
> 也正因为如此，它的默认值必须**保守**。

---

## 0.4.2：B站真正吃文件的是那个"藏着"的 input（2026-10-17 晚，真机）

第二次真机跑，卡在"等了 61 秒编辑表单没出来"。查下来：B站投稿页有**三个** `input[type=file]` ——
一个**隐藏**的（外面包着 `.bcc-upload-wrapper`）、一个看得见的按钮里的、一个给字幕的 `.txt`。
**真正驱动上传的是隐藏的那个**；塞进看得见的那个，页面一动不动（文件在 input 里，但没人接）。

旧代码按"可见优先"挑，正好挑错。现在：

1. 候选按 **DOM 先后**排，不再按可见性；
2. 塞完先**看页面有没有往前走**（编辑表单出现），没走就**换下一个候选**试，最多 3 个；
3. 回执里写明"塞进了第 N 个上传控件"。

## 0.4.1：真机上遇到的两个"不是改版"的情况（2026-10-17 晚）

第一次拿真 B站账号跑 v0.4.0，卡在"版式自检"——不是选择器坏了，是两件真事：

1. **上传按钮比 `input[type=file]` 晚渲染**。旧代码只要看到 file input 就去自检，
   而 B站的上传区还在画 → 误报 `layout-changed`。现在会**等上传区真的出现**（最多 15 秒）。
2. **B站会提示"本地浏览器存在 N 个未提交的视频 → 继续编辑 / 不用了"**。自动化不该接管别人的旧草稿：
   现在看到这个提示会点「不用了」，从新稿开始（旧稿原样留着），并在回执里记一笔。
   如果页面**直接**把旧稿恢复成编辑态（没给"不用了"），会明确报 `resumed-draft`，
   让你先去处理那条旧稿——而不是猜成"改版"。

## 配乐：让用户自己在平台曲库里挑（v0.6.0）

**不是本地音乐库**。抖音自己的曲库里有搜歌、试听、使用那一套，那是平台的东西，
我们不去复制它 —— 我们只负责**把那个面板打开、再往前送一步**：

```
douyin_upload({ ..., pickMusic: true })                  // 打开面板 + 聚焦搜索框
douyin_upload({ ..., pickMusic: true, musicSearch: "轻快" })  // 打开面板 + 顺手搜「轻快」
```

流程是：填完标题/文案/话题/封面 → 点右侧「添加音乐」标签 → 等「选择音乐」侧边面板长出来
→ **把「搜索音乐」框聚焦** → **停**。剩下的打字/试听/点「使用」由人在浏览器窗口里做
（平台会自己把歌混进视频）。

真机核对的细节（2026-10-18）：入口不是文案「添加音乐」，而是右侧那颗 `div[class*=preview-button]`
标签；点开后的面板里有一个 `input[placeholder*="搜索音乐"]`，它外面盖着遮罩，**点不可靠、`el.focus()` 可靠**。
`mode=publish` 时不打开面板（避免和发布撞在一起）；B站的曲库面板还没核对，传了会标 warn 跳过。

**`musicSearch` 是实验性的**：我在这台机器上没能稳定把词打进去 —— 脚本改 `value`（native setter、
`execCommand`）都能改值，但抖音的搜索只在**真实键盘事件**时才触发；而插件会话里的按键投递时好时坏。
所以它默认只做"打开面板 + 聚焦"，词打不进去时回执会**如实说**"请你手动在搜索框里输"，不会假装成功。
不想点的话，用下面的 `bgmPath` 走本地混音。

**另一条路（可选）**：`bgmPath` 给一段本地音频，它会先用 ffmpeg 混好再上传（原视频不动），
`bgmVolume` 默认 0.35 —— 适合"我就要这一首，别让我点"的场景。

## 两条默认值是刻意的

| 参数 | 默认 | 要改成别的必须显式说 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `visibility` | **`private`（仅自己可见）** | `visibility: 'public'` / `'friends'` |
| `mode` | **`draft`（不点投稿）** | `mode: 'publish'` |

发布是**不可逆且对外可见**的动作。所以这个插件默认只做到"表填好、停投稿前"，
你要发，就再说一次。想先看看会发生什么，用 `dryRun: true`。

**平台没有你要的可见性时，插件直接拒绝**（`visibility-unsupported`），
不会"默认当你没说过"然后按公开发出去。

## 文件是怎么交给页面的（v0.4 的关键改动）

以前靠"真点上传按钮 → 等系统『打开文件』对话框 → 用 UI 自动化填路径"，
那条路要碰另一个进程的窗口、会挡住使用者、还得起 PowerShell，
**而且它出过一次"看起来成功、其实没交上"的事故**（见下）。

现在默认走**注入**：

1. 本机在 `127.0.0.1` 的一个随机端口起一个**只读、只服务这一个文件、带随机令牌**的小服务；
2. 页面自己 `fetch` 回来，用 `DataTransfer` 造一个真 `File`，塞进页面的 `input[type=file]`，
   派发 `input`/`change`；
3. 之后就是页面自己的上传逻辑在跑 —— 和"人手选文件"完全一样，但**不弹对话框、不挡人**。

安全边界写死：只绑回环地址、只认一条路由（令牌不对一律 404）、不列目录、用完就关（另有空闲超时兜底）。

**什么时候退回系统对话框**：文件超过 `maxInjectBytes`（默认 512MB）、
或注入被页面拦下（CSP/CORS）。退回时会**回读校验**，读不回来就判失败 —— 不点确认、不假装成功。

## 它做什么（每一步都留证据）

| 步 | 动作 | 细节 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ① | 检查视频 | 大小 / 分辨率 / 时长 / 编码（ffprobe，拿不到也不拦） |
| ①' | **配乐（可选）** | 给了 `bgmPath` 就先用 ffmpeg 混一段新视频：原视频有声→与原声混合（`bgmVolume` 默认 0.35）、无声→BGM 铺满；**原视频不动**，混音失败直接报错不硬发 |
| ② | 借浏览器会话 | 用自己的会话键，和别的任务不串台 |
| ③ | 打开投稿页 | 平台档案里的地址（抖音 / B站） |
| ④ | 等上传控件 | 轮询到 `input[type=file]` 出现为止 |
| ④' | **版式自检（投稿页）** | 上传控件 / 「上传视频」区域缺一个 → 立刻报 `layout-changed` 并点名，不硬着头皮跑 |
| ⑤ | **交文件** | 注入（默认）；大文件或注入失败才退回系统对话框 |
| ⑥ | 等编辑页 | 按平台的"编辑控件是否出现"判（B站**不换 URL**，URL 只当旁证） |
| ⑥' | **版式自检（编辑页）** | 标题框 / 投稿按钮缺一个 → 同样当场报 `layout-changed` |
| ⑦ | 填标题 | **整段写入后回读**（B站会预填文件名，所以要覆盖而不是追加） |
| ⑦' | **填文案 + 代填话题** | 抖音：文案与 `#话题` 都进简介，打完回读；B站：文案进简介，话题进「标签」并回车确认 |
| ⑧ | 设可见性 | 抖音按中文标签点 checkbox；B站展开「更多设置 → 可见范围」再选，**回读选中态** |
| ⑧' | **设封面帧** | 只有抖音做：打开「选择封面」→ 时间轴挪到 `coverTime`（**默认第 1 秒**，第 0 帧常是黑场）；设不上只标 warn |
| ⑨ | 投稿，或**故意不投稿** | `mode=draft` 时这一步记 `skipped` |

失败会分类说清：`no-browser` / `platform-unsupported` / `visibility-unsupported` /
`upload-page-timeout` / `edit-page-timeout` / `layout-changed` / `handover` / `visibility` / `bgm`。

## 平台

| 平台 | 状态 | 差异 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **抖音** | ✅ 真机核对过 | 话题写进简介；可见性三档（公开/好友/仅自己可见）；封面帧可设 |
| **B站** | ✅ 真机核对过（2026-10-17） | **不换 URL**就切到编辑态；标题预填文件名；话题进「标签」（回车）；可见范围在「更多设置」里（公开可见/仅自己可见，**没有好友**）；封面帧未核对 |
| 小红书 / X | ⛔ 还没核对 | 传 `platform="xiaohongshu"` 之类会**明确拒绝**（`platform-unsupported`），不拿别的平台的选择器去瞎点 |

要扩到别的平台，前提是**先真机把那个平台的投稿页走一遍**（登录态、上传入口、标题/简介框、
话题落地方式、可见性入口、投稿按钮），再往 `lib/platforms.js` 补一份档案 ——
这是"给别人用"的底线，不能拿猜的选择器充数。

## 它依赖什么

- **浏览器插件**（借宿主的 `ctx.browser` 服务）—— 没有时**明确报错**，不会假装能用。
- **可选**：`ffprobe`（没有也能发，只是少了元信息）。
- 大文件才需要的退路：自带 `lib/handover.ps1`（与作者的 `dsh-file-handover` 同源，
  但各作品独立成仓，不互相依赖）。

## 安装

市场收录后在 DSH 里搜 `dsh-douyin-publish` 安装。手动安装：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-douyin-publish" -Target "D:\dsh\projects\dsh-douyin-publish"
# profile 的 package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-douyin-publish": "link:D:/dsh/projects/dsh-douyin-publish"
# 并把 "dsh-douyin-publish" 加进 dsh.profile.bundles（漏了不加载）→ 重启 DSH
```

**发布前先做这两件事**：① 装好浏览器插件；② 在浏览器窗口里**登录对应平台的创作中心**
（登录态存在浏览器 profile 里，一次登录可跨重启复用）。

## 用法

```
douyin_upload videoPath=D:\videos\a.mp4 [platform=douyin|bilibili] title="标题" \
  [description="文案"] [topics="猫,狗"] [coverTime=1] [visibility=private] [mode=draft|publish] [dryRun]
```

典型流程：`dryRun: true` 看一眼 → 正式跑一次（停投稿前）→ 到浏览器里核对 → `mode: 'publish'` 真发。

## 已知限制

- **版式绑定**：选择器基于真机实测（抖音 2026-10-16、B站 2026-10-17）；
  平台改版后需要同步更新。插件**先自检再动手**：关键控件缺一个就当场报 `layout-changed` 并点名缺什么。
- **注入会把文件读进浏览器渲染进程**：所以设了 `maxInjectBytes`（默认 512MB）上限，超过自动退回系统对话框。
- **抖音话题是"联想式"的**：代填是把 `#话题` 打字进简介框，**是否被转成真标签由页面决定**；
  所以填完一定回读，读不齐就明说"请在页面上看一眼"，不假装成功。
- **B站标签上限 20 字**：超长的话题会被页面截断，回执里会提醒。
- **封面是尽力而为**（仅抖音）：靠封面弹窗里的时间轴定位；弹窗里没有时间轴时只标 warn、保留默认封面。
- **验证码 / 风控不硬试**：检测到就停下请人到浏览器窗口处理，再继续。
- **系统对话框那条退路仅 Windows**：注入这条路是跨平台的。
- **不做内容创作**：剪片、封面图、文案是内容管线的事（用 ffmpeg 等），这个插件只负责"送上去"。

## 自测

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs   # 165 项：假浏览器 + 假 spawn + 真起一个回环小服务；断言编排序列、默认值、失败分类、版式自检、话题/标签、可见性、平台拒绝
```

## License

MIT

# dsh-mc-gradle-runner

**在 DeepSeek Harness 里一键跑 Minecraft 的 `runClient` / `runData`，并且让模型自己会用。**

写 Minecraft 模组最烦的两件事：改完代码要切回 IDEA 点运行，数据生成完了要自己 `git diff` 看产物变了什么。这个插件把这两件事都搬进 DSH：

- 聊天窗口**右上角多出一组 run\* 按钮**，长得和 IDEA 的运行按钮一个习惯——不用切窗口，点一下就跑；
- 模型**自己也能起任务**，跑完 `runData` 会**自动把产物 diff 摆到你面前**，跑了 `runClient` 如果崩了会**把崩溃报告摘要递过来**。

对任意 Gradle 的 MC 项目都能用：Forge、NeoForge、Fabric Loom、Architectury，单模块、多模块 monorepo 都行。不绑定某个仓库。

---

## 它长什么样

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ◀ 会话     ▣ CTNH-Core - Client ▾  ▶  ■  ⋮   ▶ 1:24  │  ← 右上角，排在所有控件最左边
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

版式照着 IDEA 的运行工具条来：

| 控件 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **▣ Client ▾** | 运行配置选择器。列出这个项目里所有 run\* 任务（多模块项目会带 `模块 - 类型` 名字），也可以在这里从 Gradle 刷新任务清单 |
| **▶ 绿键** | 跑当前选中的配置。**跑过一次就变成循环箭头 ⟳**，表示再点是"重新运行"；取消过一次则退回三角 |
| **■ 红键** | 停止。**真的停干净**——连 Gradle daemon 拉起的游戏进程一起带走 |
| **⋮** | 更多操作：重开日志面板、从 Gradle 刷新任务列表、看项目根与来源 |
| **▶ 1:24** | 有任务时贴一行状态：运行中（带耗时）/ 完成 / 失败 / 已取消 |

按钮**只在认出这是个 MC 项目时才出现**。打开一个普通的 Java 库、或压根不是 Gradle 的目录，界面上什么都不会多——不会有一排点不动的假按钮。

点绿键之后，右侧栏会**自动开一个日志页签**，输出实时滚进来；同一个会话始终复用一个页签，不会越跑越多。

### 为什么停止按钮值得单说

默认的 `gradlew runClient` 会把构建交给一个**长命 Gradle daemon**，而 daemon 随后会被系统重新挂到别的父进程下。结果是：游戏进程**根本不在你启动的那个进程树里**，`taskkill /T` 够不到它，你点了关闭，游戏窗口还留在那儿。

这个插件默认加 `--no-daemon`，让整条链（wrapper → java → 游戏）都在自己的进程树内，关闭就是真关闭。实测对比（同一套项目，只差这一个参数）：

| | 游戏在进程树内 | 点关闭后游戏还活着 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 默认 | ❌ | **是** |
| `--no-daemon` | ✅ | 否 |

代价是每次冷启动一个 JVM——对本来就要跑几十秒的 MC 项目来说可以忽略。想换回去就改 `daemonMode`。

---

## 装

需要 DeepSeek Harness（desktop profile）与一个能跑的 Gradle MC 项目。

打开 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，在「包名或地址」输入框里粘贴仓库地址：

```
https://github.com/mmyddd/dsh-mc-gradle-runner
```

点安装即可。装好之后：

- 会话头部右上角出现 run* 按钮（只在真正的 MC 项目里出现）；
- 设置 →「插件配置」→ `dsh-mc-gradle-runner` 里出现本插件的开关。

升级同样在插件管理里操作，重新拉一次这个地址就行。

> 开发时想让改源码立刻生效，就把插件目录换成 junction 指到本地仓库，
> 别用 pnpm 的 `file:` 依赖——它会**拷贝**一份，之后你改的代码不会同步，
> 会被"明明改了却没生效"坑很久（这个坑我踩过）。

---

## 用

### 手动：点按钮

打开任意会话，右上角就有。第一次点 `Client` 之前的探测要几百毫秒。

### 右侧栏的实时日志

点绿键就会自动把右侧栏的日志页签打开，`gradlew` 的输出边跑边进。它不只是"看"：

- **运行中自动跟随**（你手动往上滚就不抢你的滚动条）；
- **彩色分档**：普通构建输出、失败行、Gradle 的进度噪声视觉上能分开；
- 跑完把 `runData` 的产物 diff、`runClient` 的崩溃摘要直接贴在日志下面；
- 底部有**命令输入框**，`runClient` 和 `runServer` 都能用。

**命令怎么进游戏——分两段。** 第一段是把面板的管道接到游戏进程：Gradle 的 `JavaExec` 默认**不转发标准输入**，插件启动时用 `-I` 注入自带的初始化脚本（`lib/stdin-init.gradle`），给所有 `JavaExec` 接上 `standardInput = System.in`。不改你的构建脚本，任何 MC 项目都能用，关掉 `forwardStdin` 就退化成纯日志。

第二段才是关键：**光转发没用，客户端根本不读 stdin**。Minecraft 1.20.1 源码里全库只有 `DedicatedServer` 一处读 `System.in`（服务端控制台线程，Forge 再套一层 JLine 的 `TerminalHandler`）；`net/minecraft/client/**` 下**没有任何一处**读 stdin——字节到了游戏 JVM 也会原地消失。所以插件在 `runClient` 上再挂一个 `-javaagent`（`lib/console-bridge/`），由它在游戏 JVM 里补上缺失的读线程：

- 以 `/` 开头 → `ClientPacketListener.sendCommand`（如 `/time set day`）
- 其余 → `sendChat`（发一条聊天消息）
- 全程只用反射、不 import 任何 Minecraft 类，因此不绑定 MC 版本与映射（Mojmap / SRG 名字都认）；类从 `Instrumentation.getAllLoadedClasses()` 里找，能跨 NeoForge 的转换类加载器
- 游戏还没启动完就敲了命令不会丢——桥会等客户端实例，先排队的命令随后执行

执行回执打在日志里，形如 `[mc-console] 已交给客户端：time set day` / `[mc-console] 尚未进入世界，命令无处执行`。看到回执才代表真的进了游戏。

> 这条链路依赖 `--no-daemon`：长命 daemon 的 `System.in` 不是我们这条管道。
> 所以把 `daemonMode` 改成 `daemon` 之后，命令输入框基本就没用了。

**服务端不挂桥**：`runServer` 本来就有 JLine 在读同一个 stdin，再挂一个读者只会两边抢行、命令随机丢一半。

**桥的 jar 是随插件发布的**（`lib/console-bridge/mc-console-bridge.jar`，约 6 KB）。万一你的安装里缺了它，输入框会被明确禁用并提示怎么补，而不是敲完回车弹一句"已发送"、实际什么都没发生。自己编译：`node lib/console-bridge/build.mjs`（需要 JDK 17+，会自动找 `JAVA_HOME` 或 PATH 里的 `javac`）。

### 让模型来：`mc_run_*` 工具

```
你：帮我把数据重新生成一下，看看产物变了什么
```

模型会调 `mc_run_task { kind: "data" }`，后台跑，跑完自动拿到 diff——**而且它看到的就是你能看到的那张 diff 卡片**。

五个工具：

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mc_run_task` | 起任务。`kind` 可以是 `client` / `data` / `server`，也可以直接给完整任务名如 `:modules:CTPP:runClient` |
| `mc_run_output` | 读输出。`wait: true` 就阻塞等它跑完 |
| `mc_run_list` | 现在有哪些任务在跑 |
| `mc_run_kill` | 停掉 |
| `mc_send_command` | 往正在跑的游戏里发一行：`/` 开头按命令执行（如 `/time set day`），其余按聊天发送 |

`mc_send_command` 是日志面板底部那个输入框的模型侧等价物，所以它同样只对 `runClient` / `runServer` 成立。它写完会短暂等一等游戏侧的回执并一起返回；没等到回执时它只会说"还没确认"，不会替你断言命令生效了——原因见上面那段"命令怎么进游戏"。

**工作区确实是可运行的 MC 项目时**（判定与"是否显示按钮"完全同一套：有 Gradle 构建脚本且发现了 `run*` 任务），插件还会往系统提示词里加一小段，告诉模型这几个工具怎么配合、以及"发送成功 ≠ 执行成功"。工作区不对时那段话不会出现，模型也就不会去调注定失败的工具。

任务全程在后台，**不阻塞前台**——你在它跑的时候还能继续聊。

**不想让模型碰这些？** 在设置里把「向模型暴露工具」关掉，按钮照常能用。

### `runData` 之后你会看到什么

不是干巴巴一句"文件变了"，而是三层：

1. **总量** —— 新增 3、修改 7、删除 1
2. **按类目分组** —— `lang` / `recipes` / `tags` / `models` / `loot` …… 一眼看出这次动的是哪块
3. **逐个文件** —— 带**真实增删行数**（`+4/-2`）和实际改动内容，不是笼统的行数对比

底下还垫了一条 `git status` 补充来源，产物目录之外的手改文件也不会漏。

### `runClient` 崩了

不用去翻日志。插件会认出崩溃报告，把**路径 + 描述 + 异常 + 栈顶 + 可疑 mod** 一起交出来。模型直接就能开始分析，而不是对着"退出码 1"发呆。

---

## 认路径这件事

多模块 MC 项目里"哪个才是可运行的目标"经常没那么显然。插件的发现来源**按可信度分级**：

```
Gradle 自己报的任务清单  >  IDEA 运行配置(.run/)  >  IDEA 项目结构(.idea/)  >  自己解析 settings.gradle
```

不硬编码任何路径。它读你项目里已有的 `gradlew` / `settings.gradle` / `.idea` / `.run`，所以不管你是上百个子模块的大整合包，还是自己写的小模组，都能自己找对地方。

顺带一个实际遇到过的问题：有些项目里子模块**自带一份只声明 `pluginManagement` 的 `settings.gradle`**，朴素的"往上找最近的 settings.gradle"会停在那儿、把任务名的 `:modules:XXX:` 前缀丢掉。这里改用**打分**（有 wrapper、settings 里有 `include`、有 build 脚本）再取分最高且最靠上的那个目录，就不会被带偏。

---

## 设置

在 **设置 → 插件配置 → dsh-mc-gradle-runner** 里改，改完即时生效，不用重启。

最常用的几个：

| 开关 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启用插件 | 开 | 总闸。关掉后按钮和工具都不出现 |
| 显示快捷按钮 | 开 | 右上角那组 run\* 按钮 |
| 向模型暴露工具 | 开 | 关掉后模型看不到 `mc_run_*`，按钮照常 |
| Gradle daemon | `no-daemon` | 改成 `daemon` 启动更快，但关闭按钮会留下游戏进程 |
| 同名任务策略 | `reject` | 已在跑同名任务时：拒绝 / 复用 / 替换 / 允许并存 |
| Gradle 根目录 | 自动 | 需要时手动指定 |
| 每个 diff 展示的行数 | 40 | 嫌 diff 太长就调小 |

<details>
<summary>全部 20 个配置项</summary>

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `showButtons` | `true` | 是否显示快捷按钮 |
| `exposeTools` | `true` | 是否把工具暴露给模型 |
| `enabledTools` | 全部 | 只暴露列出的工具 |
| `gradleRoot` | 自动发现 | 强制指定 Gradle 根 |
| `daemonMode` | `no-daemon` | `no-daemon` / `daemon` |
| `duplicatePolicy` | `reject` | 同名任务并发策略 |
| `allowGradleTaskQuery` | `true` | 允许从菜单触发 `gradlew tasks`（一次约 7–9 秒，会缓存） |
| `dataDirs` | 内置四路径 | 产物目录覆盖 |
| `maxDiffFiles` | `40` | diff 最多展开的文件数 |
| `diffHunkLines` | `40` | 每个文件展示多少行改动 |
| `diffMaxBytes` | `524288` | 单文件参与 diff 的字节上限 |
| `snapshotTextBudgetBytes` | `67108864` | 快照保留旧内容的累计上限（64 MB） |
| `outputLimitBytes` | `4194304` | 单任务内存输出上限 |
| `dataTimeoutMs` | `120000` | runData 后收集 diff 的等待上限 |
| `taskQueryCacheMs` | `300000` | 任务清单缓存时长 |
| `taskQueryTimeoutMs` | `180000` | 任务清单查询超时 |
| `gitBin` | `git` | git 可执行文件 |
| `forwardStdin` | `true` | 用 `-I` 注入脚本把 stdin 转发给游戏 JVM；关掉则控制台命令到不了游戏（输入框会明确禁用并说明是这个开关） |
| `buttonOrder` | `-100` | 按钮排序，越小越靠左 |

</details>

---

## 出问题的时候

| 现象 | 大概是什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 右上角没有按钮 | 当前会话的工作目录不在 MC 项目里。或插件被总闸关了 |
| 按钮在、点了没反应 | 多半是 wrapper 找不到——结果里会说明，并提示 PATH 上的 `gradle` |
| 右侧栏没有日志页签 | 页签在**点绿键之后**才创建；也可以从 `⋮` 菜单里手动「打开日志面板」 |
| 命令输进去了游戏没反应 | `forwardStdin` 被关了，或 `daemonMode` 改成了 `daemon`；也可能是项目自己覆盖了 `standardInput` |
| 关了任务游戏还在 | 检查 `daemonMode` 是不是被改成了 `daemon` |
| `runData` 说"没有产物变更" | 数据生成结果真的和启动前一致。也可能产物目录不在默认四个路径里，用 `dataDirs` 指定 |
| 崩了但没给报告 | 插件只认"新写出来的"报告——目录里堆着的历史崩溃不会被翻出来当成本次的 |
| 任务在跑，又点了一次 | 默认拒绝并告诉你已有的任务 id，改 `duplicatePolicy` 可换行为 |
| 改了插件源码没生效 | 装的是拷贝而不是 junction。见上面安装说明 |

---

## 开发

```powershell
cd C:\Git\dsh-mc-gradle-runner
node test/run-all.mjs          # 全部用例
node test/run-all.mjs client   # 只跑名字含 "client" 的
```

用例在 `test/`，每个文件独立进程跑，互不影响。包含几条真跑 Gradle 的端到端链路：造一个真会崩的 `runClient` 验证崩溃摘要、造一个真改文件的 `runData` 验证 diff 内容正确性、造一条父子进程链验证关闭按钮能把孙子进程也带走。

`test/test-discovery.mjs`、`test-gradle-e2e.mjs`、`test-gradle-paths.mjs` 需要一个**真实的** MC 项目才跑得起来，没给路径时打印 `SKIP` 跳过（这是设计如此，不是失败）：

```powershell
node test/test-discovery.mjs C:\path\to\your\mc\project
# 或设环境变量，三个脚本都会用
$env:MC_TEST_PROJECT = 'C:\path\to\your\mc\project'
node test/run-all.mjs
```

源码在 `lib/`：`index.js`（主机半身：工具 + API 路由）、`client.js`（浏览器半身：工具栏 + 日志页签 + 设置页）、`discovery.js`（项目与目标发现）、`proc.js`（进程与任务注册表）、`diff.js`（产物快照与 diff）、`crash.js`（崩溃报告识别）、`bridge.js`（控制台桥的定位与"这个任务能不能发命令"的判定）、`command.js`（发送命令：选哪个任务写、回执归谁）、`guidance.js`（提示词里那段 MC 工具说明的文案）、`prompt.js`（把那段说明挂进系统提示词，带按 cwd 的短缓存）、`stdin-init.gradle`（注入给 JavaExec 的 stdin 转发 + javaagent 挂载脚本）、`console-bridge/`（游戏 JVM 里的读 stdin 代理：`ConsoleBridge.java` 源码、`build.mjs` 编

plugins.description: DSH output style plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-style · Codex style

[English](README.md) | [中文](docs/zh.md)

An independent, optional DeepSeek Harness output-style plugin targeting desktop **0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2**. It does not modify DSH, Butler, or Aqua source code, and starts no service or resident process.

`engines.dsh` and the optional peer `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` both declare exactly `0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.2`. The optional peer describes the host without installing another DSH runtime; it does not claim support for later prereleases. Recheck Client Slots and the `systemPrompt` service after upgrading DSH; local tests do not replace live App acceptance.

## Features and boundaries

- **Answer wording:** conclusions first, concise delivery, real verification, and explicit disclosure of checks not run. The prompt is a presentation preference, not a change to tools, permissions, or execution rules; identical behavior across all models is not guaranteed.
- **Progress display:** reuses native work-step grouping and collapsing, with elapsed time derived from original `turn/start` / `turn/end` timestamps. Failed and stopped turns cannot be collapsed as a whole. DSH still renders final answers, approvals, errors, and attachments.
- **File changes:** fully preserves DSH's native change cards, expanded lists, and Diff interactions. It registers no turn-tail card, hides no native cards, fetches or caches no separate change data, and adds no undo feature.
- **Theme compatibility:** adjusts only chat answer text and its own progress headings; it does not override Aqua layout, glass effects, or theme tokens.

## Install and build

```sh
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
```

The package and repository are named `dsh-codex-style`, with repository metadata `https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-codex-style` and local directory `<workspace>/MySpace/dsh-plugins/dsh-codex-style`. Cordis component IDs `codex-style` / `codex-style-prompt`, settings component IDs, existing browser preference keys, and the prompt section ID remain unchanged. The client loader and style ownership use the new package name.

The npm allowlist includes the patch, Host/prompt entry points, built client, and English/Chinese READMEs; it excludes tests, dependency directories, browser snapshots, and logs. Source retains the MySpace root repository's Zlib license; see `LICENSE` for a copy. Dependencies retain their respective licenses.

Add this directory's absolute path in the **desktop profile** plugin manager, or install the local directory through the Agent's `plugin_manager`. Build artifacts live in the ignored `lib/` directory, so build before installing. The current setup uses a local link installation; do not move the source directory arbitrarily.

Refresh the current DSH window after installation or updates. This standalone plugin has no development watcher: rebuild and refresh after changing client source; refresh-free updates are not promised. There is no need to start another Web server.

Under **Settings → General settings**, the recommended setting for “Work-step display” and “Performance and usage” is “Compact”. The plugin does not override these host preferences; you can switch back to detailed display at any time. Persisted desktop preferences may take precedence over profile defaults.

## Disabling and scope

- **Disable only the UI:** Settings → General settings → **Codex 风格** (Codex style). This immediately removes the plugin's CSS and progress headings and restores native rendering; native file-change cards are always preserved. The switch is stored per browser origin and does not change the model prompt or native work-step preferences.
- **Disable only wording preferences:** disable `codex-style-prompt` (module `dsh-codex-style/prompt`) in plugin management.
- **Disable everything:** disable the entire `dsh-codex-style` bundle in plugin management.

By default the prompt is added globally to the current profile, and the UI applies to that profile's sessions. No Agent presets are created or changed, and the default model is unchanged. To apply wording preferences to only one preset, disable the global `codex-style-prompt` and declare `dsh-codex-style/prompt` in that preset's `plugins`. The UI switch is not a preset switch.

## Style lifecycle and verification

DSH's Client module loader attributes unmarked `style` tags to the module materialized next and removes them when that module unloads. This is not a shared general-purpose style layer: this plugin writes `data-plugin` and `data-plugin-css` **before** inserting its styles into the DOM, and removes only its own style tags. Progress arrows declare both SVG dimensions and inline dimensions to prevent unbounded enlargement when CSS is missing.

Each `npm test` first rebuilds the real client bundle, then verifies: no registration or hiding of native change cards; style ownership before insertion; no accidental deletion when simulating another module claiming/unloading styles; repeated toggling and unload lifecycle; error/stop boundaries; real timing; and bounded SVGs.

A previous session in the existing host at `http://127.0.0.1:19387` verified zero custom-drawn cards, visible native cards retaining all 24 records when expanded, and native file buttons opening the sidebar Diff. After simulating the loader claiming/unloading other styles, this plugin still owned its styles, with zero console or Slot errors. This is a historical acceptance record, not a claim that the current installation has been revalidated.

Real-browser acceptance and Happy DOM component tests are reported separately. The first browser check of the historical custom-card implementation did not cover later loading/unloading of other plugins and could not establish long-term style reliability; that implementation has been removed. DSH owns native change-card data scope, lifetime, and Diff behavior; this plugin does not reinterpret or rebuild them.

## Layout

- `src/prompt.mjs`: independently removable wording preferences.
- `src/host.mjs`: empty Host entry for client discovery.
- `src/client.jsx`: progress headings, settings switch, and style lifecycle.
- `src/model.mjs`: actual elapsed time and progress state.
- `src/style.css`: scoped CSS for answer text and progress headings.

Compatibility is pinned to the DSH version above. After upgrading DSH, read its actual Slot and service contracts and repeat acceptance checks; do not force execution through a version exemption.

# dsh-settings-arranger

**English** | [中文](#中文) --- ## 中文 设置页左侧那一列分区导航，插件装多了就变成一长条：顺序由各插件注册时写死、不能改，官方分区和一堆插件分区混在一起。这个插件给它加上**拖拽排序**和**自定义分组**，排布按浏览器保存，刷新不丢。 ### 功能 - **拖拽排序**：任意分区条目拖到任意位置，分组与普通条目混排也行。 - **分组**：把相关分区收进一个组（比如把「追问 / 通知 / 喵记忆」收成「系统增强」），点组头展开。 - **组内排序 / 跨组移动 / 拖出一级**：整理模式下组内条目同样能拖，可拖进别的组，也可拖回一级。 - **新建 / 重命名 / 删除分组**，同名会就地报错。 - **恢复默认**：一键清空排布，回到原生顺序（二次确认）。 - **两套视图**：平时收起成组头、点开是下拉菜单；点「整理导航」进整理模式，组内条目全部内联铺开，方便拖。 ### 效果图 日常使用：分组收起成一行，点开是带图标的浮动下拉菜单。 ![设置页导航：三个分组（模型提供 / 样式插件 / 系统增强）收起成一行，点开的「系统增强」下拉里列出追问、通知、喵记忆、bili 设置、备份与迁移、提示词优化设置、dsh-git-idea 配置，每项带原图标](assets/normal-mode.png) 整理模式：点右上角「整理导航」，组内条目全部铺开，可直接拖动排序。 ![整理模式：分组展开为小标题样式、成员条目内联缩进、行尾有 ⋮⋮ 拖拽把手与重命名/删除按钮，底部是「＋ 新建分组」与「恢复默认」](assets/edit-mode.png) ### 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-settings-arranger ``` 装完刷新 Web GUI（或重启 dsh），bundle 会随包里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动注册。 > 用 GitHub 源安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-settings-arranger` ### 用法 1. 打开 **设置**，点右上角的 **整理导航**。 2. 点 **＋ 新建分组** 起个名字。 3. 把条目拖进组里，或把分组头拖到别的位置；组内条目可以再拖去别的组，或拖出一级。 4. 点 **完成** 退出整理模式，点分组头就能展开下拉菜单。 排布存在浏览器的 localStorage 里（键 `dsh.settings-arranger.v1`），**按浏览器与站点隔离**，换浏览器或换端口要重新整理。 ### 兼容 - dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` 实测通过。 - 纯客户端插件，只操作 DOM，不改任何其它插件的代码；同名的分区顺序仍由各插件自己的 `order` 决定，本插件只是在渲染后再重排。 ### 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) --- ## English The settings dialog's left nav grows into an unmanageable list once you install a few plugins: order is baked in at registration time and official sections sit interleaved with plugin ones. This plugin adds **drag-to-reorder** and **custom groups**, persisted per browser. ### Features - **Drag to reorder** any section, mixing groups and plain rows freely. - **Groups**: collect related sections into one group (e.g. put "Follow-up / Notifications / Meow Memory" under "System"). Click the group head to expand. - **Reorder inside a group, move across groups, drag back out** — all available in arrange mode. - **Create / rename / delete groups**, with inline duplicate-name validation. - **Reset to default** — clears the layout and returns the native order (with confirmation). - **Two views**: normal mode collapses groups into heads with a floating dropdown; clicking **整理导航 (Arrange)** switches to edit mode where every member is laid out inline for dragging. ### Screenshots Normal mode — groups collapse into a single row; clicking one opens an icon-carrying dropdown. ![Settings nav: three groups collapsed into one row; the "系统增强" dropdown lists its members with their original icons](assets/normal-mode.png) Arrange mode — click "整理导航" in the top-right corner; all members expand inline and can be dragged. ![Arrange mode: groups become compact section headers, members are indented inline with drag handles and rename/delete buttons, and the footer holds "+ New group" and "Reset to default"](assets/edit-mode.png) ### Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-settings-arranger ``` Refresh the Web GUI (or restart dsh); the bundle registers itself through the shipped `cordis.patch.yml`. > From GitHub: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-settings-arranger` ### Usage 1. Open **Settings** and click **整理导航** in the top-right corner. 2. Click **＋ 新建分组** and name the group. 3. Drag entries into it, or drag the group head elsewhere; drag members across groups or back to the top level. 4. Click **完成 (Done)** to leave arrange mode, then click a group head to open its dropdown. The layout lives in the browser's localStorage (key `dsh.settings-arranger.v1`), so it is **per browser and per origin** — a different browser or port starts fresh. ### Compatibility - Tested with dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`. - Pure client-side: it only touches the DOM and never modifies other plugins' code. Section order is still declared by each plugin; this plugin simply re-lays-out the rendered nav. ### License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-search

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that searches the
**content** of every session — not just session titles — and orders hits by the **time of the
matched record**, newest first.

It adds a first-class search destination to the sidebar (a panel icon beside *Plugins* and
*Schedules*, plus a full-width results page) and a `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F` shortcut. Clicking a hit
opens its session.

```
┌─ sidebar ─┐  ┌─ main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Plugins  │  │  Search session content                                    │
│ ▸ Search  │  │  [ 会话                                            ]        │
│  Schedules│  │  All · My prompts · Replies · Tool output   ☐ subagents    │
│           │  │  43 hits · 8 sessions · 4 ms                               │
│           │  │ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│           │  │ 2026-09-11 01:55   user   修改 FreeCAD MCP 服务端口         │
│           │  │   我在使用这个 mcp 服务[插件]，但是端口被占用了…            │
└───────────┘  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Why this plugin exists

Stock DSH can already *search* sessions — the sidebar search box is wired to a real
content-search pipeline:

```
WorkspaceBrowser → sessions.search(query) → ctx.remote.session.search
  → SessionController.search → ctx.sessionQuery.searchSessions(…)
```

It only ever finds titles because **three independent things** are true at once:

| # | Fact | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The content backend is **switched off** in the stock profile — `openAt: never`. The shipped comment says it plainly: *"the Web sidebar search matches titles and workspace names only."* | the `session-query-sqlite` row in `dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml` |
| 2 | That backend tokenizes with FTS5 `unicode61`, which treats **an entire CJK run as a single token**. Measured on a real machine: `光速太慢，星际文明无法成为整体` yields exactly two tokens, `光速太慢` and `星际文明无法成为整体` — so `MATCH '光速'` and `MATCH '星际'` both **return nothing**. The `trigram` tokenizer is no help either: it rejects 2-character queries. | verified locally against SQLite 3.53.4 |
| 3 | Even with the backend enabled, the wire shape is `{ items: [{ sessionId, snippet }] }` — **each hit's `time` is dropped at that layer**, and ranking is relevance-first (`time` is only a tie-breaker). | `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` |

So "order results by content time" is **not achievable through any shipped public remote**, and
for CJK content the shipped engine is the wrong tool regardless. This plugin therefore builds its
own index on the host: it incrementally parses every session transcript, keeps each record's text
together with **that record's own `time`**, matches by substring (correct for both CJK and Latin
text), and sorts by time. It needs **no profile configuration changes**.

---

## Where the search entry lives — and why

DSH's Web/desktop UI has **no global top bar** and **no global command palette** (`/` commands are
the composer's slash menu and are bound to the current session). Only three global seats are
available:

| Seat | Verdict |
|---|---|
| **`sidebar.panellist` icon + its matching `main` panel** | ✅ **Used here.** This is DSH's first-class "global panel" mechanism: the sidebar owns the button, the label and the selected state, and the list `id` maps directly to the `main` panel `key`. The shipped **Plugins** (order 0) and **Schedules** (order 10) panels work exactly this way; this plugin slots in between at order 5. `replaceRisk: none` — it cannot be clobbered by an upgrade. |
| `sidebar.footer.action` (next to Settings) + a `shell.overlay` dialog | ⭕ Viable alternative, better suited to a "spotlight" quick-search. Costs you hand-built overlay, focus and Escape handling, and leaves little room for snippets. |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (where the existing search box lives) | ❌ **Not used.** It is a `single` seat occupied wholesale by `ui-workspace`, with `replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui` — taking it means replacing the entire shipped session browser and breaking on the next DSH release. |

A **`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`** shortcut (registered through `dsh-client-shortcuts`) selects the panel from
anywhere. It is bound on the **desktop profiles only** on purpose: on the Web profiles the shipped
`session.fork` (`dsh-client-ui-workspace`) already owns `KeyF + primary+shift`, and the shortcut
registry validates a definition's defaults across every *declared* profile, throwing
`Conflicting shortcut defaults` from whichever plugin registers second. See
[Compatibility](#compatibility) for what that cost once.

For **searching inside the session you are reading**, the entry point is the `list` seat
`conversation.session.header.utilities` — the right-aligned action row of the conversation header.
It is additive (`replaceRisk: none`, ids `open-in-app` / `schedule-catalog` /
`session-log-download` already sit there), always in reach, and needs no new global chrome. The
find bar and the result dialog share one `shell.overlay` entry — the frame-wide layer documented as
"the additive seat for a frame-wide surface of your own" — so they float above every column without
stealing one.

---

## Install

This package is a standard DSH **bundle** (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` in its manifest).
Install it with the plugin manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target="<absolute path to this repo>"
```

That writes the package into the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` and links it
into the profile's `node_modules`. You do **not** need to hand-edit the profile's `package.json` or
`cordis.patch.yml`.

Disable or remove it again:

```
plugin_manager action=set_bundle    target=dsh-session-search enabled=false
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-session-search
```

### Mounting it manually instead

Add a row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (the `name` may be a bare package specifier, a
path relative to the patch file, or an absolute path):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-search
      name: 'dsh-session-search'
```

> **A note on reloading.** The Harness loads plugin rows through Node's ESM loader, which caches
> both the resolved package entry and the module itself for the lifetime of the Host process.
> Re-enabling a row that previously failed re-runs the *cached* module, so a fix on disk is not
> observed until the app restarts — `dsh-hmr` can activate a **new** row, but it cannot swap a
> JavaScript module generation for an already-loaded package. `lib/entry.js` exists to work around
> this during development: it re-imports `lib/host.js` behind an mtime-keyed query, so host-side
> edits take effect on the next activation. In normal use it is simply the entry point.

---

## Usage

### Global search

1. Click the magnifier icon in the sidebar (between *Plugins* and *Schedules*), or press
   `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`.
2. Type a query. Matching is **substring**, case-insensitive, and works for CJK (a 2-character
   query matches inside a longer run, which the shipped FTS5 engine cannot do).
3. Narrow the results with the chips — *All* / *My prompts* / *Replies* / *Tool output* — and the
   *Include subagent sessions* toggle (off by default; subagent sessions routinely outnumber your
   own). The **session scope picker** at the top lists only the sessions that actually matched the
   current query, with hit counts (`title (12)`), so scoping to one of them is one click; with no
   query it lists recent sessions.
4. Click any hit to open it **with its context**: the matched record plus four records before and
   after, the match highlighted and untruncated. Use previous/next to move between hits, and
   *Open session* to jump to the session itself.

### Find in the conversation (Ctrl/Cmd+F)

Press `Ctrl/Cmd+F`, or click the magnifier in the conversation header's right-aligned utilities.
A small floating bar appears, searches the transcript, paints **every match** and scrolls the
active one into view:

- `Enter` / `Shift+Enter`, or `‹ ›`, cycle matches; `Esc` closes and clears the highlights.
- The match counter s

# dsh-sync

DSH 跨设备同步插件。通过**使用者自己的私有 HTTPS Git 仓库或 SFTP 服务器**同步会话、附件、配置及选定工程，支持在线安全范围应用、离线恢复及经确认的插件升级。

- 当前版本：**0.6.0**；许可证：MIT。
- 公开源码／安装包：https://github.com/vxdeus/dsh-sync
- 公开软件与私人备份完全分开：发布包不含作者的同步仓库、服务器连接信息、账号、密钥、令牌、会话、附件或工程数据。
- 首次安装没有预配置远端。安装、启动及打开面板不自动上传或下载；已有本机配置不会被安装初始化覆盖。

## 环境与安装

需要带插件管理器的 DeepSeek Harness，运行时 Node.js **24 或更高版本**。SFTP 另需本机可用的 OpenSSH `ssh` / `sftp`。在线应用及插件升级取决于宿主提供的接口；不可用时明确禁用，不会绕过授权或降级为直接覆盖会话文件。

在 DSH 插件管理器中安装 GitHub Release 的 `dsh-sync.tgz` 或带版本号安装包，并核对同一 Release 的 `SHA256SUMS`。随后**完全退出并重新打开 DSH**，再刷新原有网页。仅刷新网页不能保证更新宿主插件的模块缓存。

入口：**设置 → 跨机同步**，或侧边栏底部的**同步**。

## 配置自己的存储

配置文件位于当前 `DSH_HOME` 下的 `dsh-sync.json`；未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为用户目录下的 `.dsh/dsh-sync.json`。它只留在本机，不进入同步快照。请在本机编辑，勿将真实配置提交到公开源码仓库或贴入聊天。

### 私有 HTTPS Git

新建仅自己／授权协作者可访问的私有数据仓库，使用独立同步分支。下面仅是**不可连接的占位示例**，请替换仓库和账号：

```json
{
  "backend": "gitee",
  "repoUrl": "https://git.example.invalid/your-account/private-sync.git",
  "branch": "dsh-sync",
  "username": "your-account",
  "token": "",
  "privateRepoConfirmed": false,
  "profiles": ["desktop"],
  "includeAttachments": true,
  "maxExtraBytes": 209715200,
  "extras": []
}
```

`gitee` 是保留的 Git 后端配置名，界面也沿用 Gitee 标签。Git 传输使用 HTTPS 用户名／令牌认证；不同提供商的兼容性和权限要求需自行验证。

令牌可只设置在本机环境变量 `DSH_SYNC_TOKEN`，或写入本机配置的 `token` 字段。使用最小必要仓库权限，不把凭据嵌入 URL。**亲自确认数据仓库为私有后**才将 `privateRepoConfirmed` 改为 `true`；这是本机确认声明，插件不会自动查询或更改远端可见性。

**不得将本项目的公开源码仓库作为个人同步目标。** 插件会拒绝此目标。切换仓库、分支或账号会隔离 Git 工作副本；更换旧设备配置后建议先下载核对，不强制推送覆盖远端。

### 自己的 SFTP 服务器

不提供托管服务器、共享账号、预置主机公钥或私钥。每台设备自行生成／保管密钥，并由服务器管理员授权设备公钥。在本机配置：

- `backend`：`sftp`。
- `sftp.host`：自己的服务器域名或地址；`port`：SSH 端口。
- `sftp.username`：自己获授权的服务器用户。
- `sftp.remoteRoot`：安全的 `/data/` 子目录，例如 `/data/my-sync`；须按服务器 **SFTP 可见路径**配置。
- `sftp.privateKeyPath`：本机私钥绝对路径，私钥不经过网页、不进入同步。
- `sftp.hostKey`：通过可信独立渠道核对的完整 `ssh-ed25519` 服务器公钥。不要关闭主机身份校验，也不要盲目信任首次网络扫描结果。

密钥需可用于非交互式 OpenSSH 认证。账户、密钥和目录访问权限由使用者管理。Git 和 SFTP 备份相互独立；切换存储不会搬运或删除旧备份。面板保存存储选择不会自动传输。

## 日常使用

### 源设备上传

1. 先检查状态与同步范围。工程／额外文件须手动添加自定义映射，例如逻辑名 `my-project`。
2. 可执行**本地预演**：它会扫描并暂存本机数据；已配置 Git 时还可能创建本地提交，**不是只读检查**，但不推送或访问远端。
3. 明确确认后上传。仅当显示远端回读／哈希核验成功时，才视为备份成功。超时后可能显示待确认，不自动重复推送。
4. 同一时刻只在一台设备编辑。不是实时双向同步，也不自动合并两台设备的分叉历史。

### 目标设备下载与恢复

1. 安装兼容版本插件，并配置自己的仓库凭据或 SFTP 授权。各设备按**相同逻辑名**映射工程，本机目标路径可以不同。
2. 默认在线模式只应用宿主允许的安全范围：冷历史通过原生接口导入；已加载、分叉、格式不支持的会话及忙碌工程保留，运行时配置等推迟应用。查看未应用项，不能将部分应用当成全量成功。
3. **仅下载／离线恢复**只产生暂存计划，不覆盖现有会话或工程。检查结果后完全退出 DSH，再运行该结果给出的恢复命令。需可运行 Node.js 24+；不要在另一台机器复用生成的本机恢复脚本。
4. 恢复核对源哈希及下载时的目标基线，覆盖前验证备份；冲突时停止，不自动改权限。内容相同的只读附件保持原样。失败计划不可重跑，先检查日志并重新下载。
5. 恢复中失败会尝试回滚，仍可能出现需人工处理的不完整回滚。请保留日志和备份；本插件不替代独立备份。

离线计划会记录本次宿主端口并检测监听，但仍须自行确认**所有相关 DSH 进程已退出**。不提供自动关机、自动关闭 DSH、配套桌面宿主补丁或一键授权新设备的功能。

下载尚未完整应用时会阻止后续上传，避免用旧本机快照覆盖远端。不要轻易勾选覆盖未应用远端内容；只有核对并明确接受丢弃风险后才能使用此选项。

### 跨设备插件升级

快照可携带已安装插件的精确版本、支持的本地安装包和升级说明。目标设备下载后仅检测差异；**用户选中具体插件并再次确认后**才交给宿主插件管理器安装。模型调用另需本次插件管理授权。

不自动批准依赖构建脚本，不自动降级，不自动重启。远端说明及本地插件包都属于不受信任输入，请先核对来源；安装插件意味着允许代码在宿主环境执行。若返回待重启，由使用者手动重启。安装后重新下载恢复计划，以免使用安装前的旧基线。

## 同步范围、隐私与限制

- 包含：指定 profile 的安装声明／锁文件、允许的会话与 `storages` / `state` 文件、`.agent-presets`、可选附件、已有 `dsh-pet` 配置和明确添加的自定义项。
- 不直接复制：`node_modules`、模型／OAuth 登录凭据、`integrations`、IM 聊天存储、运行时、缓存、同步配置、私钥和令牌。插件包按白名单另行归档，不直接归档 profile。
- 本机搜索覆盖诊断与额度预测缓存不跨机覆盖；真实费用账本与搜索用量日志仍在允许范围内。
- 默认排除工程依赖、Git 历史和构建产物。凭据路径过滤不能识别任意正文中的秘密。**会话、附件、插件配置、脚本和工程可能本来就包含隐私／密码；上传前自行审查。**
- 私人快照及默认 Git 提交可能记录设备主机名、系统用户名和配置账号，并非匿名同步。私有 Git / SSH 提供访问控制和传输保护，**不提供客户端端到端加密**。Git 历史可能保留已删除的内容；SFTP 历史快照和未引用对象暂不自动清理。
- 目录名及部分文本中的用户目录可做占位符转换；压缩历史内部路径和自定义工程内容不保证跨盘符自动修复。迁移后可能需重新定位工程。
- 单项自定义同步默认上限 200 MiB；缺失、超限或未映射项目可能阻止上传，避免静默丢失旧备份。
- IM 机器人历史不在同步范围内；同步 DSH 会话不等于两个 QQ 机器人自动续接话题。

## 模型工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_sync_status` | 只读检查配置、范围及插件升级提醒 |
| `dsh_sync_extras` | 添加／移除／查看本机工程映射，不传输 |
| `dsh_sync_upload` | 明确要求后上传；`dryRun: true` 本地预演 |
| `dsh_sync_download` | `mode: online` 安全在线范围；`mode: offline` 下载并生成离线计划 |
| `dsh_sync_update_plugins` | 仅安装用户明确确认的当前计划中所选插件 |

## 开发与发布

```sh
node scripts/test.mjs
node scripts/verify-public.mjs
node scripts/release.mjs
node scripts/smoke-package.mjs
```

隔离测试使用合成临时数据，不需要真实用户配置或访问真实仓库。Windows 的符号链接测试取决于系统权限；若沙箱重写 junction 元数据，必须在正常 Windows 环境复核，不能通过移除安全断言宣称测试通过。原生宿主集成测试需单独配备支持的 Host，默认不访问真实 profile。

打包使用 npm 标准格式及显式文件白名单，并核对归档成员、字节和 SHA256。不上传任何备份，不执行 `npm publish`，不自动创建 GitHub Release。公开发布步骤及市场提交见 `PUBLISHING.md`，版本说明见 `CHANGELOG.md`。

plugins.description: In-conversation workflow run timeline for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workflow-ui

[![CI](https://github.com/zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的对话内工作流运行时间线：把官方 `workflow` 工具卡与 `workflow-run` 聊天节点替换成横向时间线——轨道 + 阶段站 + 子代理药丸 + 循环弧线 + 并行带，且**开跑之前就能看到全部计划**。

English documentation in [README.en.md](README.en.md)。

![dsh-workflow-ui 截图](docs/screenshot.png)

窄窗口自动换行（同排弧 + ↩ 回边徽标）：

![dsh-workflow-ui 换行模式](docs/screenshot-wrap.png)

## 功能

- **对话内嵌卡片** — 每次 workflow 运行一张卡，长在对话流里，无需打开任何面板。
- **计划先行** — 客户端扫描 workflow 脚本（`phase()` 调用、`parallel()` 块、阶段回访），开跑前就渲染出全部计划站点、药丸占位与依赖弧线。
- **并行带** — `parallel()` 阶段渲染为抬升轨道，fork/merge 接头为圆角弧。
- **弧线** — 非相邻前向边与循环回边在轨道上空飞行：弧道按跨度分配（短跨低道、相交上推）、8px 圆角拐点、落地箭头；落入运行中站点的弧点亮为 march。宽屏画完整弧线；窄屏换行时只画同排弧，跨排回边由 `↩` 徽标承担。
- **药丸折叠** — 单站超过 5 个子代理自动折叠为「＋N」展开片；展开状态跨实时刷新保留；隐藏药丸里有运行中的会在折叠片上闪呼吸点。
- **药丸跳转子会话** — 点击药丸按 DSH 0.2.1 契约（`openSession({parentSessionId, childSessionId, mode})`，mode 传 `unknown` 由工作区自行解析）直达对应子会话；支持键盘聚焦与 Enter 触发。
- **自带 agent 预设** — 安装即向名册添加 `Workflow 编排` 预设（标准全量工具 + "多步任务主动用 workflow"的 persona 指引），卸载即移除。
- **DSH 官方图标** — StateDot 状态点（done/error = 6px 实心核，running = 中性 spinner 弧，pending = idle 点）、官方 ListPen 卡头图标、1px Check/Close 标记。
- **子代理药丸** — 逐 agent 状态 + 表情（运行中张望/眨眼），结算勾，未启动的计划占位。
- **主题与无障碍** — 经 DSH 别名 token 适配亮/暗主题，全链路尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`，状态字形带 `aria` 标签。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui
```

安装后重启一次 dsh（组合变更），再刷新页面。要求 DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.5`；已在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2` 实测，web profile。

装好后建议切换到自带的 **Workflow 编排** 预设（新会话选择器里），模型会对多步任务主动使用 workflow 编排。

## 原理

两个 keyed 槽位以 `priority: -1` 影子官方渲染器（官方默认 `0`，priority 最低者渲染；本组件崩溃会自动 abdicate 回退官方）：

- `conversation.chat.node` key `workflow-run` — 数据来自官方 Definition 对持久化事件（`tool-workflow/run-start|agent-start|agent-end|run-end`）的投影，本插件只换呈现。
- `tool.call.toolview` key `workflow` — 渲染不可见标记（该行经 CSS `:has` 隐藏，0.2.1 起连同 turn-process 流程头一并隐藏），并把工具入参的脚本元数据 stash 进模块 store，供运行卡做计划先行渲染。

样式以 `<style data-plugin>` 一次性注入、卸载时移除；类名全部 `zcf-` 前缀。颜色落在 14 个局部 `--color-*` token，映射到 DSH `--dsw-alias-*`。

## 开发

零依赖，Node >= 20。

```bash
npm run check     # 语法检查 + 单元测试 + 构建 + lib 检查 + 门面冒烟
npm run preview   # 生成 docs/preview/preview.html（亮/暗卡片）
```

无头截图预览：

```bash
chrome --headless=new --virtual-time-budget=3000 --screenshot=shot.png docs/preview/preview.html
```

布局常量参考 ZCode 的公开工作流呈现设计（站宽 168 / 间距 192 / 灯心 +17，弧基 26 / 道距 14，6–8px 圆角接头，120/160/200/320ms 运动 token）。状态点与图标复现 DSH 官方 `dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的形制（StateDot、ListPen、Check、Close）。本插件与 ZCode、DSH 官方均无隶属关系。

## 路线图

迭代方向与版本主题见 [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md)（下一版 v0.3.0：完成态折叠摘要 + 耗时/循环指标 + 失败复盘）。

## 边界说明

- 工具行只作为隐形数据源存在；时间线卡是会话中的唯一入口。
- 宽屏单排画完整弧线；换行模式只画同排弧，跨排依赖以 `↩` 徽标提示。
- 完成后卡片默认收成一行复盘摘要（阶段/进度/循环/失败定位/耗时，耗时需上游时间字段支持）；状态词为内置中文，locale 通道暂未接。
- 只读消费 workflow 事件，不保存任何平行编排状态。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © zuiyouli

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-verispring

Verispring three-role session architecture plus a bundled local knowledge graph (manon), substantially improving main-session context and reducing premium model API costs.
[中文](README.zh.md) | English

## What it enforces

| # | Gate | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Dispatch spec gate | `subagent` / `subagent_fork` requires the dispatch spec content to have appeared in the session (a read result containing the spec's first-line marker; state is persisted in the session log and survives restarts) |
| 2 | Resident scout (reachability) | The first dispatch of a session is pinned to the scout role at runtime (`description` is a display label only). The authoritative fact is **reachability**, not the description prefix: while a reachable scout exists, another scout dispatch is denied with a `send_message` reuse pointer (a scout waiting for a question showing finished/inactive is normal — `send_message` cold-resumes it); once it becomes unreachable (an `end` with a non-`completed` stop reason, or `send_message` reporting unavailable) the next dispatch is automatically re-roled to scout and the map is re-injected. Child roles are persisted at spawn (`session-state/<child session id>.json`) and restored from the record and the session title after reloads |
| 3 | Map first + baseline | Non-scout dispatch requires `<session workspace>/.project-map.md` (project root = `.git`/`.manon` present; otherwise fail-open); a `write`/`edit` of that file registers the current HEAD as the map baseline, and dispatch is denied while HEAD has advanced past it (the denial points to a scout incremental recheck plus a full `write` rewrite to re-register). A map without a registered baseline is denied too — no fail-open, so a stale map cannot stay valid forever. Fail-open only when `CASEOS_SCOUT=0` or HEAD cannot be read |
| 4 | Brief lint + executor cap | The executor brief is a result description, not a research request: briefs containing research wording (`BRIEF_LINT_TERMS` in `gates/dispatch-gate.js`) are denied with directions to `send_message` the scout instead — **negated mentions are exempt** (a negation within 6 characters before the hit, e.g. `不要通读实现` / `禁止先调研`). Running executors per leader session are capped (default 8); exceeding it is denied with "end the turn and wait for receipts". Both have kill switches (`CASEOS_BRIEF_LINT=0`, `CASEOS_MAX_EXECUTORS`) |
| 5 | Pinned model | Routes are enforced at runtime per role: the first dispatch uses the panel's scout route, later ones the executor route; explicit `provider`/`model` on the call is ignored. `subagent_fork` is always denied |
| 6 | Commit gate | `git commit` requires a prior read of `~/.dsh/specs/代码写作规范.md`; the shape is forced to `-F file -- explicit paths`, with `timeout`/`env`/`nice`/`nohup`/`stdbuf` style wrappers seen through |
| 7 | Leader scope | The leader's tool face shrinks to the review five (`bash`/`edit`/`write`/`read`/`read_image`) plus the dispatch face (`subagent`/`send_message`/`interrupt_agent`/`list_agents`), intersected with the tools that actually exist in the leader's view (desktop serves them from the preset layer, headless from the root layer); dispatch tools are shadowed by slim definitions; `subagent-base` is unconditionally denied at the root layer (if the routing executor ever breaks, the model has no fallback to sneak through). Scout and executor subagents get the full face of the `verispring-subagent` preset, and scouts are hard-denied `edit`/`write` through the dispatch request. Kill switch `CASEOS_SCOUT=0` drops the scout part of the division clause |
| 8 | Leader guard | Two kinds of runtime handling. **Denials (unchanged):** while a child is running, `sleep`/loop-waiting in `bash` is denied, and a second `list_agents` in the same turn is denied. **Hints (since 1.3.66):** `edit`/`write` outside the whitelist (`.project-map.md`, paths containing `/reports/`, `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, plus `CASEOS_LEADER_WRITE_ALLOW` prefixes) and `bash` change commands — `git commit/push/merge/rebase/restore/stash` (only `git stash list` / `git stash show` stay silent), `npm`/`pnpm` publish/install, `sed -i`/`perl -i`, `rm -rf`, workspace redirects — are **no longer denied**: the call runs as usual and one notice is appended after the tool result via the host `tools/post-execute` `additionalContexts` ("clear-boundary code and writing tasks go to an executor subagent; the leader does small fixes, the map, reports and verification writes"), at most once per turn, recorded to the monitor as `leader-write-hint` (rule + summary). Subagent sessions are unaffected. Kill switch `CASEOS_LEADER_GUARD=0` |
| 9 | Scout relay | The three loops that used to exist only in the prompt: `ask_scout` lets an executor hand a location/fact question to the resident scout and waits for the fresh answer (sender is the leader agent, since `sendMessage` authorizes by lineage); the closing "结构增量" (structure delta) section of a non-scout child is forwarded to the scout automatically; a failed child (`error`/`aborted`/`refusal`) writes a checkpoint that the plugin attaches when the leader continues it. Non-scout subagents get an injected ≤4-line locator discipline (`ask_scout` when a scout is reachable, "write it into your report" otherwise) plus the mandatory structure-delta section. Kill switch `CASEOS_SCOUT_RELAY=0`; `CASEOS_ASK_SCOUT_TIMEOUT_MS` bounds the wait |
| 10 | manon bridge | Resolves the local graph CLI (`MANON_KG_BIN` > bundled `manon/manon-kg` > legacy `~/manon/manon-kg`) and, when present, injects per role: the scout gets the full surface (commands, sourced invocation rule, ownership discipline), the leader gets one line ("graph facts come from the scout"), the executor gets one line — **manon is scout-owned; leader and executors never invoke it directly**; semantics in `~/.dsh/specs/Manon调用规则.md`. **The load-bearing part is the invocation rule**: dsh's subprocess service strips KEY/TOKEN-shaped env vars from children (anti-leak), so a bare `manon-kg sync` always fails with a missing key — the injected form sources `~/.dsh/manon.env` inside the bash command first (the scrub only strips the first hop; grandchildren inherit freely). Secret values never pass through or get printed |
| 11 | Secret hygiene | Credential/env files (`manon.env`, `verispring.env`, project `.env*`) cannot be read via `read` or echoed via `cat`/`sed` and friends (matched per command segment, so the sanctioned `source` prefix and pipes on manon output are not false positives); whole-environment dumps — bare `env`/`printenv`, `ps eww`, `/proc/*/environ`, `docker inspect` without `--format` — are denied |
| 12 | Runtime monitor | Role drift, gate denials, scout reachability changes and subagent start/end (role + route + stop reason, recorded only after a successful start) are appended to `~/.dsh/verispring-monitor.jsonl`, so audits no longer require decompressing session logs |

### Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `CASEOS_SCOUT` | on | `0` drops the scout part of the division clause and the map freshness/baseline gate |
| `CASEOS_BRIEF_LINT` | on | `0` disables research-wording denials on executor briefs |
| `CASEOS_MAX_EXECUTORS` | `8` | running-executor cap per leader session (`0` blocks every executor dispatch). The default equals the host's own `maxActiveSubagents` default of 8 (the scout counts toward the host limit), so with the scout running the 8th executor may be refused by the host with `ACTIVATION_LIMIT_REACHED` |
| `CASEOS_LEADER_GUARD` | on | `0` disables the leader runtime denials at assembly time |
| `CASEOS_LEADER_WRITE_ALLOW` | empty | `:`-separated extra path prefixes the leader may `edit`/`write` |
| `CASEOS_SCOUT_RELAY` | on | `0` unregisters `ask_scout` and stops forwarding/checkpointing/prompt injection |
| `CASEOS_ASK_SCOUT_TIMEOUT_MS` | `600000` | how long `ask_scout` waits for the scout's answer before returning a timeout |

### Monitor events

`kind` values in `~/.dsh/verispring-monitor.jsonl`: `subagent-start` / `subagent-start-failed` / `subagent-end` / `subagent-error` (lifecycle + role + route), `child-route-updated`, `role-route-mismatch`

plugins.description: Resource lease governance: auto-registers browser tabs, background jobs, processes and ports as session-owned leases with TTL auto-reclaim, pinning and manual sweep.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-resource-lease — 资源租约治理插件

解决「agent 打开浏览器 tab / 后台 job / 临时进程后忘记关」的问题。**不依赖模型自觉**：资源打开即自动登记租约（归属会话 + TTL），回收由机制执行。

## 三层防线

1. **自动登记**（tools/result 观察钩子，零提示词依赖）
   - browser_tab_new → browser-tab 租约（tabId + 归属会话 + TTL，默认 240min）
   - bash/subagent/workflow 带 run_in_background → job 租约（jobId，默认 360min）
   - 其他资源（run_code 里起的服务器等）→ lease_register 工具手动登记
2. **自动回收**（三个触发点互为冗余）
   - session/disposed → 关闭该会话全部 session 级租约（正常路径）
   - daemon 每 60s 扫 TTL 过期租约（会话挂死兜底）
   - 启动 10s 后扫过期账（宿主重启兜底；注册表持久化于 ~/.dsh/resource-lease/leases.json）
   - 浏览器空闲 10min 且**实查 0 残留 tab** 才 browser_close（共享实例安全闸：有未登记 tab 绝不误关）
3. **分类策略**
   - session（默认）：随会话/TTL 自动回收
   - pinned：用户说「这个留着」→ lease_pin 升级，永不自动回收
   - system：白名单（cron/watchdog 服务、外部 Chrome 本来就不登记，天然豁免）

## 工具面（agent）

| 工具 | 用途 |
|------|------|
| lease_list | 列租约（默认当前会话活跃；all=true 全部） |
| lease_register | 手动登记（kind=process/port/custom；process/port 需 pid） |
| lease_pin | pinned 升级/降级 |
| lease_release | 立即关闭（force=true 连 pinned 也关） |
| lease_sweep | 立即扫一轮（给 sessionId 则清该会话） |

## 面板（conversation.view slot「资源租约」）

活跃租约表 + 单个关闭/固定 + 清扫过期，10s 自动刷新。宿主 API：/resource-lease/api/{leases,release,pin,sweep}。

## 回收执行路径（实测）

- browser tab → ctx.tools.execute('browser_tab_close')（无 agent 上下文可用，PTC 不拦）
- job → ctx.jobs.kill(jobId, sessionId, reason) 直连服务（job_kill 工具是 agent 作用域注册，全局视图不可见——v1 实测踩坑）
- process/port → process.kill(pid, SIGTERM)
- 「资源已不存在」（not found/ESRCH/already-finished）视为关闭成功；'unknown tool' 不算——连续失败 3 次标 failed 停止重试，面板可见待人工处理

## 构建（离线，无需 npm install）

- host：bash scripts/build.sh（DSH_CHECKOUT 自动探测 ~/dsh-harness）
- client：bash scripts/build-client.sh（tsc CJS + 手工 __ModuleLoader__ 包装，替代 tsdown）
- 一键：dev_build_plugin → dev_inject_plugin / dev_reload_package 热重载

## 配置（cordis.patch.yml 可覆盖）

sweepIntervalMs(60s) tabTtlMinutes(240) jobTtlMinutes(360) autoCloseBrowser(true) browserIdleCloseMs(10min) keepClosedHours(72)

plugins.description: Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness - configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat. Read-only by default, writes opt-in per connection.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-db-connections

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Named database connections** for DeepSeek Harness. Configure your databases in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat — say "use 128" and the model knows which database to reach and how.

## The problem it solves

Asking an AI to query a database normally means restating host, port, user, and password every time. This plugin stores those in configuration and leaves one short name (`128`) for you and the model to use:

- The connection names are contributed to the system prompt, so "use 128" resolves without you repeating an address or a credential.
- All three tools take `connection` as their first argument, so the model only carries names.
- **No password ever reaches the prompt** — only host, port, default schema, and whether the connection is writable.

## Install

Plugin directory: `<path-to>/dsh-db-connections`

Install dependencies first (`mysql2` and `yaml`):

```sh
cd <path-to>/dsh-db-connections
npm install
```

Then install into a profile with the DSH plugin command. The Electron desktop app owns its `desktop` profile exclusively, so use the CLI the app ships:

```sh
# Default Windows desktop path; substitute your own if installed elsewhere.
"C:\Program Files\deepseek\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" ^
  plugin --profile desktop add "<path-to>/dsh-db-connections"
```

`dsh plugin add` records the package in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `id: db-connections` row with `connections: []` (connect to nothing by default).

Any other profile (`web`, `tui`, your own) uses the ordinary CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-db-connections
```

> **Restart the desktop app once after installing**, so the settings page appears: the client-plugin roster is scanned at startup, not re-scanned while running.
>
> Conversely, **the plugin directory must not be deleted, renamed, or moved**: the profile references it through a `link:`, and a missing directory produces `cannot resolve profile bundle "dsh-db-connections"`.

## Configure a database

Two routes, one configuration — use whichever you prefer.

### Route 1: click through the app (recommended)

Open **Settings → Databases** to add, edit, and delete connections, pick **read-only** or **read-write** per connection from a dropdown, and press **Test** to verify a connection on the spot. Saving applies immediately — no restart, and no need to touch the configuration file.

The page follows the shell's own language setting (Chinese/English): dictionaries are contributed with `ctx.locale.register()` and lookups go through `ctx.locale.bind()`, rather than guessing from the browser, so the page follows a language switch.

Passwords are shown and edited as plain text: the value lives in a file you own, and hiding it only makes a wrong password impossible to spot.

### Route 2: edit the configuration file

**Redefine** the `db-connections` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The loader replaces a row's whole `config` rather than deep-merging it, so restate every key:

```yaml
- id: db-connections
  name: "dsh-db-connections"
  config:
    connections:
      - name: "128"              # the name you and the model use in chat
        host: 192.0.2.10
        port: 3306               # optional, default 3306
        user: root
        password: "change-me"       # or use passwordEnv, below
        database: appdb     # optional default schema
        description: dev database # optional; shown in the prompt
        allowWrite: false        # optional, default false = read-only
```

Where the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` lives:

| Platform | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` |
| macOS / Linux | `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` |

Press **Reload** on the settings page, or restart the app, to apply a hand edit. A change made through the settings page needs neither.

### Several connections

`connections` is a list, in order; names must be unique:

```yaml
- id: db-connections
  name: "dsh-db-connections"
  config:
    connections:
      - name: "128"
        host: 192.0.2.10
        user: root
        password: "change-me"
        database: appdb
        description: dev database
      - name: "prod"
        host: 192.0.2.9
        user: readonly_user
        passwordEnv: PROD_DB_PASSWORD   # keeps the secret out of the file
        database: app_prod
        description: production (read-only account)
      - name: "local"
        host: 127.0.0.1
        user: root
        password: ""
        description: local MySQL
```

### Keep the password out of the file

Name an environment variable with `passwordEnv`; it is resolved at load, and a missing variable fails loudly rather than becoming an empty password:

```yaml
        passwordEnv: PROD_DB_PASSWORD
```

When both are present, `passwordEnv` wins. **A settings-page save does not destroy this**: the page edits raw configuration, so a resolved password is never written back to the file. Note the other direction: the settings page has no `passwordEnv` field of its own — creating the indirection is a hand edit of the configuration file.

### Write access

**Set per connection, read-only by default.** The settings page's dropdown ("Read-only" / "Read-write") is exactly the `allowWrite` flag in the configuration file.

Read-only has two independent layers, neither of which is keyword matching in the plugin:

1. With `allowWrite: false` (the default), `db_execute` refuses outright.
2. Even on a writable connection, every `db_query` statement runs inside a server-enforced `START TRANSACTION READ ONLY` — **MySQL rejects the write** — so bypass-shaped statements such as `SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE`, `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, and `WITH ... UPDATE` are refused by the server too.

Before enabling writes, confirm the database should accept changes from the agent. A read-only account is the better choice for most deployments than turning on `allowWrite`.

## The three tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `db_query` | Read-only queries, in a server-enforced read-only transaction. Returns columns plus rows. |
| `db_execute` | Writes (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL). Available only with `allowWrite: true`. |
| `db_schema` | Inspect structure: omit `database` to list schemas; pass `database` to list tables; add `table` for columns, indexes, and DDL. |

You do not call these yourself. Typical requests:

- "list the schemas on 128" → `db_schema`
- "what does sys_user look like in 128?" → `db_schema`
- "show me the first 10 users in 128" → `db_query`
- "change the remark on id=1 in 128" → `db_execute` (needs a writable connection)

## Per-connection options

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | required | Connection name, unique, ≤64 characters |
| `host` | required | Hostname or IP |
| `user` | required | Account name |
| `password` | `''` | Password, stored as plain text in the configuration file |
| `passwordEnv` | — | Environment variable holding the password; wins over `password` |
| `port` | `3306` | TCP port |
| `driver` | `mysql` | Only `mysql` is supported |
| `database` | — | Default schema; without it, qualify SQL as `schema.table` |
| `description` | — | Shown in the prompt, for context |
| `allowWrite` | `false` | Whether this connection accepts writes; the settings page's read-only / read-write dropdown |
| `ssl` | `false` | Connect over TLS |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `10000` | Connection timeout |
| `queryTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-statement timeout (client and server `MAX_EXECUTION_TIME`) |
| `maxRows` | `200` | Rows returned per call; an excess is reported, never silently dropped |
| `maxCellChars` | `500` | Characters kept per cell |
| `maxDdlChars` | `20000` | Bound for the table DDL `db_schema` returns, kept separate so a CREATE TABLE is not cut off |
| `connectionLimit` | `4` | Pool size |

A bad configuration fails **at plugin load** naming the offending key, rather than when the model first calls a tool.

## Security notes

- Passwords never appear in the prompt or in tool results.
- Read-only comes from a server

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s
