rename」，互不干扰。 `{{model}}` / `{{cwd}}` / `{{provider}}` 的引用规则**与人设完全一致**：落盘前过同一道 白名单闸门（`normalizeBody()`），其余引用一律拒绝保存并说明原因。 其中只有 `{{model}}` / `{{provider}}` 是 DSH 0.2.1 注册的官方提示词变量；`{{cwd}}` **不是**（0.2.0 曾有，0.2.1 已移除）。本插件仍支持它，但由插件自己在渲染时从 `agent.session.header.cwd` 本地展开，两个段落都设了 `interpolate: false`，不会交给 DSH 官方插值。`{{cwd}}` 取的是会话 header 记录的**原始工作目录**，不是 working-directory 服务变更后的当前目录。 ### 语义：设置页管仓库，会话管这次用哪张 | 层 | 存哪 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | 卡片 | `cards.json` | 设置页维护 | | 启用开关 | 同上 | **只决定这张卡进不进备选池**，不替任何会话做决定 | | 会话 → 卡片 绑定 | `session-cards.json` | 会话界面的选择器写入 | | 全局设置 | `settings.json` | 设置页维护，**无条件注入**，与会话/人设无关 | | 注入什么 | —— | **全局设置（若有）+「绑了就用绑的那张；没绑就什么都不注入」** | 这个设计解决了一个实际问题：把几张卡全启用，新会话**不会**把几个人格叠加成 互相打架的身份指令 —— 因为「启用」不等于「生效」。 会话 id 来自段落 text 函数收到的组装上下文 —— `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` 的 `assembleContextFor()` 返回的是 `{ agent, scope: agent, signal? }`， 所以 `context.agent.id` 就是当前会话。拿不到 agent（或绑的卡被停用/清空/删除）时 一律按「不注入」处理，不会抛错、也不会误注入别的卡。 ### ⚠️ 为什么选择器不在「新建会话」界面 试过了，**DSH 的插槽体系里没有干净的位置**： 1. 新建会话的空状态（hero）里，所有会话级控件都被官方显式跳过 —— `dsh-client-ui-conversation` 里写死了 `input === undefined || sessionId === undefined ? null : renderSlot("conversation.input.left", {})`。 新建会话时还没有 `sessionId`，所以这些槽一律不渲染。 2. hero 区唯一能挂东西的是 `conversation.hero.agentPreset`，但它是 **single 槽且已被官方占用** （`replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`）—— 用它就得顶掉官方的 agent 预设选择器。 所以选择器放在 **composer 工具行左侧**（`conversation.input.left`，list 槽、空着、`replaceRisk: none`）。 效果是：**发出第一条消息后选择器出现**，之后随时可切；新会话的第一条消息用设置里的默认规则。 ## 安装 包已链接进 desktop profile。手工装的三步（本机开发用）： 1. 包目录 junction 到 `/node_modules/dsh-persona-cards` 2. `/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-persona-cards": "0.2.0"` 3. `/cordis.patch.yml` 追加 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 insert 块 官方装法：`dsh plugin --profile

add dsh-persona-cards` ### ⚠️ 改完 Host 代码必须**完全重启** DSH DSH 的 Loader 复用 ESM 模块缓存：禁用/启用插件、改配置文件、新建会话都不会 重新 import `lib/index.js`。 **两半的更新方式不一样，会错配**： | 半边 | 什么时候重新读盘 | |---|---| | `lib/client.js` | `dsh-client-modules` 对这个文件挂了 watch —— 改完**刷新页面**就是新的 | | `lib/index.js` | **只在 DSH 进程启动时**加载一次 | 所以「刷新页面」之后很容易出现**界面是新的、Host 是旧的**：新界面按新协议调 `saveGlobal`，旧 Host 的 switch 里没有这个 case，回一句 `未知接口：saveGlobal`，界面上就是「保存失败：未知接口：saveGlobal」。 现在这种错配会被显式认出来（快照里没有 `global` 字段 = Host 是旧版本）， 设置页直接给出警告并禁用输入框，不会再让人对着"能打字却存不下去"猜。 **修法只有一个：完全退出 DSH 再重新打开**。 ## 数据 | 项 | 位置 | |---|---| | 卡片文件 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/cards.json` | | 全局设置 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/settings.json` | | 会话绑定 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/session-cards.json` | | 诊断输出 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/diag.json`（排查注册问题用，可删） | `$DSH_HOME` 解析顺序：环境变量 `DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh`。 默认即 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\persona-cards\cards.json`。**同目录下已有的 `.md` 人设文件不会被读写或修改。** > **这些文件不在会话日志里。** 卡片、全局设置、会话绑定都是插件自己的外部状态， > session log 不记录“这一轮用了哪张卡”，所以 fork / replay / 换一台机器 / 删除 > `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards` 后都无法从日志重建绑定；插件会按“没绑定”处理，静默 > 不注入，而不是报错。存储格式（version 1）保持不变。 ## 注入位置 两个提示词段落，`order` 取自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` 的 `SECTION_ORDERS`： ``` HARNESS_IDENTITY(-1000) → DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX(0) → ★persona-cards:global(90) → ★persona-cards:user(100) → PLAN_POLICY(500) → TEAM_POLICY(600) → 各工具说明(1000+) ``` | 段落名 | order | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `persona-cards:global` | 90 | 全局设置，非空就注入，与上下文无关 | | `persona-cards:user` | 100 | 当前会话选中的那张人设卡，没选就是空串（整段被丢弃） | ## DSH 0.2.0 兼容性（重要） DSH 从 `0.1.7-rc.2` 升到 `0.2.0-rc.1` 后，cordis 收紧了 ctx 代理： **没声明 `inject` 的服务属性访问会直接抛错** —— `cannot get property "X" without inject`（`cordis/lib/index.js` 的 `ReflectService.handler.get`）。 `connection.rpc.handle()` 内部是 `register(owner = this.ctx, …)` → `owner.webServer.register(route)`，而 `this.ctx` 解析成**调用方 fiber 的 ctx** （官方注释明写："channel registrations belong to the caller fiber"）。 本插件刻意不声明 inject（声明会把 apply 推迟，见 `whenService` 注释）， 于是官方通道整条挂掉，表现就是设置页报： ``` 读取失败：transport failure for /persona-cards/state: HTTP 405 ``` （405 = 请求落到了 fallback，说明路由压根没注册。） **修法：官方通道优先，失败自动降级。** 降级路径用 `ctx.get('webServer')` —— 官方给的服务可选访问形式，**不受 inject 约束** —— 自己挂 `{kind:'prefix'}` 路由，信任校验复用 `connection.admit(req)`： 它是实例方法，只读 `trustedHosts` / `browserAuth` / `operator` 三个实例属性， 完全不碰 ctx。 **已在真实运行环境实测过**（建了个独立探针包，新包名没有 ESM 缓存所以当场加载）： | 检查项 | 结果 | |---|---| | `ctx.get('webServer')` | `object` | | `webServer.register` | `function` | | `ctx.get('connection')` / `.admit` | `object` / `function` | | 路由注册 | 成功 | | 未认证请求打到该路由 | **401**（不是 404/405），且确实进了处理器 | 401 是预期的：命令行的裸请求没有浏览器认证 cookie，被信任栅栏拦下； 页面内发起的同源请求会带 cookie，正常通过。 ## DSH 0.2.1 变量变化（重要） DSH 0.2.1 的 `dsh-agent-loop` 只注册 `provider` 和 `model` 两个提示词变量； 0.2.0 里的 `cwd` 已被移除。官方文档明确要求从 persona / preset 的 `suffix` 中删掉 `Your working directory is {{cwd}}.`，否则引用未注册变量会让提示词组装在模型请求前 直接失败。 本插件不受影响，因为： - 两个提示词段落都用 `interpolate: false` 渲染，DSH 不会扫描卡片正文里的 `{{...}}`； - `{{cwd}}` 由 `renderVariables()` 从 `agent.session.header.cwd` 本地展开，缺值替换为 空串而不是抛错； - 落盘前的白名单校验沿用官方 `interpolate()` 的语法，保证存下来的正文在别处（例如 被复制进会做官方插值的 preset 段落）也不会带雷。 **不要把 `interpolate` 改回 `true`，也不要指望 DSH 替你展开 `{{cwd}}`。** `{{cwd}}` 是插件的本地变量：它取会话 header 的原始工作目录，不跟随 working-directory 服务后续的目录切换。 ## 两个保命设计（别改） 1. **`{{...}}` 闸门**。DSH 的官方插值会对每个段落扫 `{{...}}`，而 `interpolate()` 在三种情况下**直接抛异常**：引用了没注册的名字（`unknown prompt variable`）、 引用了已注册但本次组装没有值的变量、以及写法不合法 （`malformed prompt variable reference`）。0.2.1 只注册 `provider` / `model`； 0.2.0 里还能用的 `{{cwd}}` 现在会让整个模型步骤失败。 本插件的做法是**关闭官方插值 + 本地展开 + 落盘前白名单校验**： - 两个段落都设 `interpolate: false`，DSH 不会碰正文里的 `{{...}}`； - 渲染时只本地替换 `model` / `cwd` / `provider`，缺值给空串；`cwd` 取自 `agent.session.header.cwd`（会话创建时的原始目录，不是 working-directory 服务变更后的当前目录），它不是 DSH 官方变量； - **保存时**用 `scanVariableReferences()` 按官方 `interpolate()` 的语法扫正文 （包括「没有配对的单个 `{{` 当普通文本放行」），只放行这三个名字，其余引用 拒绝保存并说明原因。 全库扫过 DSH 的包（0.2.0 时是 289 个）：官方自己**没有任何内置段落**引用这些 变量 —— 它们就是留给插件/组合层用的。0.2.1 起官方变量只剩 `provider` / `model`， `cwd` 归本插件自己维护。 2. **不能用 `deployment:persona-prefix` 这个段名**。它归 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 所有，而官方注释明写那个插件是 scope-only 的： 全局挂载会与注册表自身的注册相撞并 fail loud。所以本插件用自己的段名。 ## 实现要点 ``` dsh-persona-cards/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（平台 web） ├── cordis.patch.yml # 挂载声明 └── lib/ ├── index.js # Host：持久化（卡片 / 绑定 / 全局设置）+ 两个提示词段落 + RPC 通道 └── client.js # Client：设置页 UI + 会话界面的人设选择器 ``` **Host ↔ Client 通信**走 `ctx.connection.rpc.handle(channel, handler)`。 通道内部已经过 `admit(req)`（Host/Origin 信任栅栏 + 浏览器鉴权），被拒即 401/403 —— 所以本插件**不需要**自己写路由守卫，这也是没走 `ctx.webServer.register()` 野路子的原因。 客户端侧对应 `ctx.connection.rpc.call(channel, endpoint, payload)`， 返回 `{ok:true,value}` / `{ok:false,error}`，**业务失败不抛异常**，必须自己解包。 **service 获取刻意不用依赖注入**：`apply` 用 `whenService()` 轮询取 `systemPrompt` / `connection`。本机实测踩过一次 `ctx.inject([...], cb)` 静默挂起（fiber 显示 active，但回调始终没跑，RPC 通道就这么没了）。 **`dsh.client.inject` 填的是包名，不是 cordis 服务名**（`package.json` 里）： ```json "client": { "platform": "web", "inject": [ "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings",

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 高效执行 Skill：将确定性操作合并为单次脚本化执行、反馈压缩为摘要并按需深读、本地核验结果、及时停止无效重试 | Efficient tool execution skill for DeepSeek Harness: batches deterministic operations into one scripted pass, compresses feedback to summaries with on-demand deep reads, verifies results locally, and stops unproductive retry loops
plugins.readme_text:
# deepseek-harness-batch-executor

> **简体中文**：面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) 的高效执行 Skill——让**模型只参与真正需要判断的步骤**，把确定性工作合并为一次脚本化执行（程序化工具调用 PTC 纪律），在汇报前**本地核验**结果（数量、sha256 树哈希、差异），并对无效重试**及时止损**。
>
> - 与 Harness 无关：**Python 3.8+ 纯标准库**，零依赖、不联网。
> - 作为 DSH 原生 Skill 安装（`SKILL.md` + 辅助脚本），也可在任何能运行 Python 的 Agent 环境中直接使用。
>
> 📖 完整中文文档：[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

---

Efficient tool execution for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`): a skill that keeps the **model in the loop only for steps that need judgment**, moves deterministic work into one scripted pass (the Programmatic Tool Calling discipline), verifies results **locally** before reporting, and **stops unproductive retry loops** instead of burning tokens on them.

- Harness-agnostic scripts: **Python 3.8+, standard library only** — no pip install, no network.
- Installs as a native DeepSeek Harness **skill** (`SKILL.md` + helper scripts), and works in any harness that can run Python.

---

## Why: the three cost centers of long agent sessions

In long-running harness tasks the bill comes from three places:

1. **Repeated context cost** — every model turn re-carries the conversation: past messages, past tool calls, past tool *results*. Mechanical steps (copy this file, check that file, count those lines) each trigger a full round trip, and each round trip pays for the whole transcript again.
2. **Round-trip inflation** — a 20-file copy done step-by-step is ~40 model round trips; the model is present for steps that need no judgment.
3. **Verbose feedback** — raw tool output floods the context (hundreds of search hits, full test logs, whole-file dumps) even though the model only needs a status, a count, a diff, or an exception summary.

This project's answer, per cost center:

| Problem | Mechanism | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Mechanical steps trigger repeated model round trips | **Plan → batch execute → receipt**: one programmatic pass for the whole deterministic sequence | `scripts/batch_exec.py`, SKILL.md Layer 2 |
| Tool output floods the context | **Compressed feedback**: summary to stdout, full detail to a local log with stable ids, lazy on-demand deep reads | `scripts/search_summary.py`, `scripts/test_summary.py` |
| "Did my edit land?" stays unverified | **Local verification**: counts, sha256 tree hashes, diffs — evidence, not vibes | `scripts/verify_state.py`, plan `verify` section |
| Blind retries and repeated no-op edits | **Loop governance**: evidence hashes detect no-progress; retry limits stop the loop with a reason | `scripts/loop_guard.py` |
| Destructive ops run without scrutiny | **Approval gates**: remove/overwrite require explicit approval; dry-run first | `batch_exec.py` `--approve` / `--dry-run` |

## Architecture & workflow

```
            ┌──────────────────────────── model (judgment) ───────────────────────────┐
            │ 1. CLASSIFY  split task: deterministic (batchable) vs judgment-required │
            │ 2. PLAN      write plan JSON (or one program, if native PTC is on)      │
            └───────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                │ one hand-off
            ┌──────────────────────────── executor (deterministic) ───────────────────┐
            │ 3. PRE-CHECK  sources, destinations, policies                           │
            │ 4. EXECUTE    the whole planned sequence, continuously                  │
            │ 5. VERIFY     counts, hashes, diffs — locally, cheap-first              │
            └───────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                │ one receipt + evidence pointers
            ┌──────────────────────────── model (judgment) ───────────────────────────┐
            │ 6. REPORT     compact receipt only; deep reads are lazy (by log path)   │
            │ 7. GUARD      loop_guard check/record before every retry; honor STOP    │
            └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Native PTC note: DeepSeek Harness's Code Mode / programmatic tool calling does exactly this natively when enabled — **use it when available**. When it is not enabled, the same shape is achieved with the harness's ordinary file-write + command-execution tools (write the plan/script, run it, read only the summary). The skill documents both paths and the decision rules for each.

## Installation

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin (recommended)

The repository ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest (`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml`), so it installs as a native plugin and the skill is registered automatically — no manual copying:

```bash
dsh plugin add github:LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor
```

The plugin registers the bundled `SKILL.md` through the `ctx.skills` provider seam; the helper scripts under `scripts/` ship inside the package and resolve relative to the skill directory. It is listed on the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) directory (category `skill`).

### As a plain skill (clone into the skill directories)

If you prefer not to use the plugin channel, DSH also scans skill directories directly (project-level wins over user-level):

```bash
# user-level (available in every project)
git clone https://github.com/LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor.git \
    ~/.dsh/skills/deepseek-harness-batch-executor

# or project-level (recommended for teams: commit the skill with the repo)
git clone https://github.com/LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor.git \
    <your-project>/.dsh/skills/deepseek-harness-batch-executor
```

Equivalent locations that DSH also scans: `<project>/.agents/skills/` and `~/.agents/skills/`. Custom directories can be registered via `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (`skill-explorer.customSkillDirs`) or the `DSH_CUSTOM_SKILL_DIRS` environment variable. Skills are hot-reloaded — no restart needed.

### As plain scripts (any harness / CI)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor.git
cd deepseek-harness-batch-executor
python scripts/batch_exec.py --plan examples/sample-plan.json   # try it
```

## Usage

### 1. Batch execution with verification — `scripts/batch_exec.py`

```bash
python scripts/batch_exec.py --plan plan.json [--dry-run] [--approve] \
                             [--log-dir DIR] [--fail-fast] [--json]
```

`plan.json` (see [`examples/sample-plan.json`](examples/sample-plan.json)):

```json
{
  "plan_id": "copy-configs",
  "overwrite": "if-different",
  "operations": [
    {"id": "op-1", "op": "copy", "src": "templates/a.conf", "dst": "build/a.conf"},
    {"id": "op-2", "op": "mkdir", "path": "build/out"},
    {"id": "op-3", "op": "expect", "path": "build/a.conf", "expect": {"exists": true}},
    {"id": "op-4", "op": "remove", "path": "build/tmp", "requires_approval": true}
  ],
  "verify": [
    {"type": "count", "pattern": "build/*.conf", "expect": 8},
    {"type": "tree-hash", "src": "templates", "dst": "build"}
  ]
}
```

Sample receipt (real output from running `examples/sample-plan.json` against 8 template files):

```
[receipt] plan=copy-configs status=success elapsed_ms=56
counts: total=10 ok=10 already_satisfied=0 failed=0 refused=0 planned=0
operations:
  op-1                     mkdir    ok                 created directory: build/configs
  op-2                     copy     ok                 copied templates/app.conf -> build/configs/app.conf (14 bytes)
  ... (op-3 .. op-9: copies, all ok)
  op-10                    expect   ok                 expectation satisfied: build/configs/db.conf
verify:
  count        pass  glob 'build/configs/*.conf' matched 8 file(s), expected 8
  tree-hash    pass  trees identical (8 file(s))
full log: .dsh-batch-logs/copy-configs-20261017T043700Z.json
```

Key properties: idempotent (`if-different` reports `already_satisfied` instead of re-copying), verification is content-hash based (not "the command returned 0"), every run writes a full JSON audit log, and exit codes are explicit (`0` success, `2` partial

plugins.description: Route DeepSeek Harness web_search/web_fetch through DeepSeek's native tools APIs (POST /v1/tools/search, /v1/tools/fetch) via a small Rust engine.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-tools-deepseek

**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

[![engine](https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek/actions/workflows/engine.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek/actions/workflows/engine.yml)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)

A provider bundle for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (**DSH**) `ctx.web` seam. It routes `web_search` and `web_fetch` to DeepSeek's own **native Search and Fetch APIs** instead of the model-backed web-search tool, and falls back to the native provider when the tools API fails or returns nothing.

The HTTP work lives in a small **Rust engine** (`crates/engine`, ~900 KiB) spoken to over NDJSON on stdio; the cordis plugin is a thin JavaScript bridge around it.

```text
tool-web ──▶ ctx.web ──▶ this bundle ──┬─▶ WebSearchProvider ─┐
                                       └─▶ WebFetchProvider  ─┤ NDJSON/stdio
                                                              ▼
                                          dsh-web-tools-deepseek(.exe)   (Rust)
                                                              │
                                        POST /v1/tools/search │ POST /v1/tools/fetch
                                                              ▼
                                                    https://api.deepseek.com
```

---

## Why — and what it costs

DSH ships two web providers by default:

| | provider | how it works | billed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| search | `deepseek-official` | a **server-side tool** (`web_search_20250305`) run inside the model call | **tokens** — the results land in your context |
| fetch | `http` | fetches the URL locally, anonymously | free |

This bundle replaces both with DeepSeek's dedicated endpoints:

| | endpoint | billed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| search | `POST /v1/tools/search` | **¥5 per 1,000 successful requests** (≈ ¥0.005 each) |
| fetch | `POST /v1/tools/fetch` | **¥5 per 1,000 successful requests** (≈ ¥0.005 each) |

> **Only successful requests are billed.** A request counts when it returns HTTP 200 *and* produced a result — for search a non-empty `results`, for fetch page content. A 403, a 404, an empty result set, a timeout and a failed call are all **free**. `count` changes how many results you get, never the price. See [Pricing and limits](#pricing-and-limits).

The trade: **a predictable per-call price instead of token cost**, plus search results that arrive as clean structured fields (`title` / `url` / `summary` / `date`) rather than as text the model has to parse out of its own tool output. To go back, see [Rolling back](#rolling-back).

---

## Install

### From a clone or directory

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-tools-deepseek"
```

### From GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek"
```

### What the install does

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding it appends to `dsh.profile.bundles` and its [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml) is applied. That patch:

1. **inserts** the plugin row (registering `deepseek-tools-api` for both search and fetch), and
2. **overrides the `web` row** so `searchProvider` and `fetchProvider` point at it.

Both halves are required. A patch entry **replaces that row's whole `config`** rather than deep-merging it, so the override must restate *both* keys; and because three providers are then registered (`deepseek-official`, `http`, `deepseek-tools-api`) the seam would otherwise refuse to guess and raise `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`.

**Restart DSH after installing.** Cordis re-runs `apply()` on a config reload, but the plugin *module* is ESM-cached — code edits and a first mount need a process restart (verified experimentally; see [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)).

### Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` 0.2.x (targets the `ctx.web` provider seam) |
| Node | ≥ 18.17 |
| Credential | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, or a literal `apiKey` |
| Rust | **not needed** — `bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek-win32-x64.exe` is committed. Build it for Linux/macOS, or take a [release asset](https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek/releases/latest) (zip uploads do not keep the executable bit: `chmod +x` it). |

### Building the engine

```bash
cargo build --release          # or: npm run build:engine
node scripts/stage-engine.mjs  # → bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek-<platform>-<arch>
```

The engine is resolved in this order, so a source checkout, an installed copy and a packed tarball all work:

1. `$DSH_WEB_TOOLS_DEEPSEEK_BIN`
2. the `enginePath` config field
3. `bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek-<platform>-<arch>[.exe]`
4. `bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek[.exe]`
5. `target/release/…`, then `target/debug/…` (an unstaged checkout)

---

## Configuration

Every field has a working default, so an empty config block is valid. Override fields on the plugin row in a `cordis.patch.yml` at or after this bundle:

```yaml
- id: web-tools-deepseek
  name: dsh-web-tools-deepseek
  config:
    count: 8
    qps: 4
```

| field | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | `''` | Literal API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` — a literal ends up in the config file. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Credential reference, resolved through the `credentials` service **on every call**, so a rotated key is picked up without a restart. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | API origin. |
| `searchProviderId` | `deepseek-tools-api` | Id the search provider registers under; must match `web.searchProvider`. |
| `fetchProviderId` | `deepseek-tools-api` | Id the fetch provider registers under; must match `web.fetchProvider`. |
| `count` | `10` | Results requested when the caller passes no `maxResults` (1–50). Price-neutral. |
| `snippetSource` | `summary` | Which API field becomes each source's `snippet`: `summary` (600–800 chars, *"for models to read"*) or `snippet` (100–200 chars, *"for front-end display"*). See below. |
| `oriQuestion` | `''` | Sent as `ori_question` when non-empty; over 128 characters is truncated with a warning. |
| `localization` | `''` | Sent as `localization` when non-empty. This is an **IP address** used to prefer results local to it — *not* a language tag. For language, put `lang:zh,en` in the query. |
| `blockedAsResult` | `true` | Return fetch 403/404 as a *result* carrying a clear non-content notice (`true`), instead of throwing (`false`). |
| `includeTitle` | `true` | Prepend the API's `title` as an H1 when the Markdown does not already carry it. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt deadline; `0` disables it. |
| `retries` | `1` | Extra attempts for `408` / `429` / `5xx` **and transport failures** (DNS, TLS, socket). |
| `qps` | `5` | Per-endpoint rate limit. Search and fetch are limited independently. |
| `userAgent` | `dsh-web-tools-deepseek/<version>` | `User-Agent` header. |
| `fallbackSearchProviderId` | `deepseek-official` | Another **already registered** provider to retry on when the tools API fails or returns nothing. Empty string disables the fallback. |
| `fallbackOn` | `both` | When the fallback runs: `never`, `error`, `empty`, or `both`. |
| `enginePath` | `''` | Explicit engine binary path; overrides the `bin/` lookup. |
| `diag` | `true` | Append one JSON line per HTTP attempt to the diagnostics log. |

### Why `snippetSource` defaults to `summary`

DeepSeek's documentation labels the two fields by consumer:

> `snippet` — short summary, relevant to the query, usually 100–200 characters, **suitable for front-end display**.
> `summary` — long summary, relevant to the query, usually 600–800 characters, **suitable for models to read**.

The only consumer of a DSH `WebSource` is a model, so `summary` is the faithful default even though it costs several times the context (8 results ≈ 5K characters ≈ 2K tokens). Set `snippetSource: snippet` to spend less.

### Why `need_content` is never sent

`need_content: true` makes the API return each result's full page body in that

plugins.description: dsh-persona-driven，dsh技能插件，人格驱动引擎
plugins.readme_text:
# persona-driven · Persona-Driven Engine (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

> Turns "the AI is too cautious, re-tests every tiny change, burns tokens" into
> **eight adjustable dials**. One sentence — "be decisive" — switches the profile.
> This repository is the **native DeepSeek Harness port** of the `persona-driven` skill:
> a bundled skill, per-turn injection and a hard safety floor, all on native Cordis
> extension points. **No Git Bash, and no per-turn Python subprocess.**

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Install & verify](docs/安装与验收.md) · [Architecture & porting notes](docs/架构与移植说明.md) · [Release & distribution](docs/发布与分发.md)

[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

---

## In 30 seconds

You do not need to know MBTI. MBTI is just a memorable handle; the dial values are what
actually take effect.

| You want | Just say |
|---|---|
| Go faster, stop over-testing | "be decisive", "stop re-testing everything", "too many tokens" |
| Name a type | "use ENTJ", "switch to ESFP" |
| Use a preset | "Fast mode", "use the steady one", "give me a few options" |
| Inspect / turn off | "what persona am I on", "turn off persona" |
| See your data | "persona dashboard" |

Eight dials, each 1–5:

| Group | Dial | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| Execution | PACE | how often to stop and ask |
| Execution | **VERIFY** | **how much verification this change gets** |
| Execution | RISK | how much uncertainty is acceptable |
| Execution | STRUCT | whether existing structure may move |
| Cognition | DETAIL | how much detail to give |
| Cognition | EXPLORE | how many options to offer |
| Interaction | STYLE | how to talk |
| Interaction | WARMTH | attend to the person or the task first |

Four presets — **Fast** (`P5/V4/R4/S4/D5/E1/ST3/W2`), **Steady**, **Explore**, **Companion** —
plus all 16 types. Eight domains (coding, UI design, visual image, finance, writing,
planning, collaboration, decision) each have a dial→output mapping; only the relevant one loads.

---

## Two floors that never come down

**Safety floor.** Deleting/overwriting, payments, auth and permissions, secrets and
credentials, production changes, destructive database statements, irreversible actions —
the profile always reverts to high verification and asks first. Once this plugin is
installed, that becomes a **real** approval prompt via `tools/pre-execute`
(not just the model's good intentions).

**Verification floor.** The profile tunes how much *extra* verification happens, never
*whether* anything is verified. Whatever you change gets verified; introducing new behaviour
or fixing a defect requires fixed, re-runnable evidence, self-reported on the last line.
It is **decoupled** from `EXPLORE` and `PACE` — "only one option" and "just be quick" are
never reasons to verify less.

> **Savings may only come from getting it right the first time**, never from doing less.
> A rework is treated as a signal that earlier verification was under-funded: catch up,
> do not keep skipping.

---

## Install

### Install — one command (installing the plugin *is* L3)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:yxdotnet/dsh-persona-driven
```

That single command installs the package **and** writes `@dsh-external/persona-driven`
into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`; restart DSH and it is live. The same spec can be
pasted into the **Plugins** page in DSH's Web sidebar.

> Measured: pnpm finishes in 9.1 s; `dsh <profile> --dump-config` shows
> `- id: persona-driven` with zero warnings. Once published to npm, the equivalent is
> `add @dsh-external/persona-driven`.

> **No hooks to install.** On DSH the three capabilities — per-turn injection, safety-floor
> interception and telemetry — are carried by the plugin itself (native Cordis extension
> points). Once the plugin is installed there is **no hooks config file and no per-turn
> subprocess**; `~/.dsh/persona/` only ever contains `metrics/` and `sessions/`.
>
> It is the **plugin**, not the **skill directory**, that provides L3 — copying
> the skill directory alone gives you no injection and no guard.
> The hook bridge below exists only to keep older configs working — **not recommended**, ignore it
> for a fresh install.

### Degraded — without the plugin (L1/L2, **not an install option**)

Copy `skills/persona-driven/` into a DSH skill root; DSH discovers it automatically.

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell ($env:DSH_HOME defaults to ~/.dsh)
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force .\skills\persona-driven "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\persona-driven"
```

```bash
# macOS / Linux
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills && cp -r skills/persona-driven ~/.dsh/skills/
```

DSH skill roots, lowest rank wins:

| Rank | Path | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills` | project |
| 200 | `<projectRoot>/.agents/skills` | project |
| 300 | `customSkillDirs` from the composition | configured |
| 400 | `$DSH_HOME/skills` | user |
| 500 | `~/.agents/skills` | user |
| 600 | bundled skill dir / `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` | installation |

`<projectRoot>` is the nearest ancestor containing `.git`.

**This level can influence, not constrain**: tone, detail and pace follow the profile,
but test depth is not enforced and the safety floor does not force a human confirmation.

### Install from a local directory (dev mode) — also L3

The plugin registers the skill, injects the dial block every turn, and turns the safety
floor into a real approval prompt.

```powershell
# add it to a profile (<profile> is desktop / web / tui / ...;
# replace <path-to-this-repo> with where you cloned it)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <path-to-this-repo>

# then restart DSH — no hand-editing of the bundle list; the command above does it
```

The command rewrites `dsh.profile.bundles` to include:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "@dsh-external/persona-driven"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

You can also install it from DSH's plugin panel (`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`,
with this directory's absolute path as `target`).

> Plugins are modules DSH loads **at startup**; restart DSH for changes to take effect.

### Hook bridge (**not recommended**; kept for older configs only)

A compatibility path: generate a Claude Code-format `hooks.json` and let DSH's bundled
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` bridge run it.

```bash
cd skills/persona-driven
python scripts/persona.py install-hooks                        # preview, writes nothing
python scripts/persona.py install-hooks --apply --write-confirmed
```

Then add the YAML the script prints into `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` (or the profile's own)
and restart DSH:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: persona-driven-hooks
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code'
      config:
        configPath: <the hooks.json path printed above>
```

**Pick one of A / B / C.** Options B and C both inject every turn; enabling both injects the
dial block twice (same content, pure token waste).

---

## Verify it actually works

```powershell
cd <path-to-this-repo>
npm test        # 273 assertions + install self-check (84 need a DSH node_modules; that suite reports "skipped, unverified" without one)
npm run doctor  # install self-check only
```

`npm run doctor` reports four things: package and patch integrity, skill payload
completeness, **whether the bundle is installed into any profile**, and whether the state
directory is writable. The criterion is "installed", not "the command exited 0".

Skill-side checks:

```bash
cd skills/persona-driven
python scripts/persona.py doctor   # environment + DSH plugin + optional hook bridge
python scripts/persona.py get      # the effective profile and which layer it came from
```

---

## What this plugin does

| Item | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Injection channel | `agent/pre-step` waterfall — native, no subprocess |
| Dependencies | **none** (Python is only needed for the CLI: switching dials, dashboard) |
| Safety floor | `tools/pre-execute` returns `{kind:'ask'}` → DSH Approva

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

# dsh-mcp-manager

在 dsh 桌面版 GUI 中查看并管理当前 profile 的 MCP 服务器
（即 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的 insert 行）。

## 这是什么

dsh 的 MCP 客户端把每个 MCP 服务器声明为一条 profile patch 的 insert 行。
官方设置页对这类 union 行没有感知，手工改文件又容易踩坑（被顶层 override 行遮蔽等）。
本插件补上这一缺口：

- **Host 半**（`lib/index.js`）：在 dsh 的 `/api` 认证通道下挂一条 fetch 路由
  `/api/mcp-config`，提供 `list` / `save` / `remove` 三种操作。写入时直接用
  yaml 的 Document API 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里就地改写目标行，因此注释、缩进、
  折行与 `!!js` 表达式全部原样保留；落盘走 dsh 自己的原子写 + 文件锁。
- **Client 半**（`lib/client.js`）：桌面 GUI 中的「MCP 服务器」页面。可列出当前
  profile 的全部 MCP 服务器，查看其 serverName / 传输方式 / 目标 / 工具数 / 运行状态，
  点「新增服务器」按表单填写后直接追加一行（行 id 默认由 serverName 派生，可手改），
  编辑并保存配置（热重载，无需重启），启用或停用，从 `{"mcpServers": {...}}` 片段
  批量导入，以及删除（删除前自动备份原文到同目录 `.bak`）。

界面文案内置中文与英文两套，跟随 dsh 主题 token 适配外观。

## 仓库结构

```
dsh-mcp-manager/
├── package.json          # bundle 元数据，声明 dsh.bundle.patch 与 dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 把本插件作为一条 Loader 行插入 profile
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # Host 半：/api/mcp-config 路由与 patch 行读写
│   └── client.js         # Client 半：GUI「MCP 服务器」页面
├── node_modules/         # 安装时由 pnpm 装入（已 gitignore，不入库）
├── .gitignore
├── LICENSE               # MIT
└── README.md
```

依赖全部写在 `package.json` 里，仓库不携带 `node_modules/`：

| 依赖 | 声明位置 | 由谁提供 |
|---|---|---|
| `yaml` | `dependencies` | 安装插件时 pnpm 装进 profile `node_modules` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write` | `peerDependencies` + `devDependencies` | 运行中的 dsh 运行时闭包（同一份实例，不与宿主重复加载） |

`dsh-atomic-write` 声明为 peer 而非 dependency，是让它由宿主供给单一实例，
插件仓库因此既不需要、也不应该携带 `node_modules`。

## 安装与启用

本插件是 dsh bundle，由 dsh 桌面版按 `package.json` 中的 `dsh` 字段识别并加载：

- `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，由 Host 半作为一条 Loader 行注册。
- `dsh.client` 声明 `platform: web` 与 inject 目标，由 dsh 客户端模块系统把
  `lib/client.js` 作为浏览器半侧送出。

通过 dsh 插件管理器或 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库地址>` 安装：pnpm 会按
`dependencies` 自动装上 `yaml`（peer 由宿主供给，pnpm 不装）。加载后在左侧导航出现「MCP 服务器」。

> 本地开发若用 `link:` 挂载源码目录，pnpm 不会安装本插件的 `dependencies`；此时需在插件
> 目录内执行一次 `pnpm install` 得到本地 `node_modules`（已 gitignore），解析时插件自身
> 的 `node_modules` 优先级最高。用 `github:` / tarball 地址安装则依赖自动装进 profile，
> 无需此步。

## 能力边界

- 支持 `stdio` 与 `streamable-http` 两种传输方式的查看、编辑与新增。
- 新增：列表页右上角「新增服务器」→ 填表单（可写一段说明注释，留空则自动生成
  时间注释）→ 保存即在 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加一个 `- insert:` 块，无需手工
  编辑文件。注释只在新建时写入，改写既有行不会动它。
- 删除：删除前回报「会一并删掉的注释行数」供确认，并把原文备份到同目录 `.bak`。
- 写入只改目标行（就地逐键合并），注释、缩进、折行与 `!!js` 表达式保持原样。

## 许可证

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH plugin: permanent Delete-session action for the session menu (DSH only ships archive)
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

Adds a **Delete session** action to the session "…" menu of DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` only ships **archive** (a soft delete: hidden, but all data is kept). This plugin fills the gap — one click **permanently deletes** a session together with its on-disk data.

## Features

- In the session row's "…" menu, right after the built-in Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive, a new **Delete session** entry appears.
- Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog (showing the session title); confirming invokes the host-side delete.
- Deleting cleans up three data locations:
  1. The session itself: `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/`
  2. The projection cache: `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json`
  3. The session's registration in the workspace index (`sessionIds` / archive / pin marks)
- After a successful delete, the open UI **needs no refresh** — the row disappears via the `api-session/removed` event.
- **Auto-repairs the default workspace**: DSH's built-in "Delete workspace", if it ever deleted the default one, leaves dangling pointers — its sessions fall into "Ungrouped" and new sessions can no longer be created. On startup this plugin rebuilds the registration and re-homes the sessions **for the default workspace only** (identified via `defaultWorkspaceId` or the last remembered path). Other workspaces you deleted on purpose are not "revived".

## Safety

- **Running sessions refuse deletion**: it uses the same `workspace/session-activity` detection as DSH's archive. Only genuinely running work (an in-flight conversation turn, background jobs, …) is blocked with "this session is running"; idle old sessions (even if still kept alive in DSH's memory) delete normally.
- Deletion goes through DSH's own workspace-registry write paths (`detachSession` / `unarchiveSession` / `unpinSession`), so persisted state stays consistent.
- Routes are same-origin fenced; only requests coming from the DSH UI itself are accepted.

## Install

This plugin targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and newer `0.2.x` releases (currently verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`), and is linked into the `desktop` profile as a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/dsh-session-delete"
```

Then **restart DSH** for it to take effect.

You can also edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` manually:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete": "link:/absolute/path/dsh-session-delete"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ... existing ...
        "@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart DSH.

## Usage

1. In the session list on the left, hover a session and click its "…".
2. Choose **Delete session**.
3. Click **Delete** in the confirmation dialog.

> ⚠️ Deletion is **permanent and irreversible**. Make sure the session really is no longer needed.

## Limitations / notes

- This is a community plugin built on DSH's public extension points (the session-menu slot `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` plus host-side file/registry cleanup). If a future DSH release ships an official "delete session" API, prefer that.
- Running sessions refuse deletion; if you really need one gone, stop it first (finish/archive its work) and then delete.
- The full-text search index is a rebuildable read model of DSH's; right after a delete there may be briefly stale results until the next rebuild.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete-cascade

**给 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：点会话旁的 `⋯` → 删除，连子会话一起清干净。**

npm 包名与仓库名都是 `dsh-session-delete-cascade`。

DeepSeek Harness 出于设计考虑**只提供归档，不提供删除**——会话可以隐藏，但永远不会被移除，日志会一直堆在磁盘上。这个插件把删除能力补回来，作为一个可随时卸载的 bundle，不动官方任何代码。

---

## 功能

- **侧栏菜单项**：会话行的 `⋯` 菜单里新增「删除会话」，排在「归档会话」之后
- **确认弹窗**：删之前告诉你到底会删掉什么，并**列出将被连带删除的子会话**
- **递归删除**：连同该会话的全部子代理子孙（孙代理也删），fork 会话不受影响
- **彻底清理**：对话日志、投影缓存、搜索索引、工作区记账，一处不留
- **安全护栏**：有任务在跑时拒绝删除并指明是哪个会话，不会删一半

## 安装

包已发布到 npm：**<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-delete-cascade>**

### 桌面端（DeepSeek Harness App）

**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，输入包名：

```
dsh-session-delete-cascade
```

也可以直接粘贴仓库地址 `https://github.com/Changqin1024/dsh-session-delete-cascade`。

装完**完全退出并重开 App**，侧栏会话的 `⋯` 菜单里就会出现「删除会话」。

> ⚠️ **桌面端的 profile 不能用 CLI 安装。** DSH 对 `desktop` profile 做了排他保护：
> `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。
> 桌面端请走上面的「设置 → 插件」。

### Web / CLI profile

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-delete-cascade
```

例如 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-delete-cascade`。装完重启该 profile。

从 GitHub 安装也可以（npm 之外的备选路径，会锁定到具体 commit）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Changqin1024/dsh-session-delete-cascade
```

### 卸载

桌面端：**设置 → 插件**，找到本插件点卸载。

CLI：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-delete-cascade`。

### 版本说明

`engines.dsh` 声明为 `>=0.2.0-rc.2`。本插件用到的
`ctx.connection.fetch.register` 在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证通过。

## 删除范围

在弹窗里点确认后，以下内容会被移除（针对目标会话**及其子代理血缘**）：

| 内容 | 位置 | 处理方式 |
|---|---|---|
| 对话历史 | `~/.dsh/sessions/<项目>/<会话ID>/`（append-only JSONL 日志） | 逐个删除目录 |
| 投影缓存（空会话标记、最后提问时间、标题等） | `session_projcache` 存储域 | 逐行删除 |
| 搜索索引行 | 会话搜索 SQLite 索引 | 日志消失后自动对账清除（索引观测的是持久化列表） |
| 工作区记账 | 每个工作区记录的 `sessionIds`，以及全局归档集、置顶集 | 逐项移除 |

**不删的东西**：按会话 ID 无法寻址的缓存，例如附件请求图缓存（`~/.dsh/cache/attachments/request-images/`）。清它需要先读日志拿内容哈希，代价不成比例；会话删掉后它也不会再出现在任何界面，后续按需重新生成。

## 血缘规则：什么算「子会话」

**子代理**（`origin: 'subagent'`）会被递归删除，包括子代理的子代理。

**fork 不算子会话。** fork 出来的会话虽然带 `parentSession` 字段，但没有 `subagent` 来源，它是独立对话，**会保留**。这条规则跟 DSH 自带归档门禁判定会话归属的规则完全一致。

- 弹窗会预览血缘：按标题列出子会话及数量
- toast 会汇报连带删除了几个
- 删子会话只删它自己的子树，父会话和兄弟会话不动

## 执行顺序与安全

删除严格按以下顺序，保证任何中间状态都不是撕裂的：

1. **收集血缘** — 从持久化 header 读，而不是从运行时的 Subagent catalog 读。这样即使中间某个会话读不出来，血缘依然完整。
2. **拒绝检查** — 只要血缘里**任何一个**会话还有工作在跑（进行中的回合、运行中的子代理、后台任务、定时提醒），就以 `session/delete-active` 拒绝，并在详情里列出**每一个**出问题的会话 ID 和它的活动类型。拒绝时不会删除任何东西。
3. **释放 Agent** — 深度优先（先子后父）。子会话的 loop 先排空，父会话的日志才会消失，避免迟到的结算打到已经不存在的父级。
4. 清**投影缓存**行
5. 删**日志目录**
6. 从**工作区记账**中移除

第 3～6 步都是**容错**的（失败只记日志、不抛错），避免某个派生存储卡死导致日志残留——日志才是侧栏会一直显示的那个东西。

## 实现说明

插件分 Host / Client 两半，通过 **Connection 上的 HTTP 路由**通信：

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半边：注册 `POST /api/session-delete.delete`，血缘遍历与有序删除 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：菜单行、带血缘预览的确认弹窗、结果提示（控件全部内联，无 Harness 包依赖） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入唯一一条 Host 插件行 |
| `package.json` | bundle 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` + web 端 `dsh.client` 配置 |
| `icon.svg`、`locale/*.json` | 插件管理页卡片元数据 |

## 验证清单

1. 侧栏悬停任一有内容的会话行，打开 `⋯` 菜单：**删除会话**是最后一项
2. 在一个有子代理的会话上点它：弹窗会写明保留边界，并列出将一并删除的子会话
3. 确认后：血缘里每一行都从侧栏消失，对应的 `~/.dsh/sessions/<项目>/<会话ID>/` 目录都不在了
4. 同一父会话 fork 出来的会话仍在侧栏
5. 侧栏搜索只存在于已删会话里的文字：无结果

## 已知边界

- 附件请求图缓存不清理，理由见上
- 血缘按持久化 header 遍历，因此**只覆盖已经落盘的会话**；纯内存中尚未 materialize 的子会话若不在 `session.list()` 里，不会被遍历到（实际使用中子会话总是先落盘）
- 删除是"整条血缘全或无"：任何一个后代在跑，整条都删不了。这是刻意的，半删会留下指向不存在父级的孤儿
- 客户端界面控件是内联实现而非复用宿主组件库。若 DSH 未来改动这些控件的视觉规范，插件需要跟进；代价换来的是不受宿主包变动影响

## 许可

MIT

## 相关

- DeepSeek Harness：https://www.deepseek.com/harness/
- 本插件未修改 DSH 任何文件，仅通过官方插件机制接入

plugins.description: DSH插件：会话页右上角「全屏」按钮，点击隐藏顶部标题栏（对话/轨迹 tabs）、底部输入框、左侧边栏；右侧边栏保持可打开，按钮落在整页最右上。再点或按 ESC 恢复。毛玻璃图标按钮，中英文文案。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-maximize

DSH 插件：会话页右上角「全屏」按钮。点击后隐藏顶部标题栏（对话/轨迹 tabs）、底部输入框、左侧边栏；右侧边栏保持可打开，按钮自然落在整页最右上。再点一次或按 `ESC` 恢复原样。

按钮采用毛玻璃风（半透明白底 + 模糊背景 + 细边框），仅保留全屏/退出图标，悬停时显示「全屏 / 退出全屏」提示。中英文文案自动跟随 DSH 语言。

## 功能

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 全屏开关 | 点击右上角按钮进入/退出全屏 |
| 隐藏顶栏 | 隐藏 `header[data-window-drag]`（含对话/轨迹 tabs） |
| 隐藏输入框 | 隐藏 `[data-composer-seat]` 与轨迹页的 `[data-conversation-composer-overlay]` |
| 折叠左栏 | 走 `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`，退出时还原进入前状态 |
| 右栏不动 | 右侧边栏开着时按钮仍在整页最右上角 |
| ESC 退出 | 按 `ESC` 或再次点击按钮恢复原样 |
| 状态持久 | 同一页切换会话（overlay 槽重挂载）保持全屏态 |

## 安装

本地安装（推荐用于自建 DSH 环境）：

```bash
# 克隆仓库
git clone https://github.com/ADkun/dsh-maximize.git
cd dsh-maximize

# 在 DSH profile 目录下以 bundle 形式安装（以 web profile 为例）
dsh plugin add ./dsh-maximize
# 或通过插件管理器加载 bundle
```

安装后**刷新页面**一次，客户端模块才会注册到 `shell.overlay` 插槽并显示按钮。

## 文件结构

```
dsh-maximize/
├── client.js        # 客户端半边：React 组件注入 shell.overlay 插槽
├── index.js         # 宿主半边：空实现（纯客户端插件）
├── cordis.patch.yml # Loader patch：注册 bundle id/name
├── package.json     # 包元数据，声明 dsh.client 平台 web
└── README.md
```

## 开发注意

`client.js` 运行在 DSH ModuleLoader 工厂垫片中，**不能**使用顶层 `import ... from 'react'`（裸说明符在工厂作用域外无法解析）。必须用工厂模式获取 React：

```js
window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
  id: 'dsh-maximize',
  factory(require) {
    const React = require('react');
    const { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } = React;
    const h = React.createElement;
    // ...
  },
});
```

文案通过 `ctx.locale.register('dsh-maximize', 'zh', {...})` / `bind('dsh-maximize')` 注册，遵循 DSH 本地化规范。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件 / skill：在 Boss 直聘求职者侧逐条浏览岗位，为每条 JD 生成只属于它的自我介绍并发给 HR —— 可见浏览器 + CDP 状态机 + 文案护栏，引擎零第三方依赖
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bossintroduce

> npm 包名与仓库名都是 `dsh-bossintroduce`，在 dsh 的插件页输入包名即可安装。
> 同一个仓库也是一份 skill：根目录有 `SKILL.md`，`scripts/` 是零第三方依赖的引擎，
> 拷进 `~/.workbuddy/skills/` 就能用，两种形态共用同一套代码。

在 Boss 直聘（**求职者侧**）替你在一个**可见的浏览器**里翻岗位，为每一条 JD 写一段
只属于它的自我介绍，发给那位 HR。

批量投递时，给每个岗位写一段"看起来是为它写的"开场话术很费神；但同一段话投所有岗位，
HR 一眼看穿，反而扣分。**这件事的全部价值在差异化** —— 同一个人，针对不同岗位点不同的名、
上不同的事实。所以这个插件做的不是"群发"，而是把**你的能力图谱**和**JD 的具体要求**
接起来，逐条产出不同的开场话术。

---

## 它怎么工作

三段式，各管一段，边界不重叠：

| 段 | 谁做 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 判断 | 模型 | 读 JD，决定投不投；决定拿哪条事实当主攻；写文案 |
| 动作 | `scripts/flow.mjs` | 查状态、点意向、读描述、翻卡片、点立即沟通、填入、发送 |
| 闸门 | `scripts/guard.py` | 文案在发出去之前必须过八项检查，退出码 0 才放行 |

状态判定与动作顺序**写死在执行器里**，运行时只查表 + 检查，不做推理 —— 模型每次重新
推导一遍"现在该点哪个按钮"，是这类自动化最不稳的地方。

```
HOME ──职位──> JOBS ──意向筛选──> 逐张读 JD ──匹配──> 立即沟通 ──> CHAT ──填入并发送──> 回 JOBS
                  ↑                                                              │
                  └──────────────────── back（自动切回意向）──────────────────────┘
```

三条约束是实测撞出来的，写进引擎而不是写进文档提醒：

- **岗位只从意向筛选列表里取。** 实测：意向列表在点过「立即沟通」后会**自行刷新**
  （已沟通的岗位移出、其余重排），而在默认推荐流里点完沟通，卡片和顺序纹丝不动 ——
  所以推荐流看起来"更稳"，但它永远给你同一批岗位。
- **一张一张看，不允许批量取列表。** 因为列表会重排，任何提前批量抓下来的清单
  （索引 / 标题 / 顺序）下一轮必然错位。
- **`back` 会落回默认推荐流**，意向筛选丢失。所以回列表这一步必须带意向标签重选，
  由执行器一步做完，不指望临场记得。

### 能力图谱：事实的唯一来源

自我介绍只能引用能力图谱里的条目，不得新增事实。图谱是一份 JSON，每人一份，抽自简历 /
公开仓库 / 自述，每条事实带 `jd_hits`（这条事实能回应哪些 JD 词）、`on_resume`
（在不在简历上）、`visibility`、`blacklist`（**不能怎么写**）。

`blacklist` 是最容易被漏、也最影响可信度的一项 —— 例："写「从零实现」，不写「自研引擎」"、
"不得写「完全独立完成」"、"不许搬业绩数字"。护栏会逐条检查，所以它不靠自觉。

### 文案护栏：不可撤回动作的最后一道闸

发出去的话收不回来，所以 `boss_say` 之前必须过 `boss_guard`。八项检查：

| 检查 | 口径 |
| --- | --- |
| 长度闸门 | 可见字符数落在预算区间（区间来自图谱 `writing_rules.budget`；不写则用引擎默认 120–200 字） |
| 禁用数字 | 白名单硬失败：只放行「有出处」的数字（日期、年份、版本号、指令集、院校背书） |
| 事实来源 | 文里至少有一个能在图谱里找到对应条目的实体 |
| 点名词 | 指定的 JD 原词确实出现在文里 |
| 主攻事实 | 声明的主攻事确实落在文里（私有仓库直接拒） |
| 未上简历项 | 引用了不在简历上的项目时，必须带上它**自己的**链接 |
| 黑名单 | 条目级 + 全局黑名单均未被触犯 |
| 可验证入口 | 文案里带公开主页（最强可验证信号） |

「默认零数字」值得单独说：提速倍数、测试条数、吞吐量、百分比这类**业绩数字一律不写**。
它们对 HR 的边际价值接近零，而且一眼就能看出是从一份通用材料里搬来的。

---

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 装（推荐）

dsh 桌面应用 → 插件页 → 添加插件 → 填 `dsh-bossintroduce` → 重启。

管理器做的事：`pnpm add dsh-bossintroduce` → 把它加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` →
包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 作为 **bundle 层自动生效**，用户不用手写任何配置。

**这个形态下插件不需要自带 `node_modules`** —— `@deepseek-ai/*` 那类 peer 由宿主自己解析。

### 方式二：绝对路径挂载（本地开发，改代码即生效）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RaganaBloodedge/dsh-bossintroduce.git
cd dsh-bossintroduce
npm install                                   # 顺带跑 prepare（即 tsc），产出 dist/

cp cordis.example.yml cordis.local.yml        # 把里面的 <本仓库的绝对路径> 换成真实路径
dsh --profile web --patch "<cordis.local.yml 的绝对路径>" --dump-config   # 只组合配置
dsh --profile web --patch "<cordis.local.yml 的绝对路径>"                 # 真启动
```

用绝对路径挂载时入口文件在 `node_modules` 之外，Node 找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*`，
所以必须先 `npm install`。

### 方式三：当 skill 用（WorkBuddy / 其它读 SKILL.md 的宿主）

把仓库整个拷到 `~/.workbuddy/skills/dsh-bossintroduce/`，然后照根目录的 `SKILL.md` 走。
这条路径不用 Node 依赖，只用 `scripts/` 里的引擎。

### 前置要求

| 需要 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Edge 或 Chrome | 插件会起一个**可见**的浏览器并开 CDP 调试端口；用 `browserPath` 指定绝对路径，留空自动发现 |
| Python 3 | 只有文案护栏需要；用 `pythonPath` 指定，留空自动发现 |
| Node ≥ 22.6 | 本地挂载/开发时需要；桌面应用内由宿主提供（Electron 下插件自动带 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，不需要另装） |

---

## 首次使用：初始化

```bash
node scripts/init.mjs              # 建数据目录 + 落「空图谱 + 投递配置」模板
node scripts/init.mjs --migrate    # 旧版把数据放在仓库目录里 → 迁到用户目录
node scripts/flow.mjs where        # 看引擎/数据/图谱/profile 到底解析到哪
```

然后**建能力图谱**（这一步必须由模型驱动，见 `references/01-能力图谱.md` 的八步）：
从简历 PDF / 公开仓库 / 自述里抽身份、教育、荣誉、经历、项目，逐条打 `jd_hits`、分档、
标 `on_resume`/`visibility`、写黑名单。做完把关键条目念给用户逐项确认 ——
图谱里每条事实都会变成发给 HR 的一句话。

投递配置写在数据目录的 `profile.md` 里：城市、意向标签、薪资左边界、学历门槛、
毕业时间窗口、循环次数 N。

---

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `boss_where` | 报告引擎/数据/图谱/profile/浏览器 profile 的解析结果（不连浏览器） |
| `boss_init` | 落初始化脚手架（可带 `migrate` 迁旧数据） |
| `boss_browser` | `status` 探 CDP 端口 / `launch` 起可见浏览器并等端口应答 |
| `boss_state` | 当前状态 + 登录判定（**每次开工第一件事**） |
| `boss_wait_login` | 停在登录页等用户登录完（仅在 `boss_state` 判出 LOGIN 后调用） |
| `boss_enter` | HOME → 岗位页 |
| `boss_pick` | 切到某个意向的岗位列表（`label` / `index` / `list`） |
| `boss_read` | 读右侧职位描述 |
| `boss_next_card` | 选下一张卡片（事件派发，不跳页） |
| `boss_contact` | 点「立即沟通」→ 聊天页 |
| `boss_say` | **填入并发送**（不可撤回）；不给 `text` 则发送框里已有的内容 |
| `boss_back` | 回岗位列表并**自动切回意向**（一定要带 label） |
| `boss_recover` | 失败态出口：回 HOME |
| `boss_guard` | 文案护栏，退出码 0 才允许发送 |

插件还会往系统提示词里加一节，说明开工顺序与红线 —— 否则模型只看到十四个孤立的工具名，
会把它当浏览器遥控器乱点。

### 一轮循环

```
boss_state → [LOGIN？让用户登录 + boss_wait_login]
boss_enter → boss_pick --label "<意向标签>" → boss_read → 硬过滤 + 匹配判断
   ├ 不匹配 → boss_next_card → boss_read → …
   └ 匹配   → 取 JD 头号要求 → 从图谱挑一条最相关的事实当主攻
              → 按图谱口径写文案（语气 + 长度，见 `references/02`）→ boss_guard（退出码 0）
              → boss_contact → boss_say → boss_back --label → 下一条
```

凑满 N 份即停，报清单：岗位 / HR / 公司 / 薪资 / 主攻事实 / 文案首句。

---

## 已知坑

都是实测踩出来的。违反了不报错，只是行为不对：

| 症状 | 原因 | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 明明发成功却报「最后一条消息不是刚发的文案」 | 早期把我方消息的类名猜成了 `item-mine`，实际是 `item-myself` | 已修；气泡文本可能带「已读」尾巴，所以用前缀包含比对 |
| 刚填入就点发送，报「按钮是禁用态」 | 编辑器状态是异步同步的，填入后按钮会短暂 `disabled` | 已修：等它变可点（≤6s）再点 |
| 按坐标点发送点空，且没有任何报错 | 页面比窗口宽，按钮落在视口右边外面 | 已修：先 `scrollIntoView` 再量，不在视口内就明确报错 |
| 中文输入框里塞进去的内容被插件改写 | 用了 CDP 的 `Input.insertText` 之外的路径 | 引擎走 `innerText` 直写并**读回比对**，不一致就报错 |
| `boss_state` 在登录页误判成已登录 | 早期判据是"找不到登录入口"，而登录页上就有登录入口 | 已修：抽成纯函数 `decideLogin`，真值表回归 |
| 从 HOME 点「消息」进岗位页 | 消息页没有选中 HR，右侧没有输入框 ⇒ CHAT_FAIL | 别点消息，用 `boss_enter`；进了失败态一律 `boss_recover`，不手动补救 |
| 点卡片结果跳到了职位详情页 | 卡片 hover 会浮出「立即沟通」浮层，鼠标命中浮层 | 选卡片用事件派发，不用鼠标点 |
| 窗口最小化后什么都点不到 | 坐标点击依赖元素尺寸，最小化时尺寸为 0 | 保持窗口可见 |
| `taskkill` 之后用户得重新登录 | 那会连用户已登录的浏览器一起杀掉 | **绝不 taskkill 清场**；要停就停启动它的那个任务 |

---

## 数据在哪

**引擎与个人数据是分开的**，所以升级/分享/发布插件都不会碰到你的数据：

| | 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 引擎 | 包目录（`SKILL.md` / `scripts` / `references` / `assets` / `dist`） | 流程、执行器、护栏、模板 |
| 个人数据 | `$AI_HOME/data`（默认 `~/.auto-introduce/data`） | `capability-graph.json`、`profile.md`、`resume-raw.txt`、`drafts/` |
| 浏览器登录态 | `$AI_HOME/edge-profile` | 已登录的浏览器 profile |

解析顺序（Node 与 Python 同一套口径，见 `scripts/paths.mjs`）：
`AI_DATA_DIR` → `$AI_HOME/data` → `<包目录>/data`（旧版遗留，仅在确实存在时才用并提示迁移）。

随包发布的只有引擎。`scripts/pack.mjs` 打可分发副本时会再扫一遍**有没有夹带个人数据**
（图谱、profile、简历、浏览器缓存），有就报错退出。

---

## 自检

```bash
npm run selftest          # 引擎 + 图谱结构一起过（离线，不需要浏览器）
node scripts/flow.mjs where
```

自检在**没有个人图谱的全新环境**下也能全绿（图谱相关断言正确跳过），
所以它是"这个包收到了就能用"的最低保证。

---

## 发版（维护者）

```bash
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version    # 或 minor / major
git commit -am "chore(release): x.y.z"
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

三件容易踩的事：

- **本机默认 registry 往往是镜像**（`registry.npmmirror.com`），它只读、不能发布 —— 必须显式带
  `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`。
- **新包的第一个版本不会直接上线。** npm 2026 年起启用了暂存发布（staged publishing）：首次
  `publish` 只是把版本提交到暂存区，registry 上会出现一个 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版，真实版本要到
  npmjs.com 的 **Staged Packages** 里点 Approve 才上线（这一步需要 2FA）。**同包的后续版本直接
  上线、不再进暂存。**
- **发布凭证。** npm 现在强制「账号开着 2FA」或「一个勾了 Bypass 2FA 的 granular access token」
  才能发布 —— 关掉 2FA 反而会拿到
  `403 Two-factor authentication or granular access token with bypass 2fa enabled is required`。
  需要非交互发布时，建一个 bypass-2FA 的 granular token（Packages and scopes 给 Read and write），
  临时写进**项目内** `.npmrc`（已在 `.gitignore` 里），发完即删。

---

## License

MIT © 2026 Li Yichen (李依宸)

plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天装进 DSH 桌面版面板：侧栏入口 + 工具栏 + 本地登录快照。 | Embed the DeepSeek web chat in a DSH Desktop main panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dschat

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dschat)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://github.com/Jakcet/dsh-dschat/blob/main/LICENSE)

把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（[chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com/)）装进 **DSH 桌面版**的面板里。

侧栏会多一个「DeepSeek 网页版」图标，点开就是一个主面板，里面用 Electron `<webview>` 原样载入网页版，工具栏可以后退、前进、刷新、回首页、在系统浏览器打开。登录在 DeepSeek 自己的页面上完成，插件不接触你的密码。

> 这个面板需要 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`，它只由 DSH 桌面版的 preload 暴露；Web 版只会显示一行提示。

## 功能

- **侧栏入口 + 主面板**：keyed panel，图标是蓝色鲸鱼气泡。
- **工具栏**：后退、前进、刷新、回 DeepSeek 首页、当前地址、在系统浏览器中打开。
- **原样加载** `https://chat.deepseek.com/`，不改页面、不注入脚本（只在你登录后读一次 `localStorage` 做快照）。
- **登录快照**：DSH 侧栏浏览器的 partition 是进程内内存分区，应用重启就丢 cookie。登录后插件把页面 `localStorage` 里登录相关的键备份到 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json`（权限 `0600`），下次载入时先回填、再刷新页面。
  能不能因此完全跳过登录页，取决于网页版把会话放在哪里：`httpOnly` cookie 不在快照范围内。

## 安装

在 DSH 插件市场里搜索 `dsh-dschat` 安装，或手动作为 bundle 装进你的 DSH profile：

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## 要求

- **DSH 桌面版**（依赖 preload 暴露的 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`）。
- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。

## 它是怎么工作的

1. 主面板挂载时，client 半部向 DSH 桌面版的 preload 桥申请一个 guest：`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspace)`。
2. 拿到 `{ lease, partition }` 后创建 `<webview>`，`name` 填 lease、`partition` 填 partition、`src` 填 `about:blank#<lease>`；DSH 主进程会在 `will-attach-webview` 里校验 lease 和 partition，通过后才真正挂载。
3. pages 加载完成（`dom-ready`）后 `loadURL('https://chat.deepseek.com/')`。
4. 登录态变化后，把 `localStorage` 里键名匹配 `token/user/auth/session/login` 的字符串值 POST 给插件的 host 路由，写到本地快照文件；下次打开时先回填再刷新。
5. 面板卸载时 `bridge.release(lease)` 释放 guest。

因为走的是和内置侧栏浏览器同一套 lease 校验、sandbox 与导航策略，插件本身拿不到 Electron/Node 权限。

## 已知限制（来自 DSH 宿主策略，插件绕不过去）

- guest 内发起的**下载会被取消**。
- 通知、麦克风、剪贴板等**权限请求一律拒绝**。
- 窗口打开请求会转成同面板内导航。
- 浏览器 partition 每次启动重建，用公开 API 做不到「完全零登录」重启。
- 只有桌面版可用，Web 版不工作。

## 隐私

插件不代理、不抓取、不转发任何内容，只渲染官方页面并保留一份本地快照。快照里可能有登录相关数据的明文，请当作 cookie 文件对待，不要分享；删掉 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` 即可清除快照。

## 文件

- `index.js` — host 半部：快照与日志的 HTTP 路由，以及一次性的客户端模块清单缓存刷新。
- `client.js` — client 半部：侧栏图标、主面板、webview 生命周期、工具栏。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch。
- `icon.svg` — 插件图标。

## License

MIT

---

# English

Embed the DeepSeek web chat (`chat.deepseek.com`) in a **DSH Desktop** main panel.

A sidebar entry opens a keyed main panel that hosts the real DeepSeek web app inside an
Electron `<webview>` guest, requested from the DSH desktop preload bridge
(`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire`) so it goes through the same main-process lease
check, sandbox flags and navigation policy as the built-in sidebar browser.

## What it does

- Adds a **DeepSeek Web** entry to the sidebar icon list and a main panel.
- Toolbar: back, forward, reload, home, current URL, open in system browser.
- Loads `https://chat.deepseek.com/` unmodified. Sign-in happens on DeepSeek's own page;
  the plugin never sees or stores your password.
- **Login snapshot.** DSH's sidebar-browser partition is a process-local in-memory
  partition, so cookies are gone after an app restart. After you sign in, the plugin copies
  login-related `localStorage` keys to `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` (mode `0600`) and
  restores them on the next load before reloading the page. Whether that is enough to skip
  the sign-in screen depends on where DeepSeek keeps the session: `httpOnly` cookies are
  not part of the snapshot.

## Install

Install it from the DSH plugin market (search for `dsh-dschat`), or add this package as a
bundle to your DSH profile:

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## Requirements

- **DSH Desktop.** The panel needs `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`, which only the desktop
  preload exposes. In the web build the panel shows a notice and does nothing.
- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

## Known limits (enforced by the DSH host, not by this plugin)

- Downloads started inside the guest are cancelled.
- Permission requests (notifications, microphone, clipboard) are denied.
- Window-open requests are turned into navigation in the same panel.
- The browser partition is recreated on every app start, so a fully zero-login restart is
  not possible with the public host API.

## Privacy

The plugin does not proxy, scrape or forward anything. It renders the official page and
keeps one local snapshot file. That file can contain login-related values in plain text;
treat it like a cookie jar and do not share it. Delete it to forget the snapshot.

## License

MIT
