plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: The real DeepSeek Harness Desktop UI on your iPhone, over Tailscale. No second Host, no reimplementation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Phone Bridge

The real DeepSeek Harness UI. On your iPhone. Over Tailscale.

--- DSH Phone Bridge is a small Host plugin plus a SwiftUI iPhone app that opens the **real DeepSeek Harness Desktop UI** on your phone. It does not run a second Host, copy your sessions, or reimplement the client. The Desktop Host remains the only writer; the phone is a secure window into it. Tailscale is the network boundary. The bridge opens exactly one listener on a `100.64.0.0/10` address, gates it with a paired-device cookie, and reverse-proxies HTTP and WebSocket traffic into the Host's existing loopback server.

The real web client, rendered by the iPhone app and connected to the desktop Host.

## Why this exists The shipped DSH web client already knows how to render sessions, tools, terminal output, approvals, plans, jobs, and subagents. Rebuilding that on iOS would be a permanent catch-up game. Running a second Host on the tailnet would create a second writer and a different profile. So the bridge does the smallest useful thing: - **one Host**, the one you already use; - **one tailnet listener**, bound to one address; - **one real UI**, rendered in `WKWebView`; - **one device credential**, stored in the iPhone Keychain. ## What you get - **The real client.** No native reimplementation, no reduced “mobile mode.” - **Tailscale-only by construction.** No `0.0.0.0`, no LAN fallback, no public port. Startup refuses anything outside `100.64.0.0/10`. - **Pair once.** Scan a QR in **Settings → Phone**. Manual code and paste-link fallbacks are built in. - **Fast, clean revocation.** Revoking a device invalidates its next request immediately and closes every WebSocket it owns. - **A phone that behaves like a console.** Foreground reconnect, offline banner, reload, and a settings sheet with live diagnostics. - **No launch token on the phone.** The Host launch token never leaves the desktop process; the Host cookie is injected only on the loopback side. ## How it works ```text ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ iPhone │ │ SwiftUI shell + WKWebView │ │ dsh-phone cookie in Keychain │ └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ Tailscale (WireGuard) ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ Host plugin │ │ 100.64.x.x:8787 │ │ device-cookie gate │ │ HTTP + WebSocket reverse │ │ proxy, header rewriting │ └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ loopback only ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ Running DSH Desktop Host │ │ sessions, tools, approvals │ └──────────────────────────────┘ ``` The phone never sees the Host's loopback port, launch token, or `dsh-auth-…` cookie. The plugin replaces the phone cookie with the Host cookie on the way in, and strips every `Set-Cookie` on the way out. ## Install ### 1. Host plugin ```sh git clone https://github.com/Adolanium/dsh-phone.git cd dsh-phone sh scripts/install-dev.sh ``` Restart DeepSeek Harness when no turn or job is running. Open **Settings → Phone**. The page shows the tailnet address, a live QR, the pairing code, the device list, and diagnostics. Windows PowerShell equivalents are in `scripts/install-dev.ps1` and `scripts/uninstall-dev.ps1`; they are provided but have not been exercised on Windows. ### 2. iPhone app ```sh cd apps/ios open DSHPhone.xcodeproj ``` Set your Apple team in **Signing & Capabilities**, choose your iPhone, and Run. The app targets iOS 17+ and has no third-party dependencies. For the Simulator: ```sh xcodebuild \ -project DSHPhone.xcodeproj \ -scheme DSHPhone \ -sdk iphonesimulator \ -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro Max,OS=27.0' \ -derivedDataPath build \ build ``` See [apps/ios/README.md](apps/ios/README.md) for signing, Simulator pairing, and the debug launch seams. ### 3. Pair 1. Open **Settings → Phone** in DSH. 2. In the app, point the camera at the QR. 3. Or enter the 8-character code manually, or paste a `dshphone://pair` link. The QR code is single-use and expires after 120 seconds. The resulting device cookie is stored in the Keychain and in WebKit's cookie store. ## Security model | Property | How it is enforced | |---|---| | Tailscale-only | Listener binds one asserted `100.64.0.0/10` address; no wildcard or loopback fallback | | No public exposure | No Funnel, no port forwarding, no LAN bind | | Launch token never leaves the Host | Minted in-process; used only for the loopback cookie exchange | | Host cookie never reaches the phone | Injected upstream; every upstream `Set-Cookie` stripped | | Device credential at rest | 32 random bytes; only a SHA-256 hash is stored on the Host | | Pairing codes | 8 Crockford base32 characters; 120 s; single use; hashed in memory; rate-limited | | Admin surface | Loopback-only, `x-dsh-phone-admin: 1`, known Origin, no CORS | | Revocation | Next request is 401; upgraded sockets are destroyed immediately | | Phone storage | Device cookie in the Keychain; no token in `UserDefaults` or URLs | | Pairing page | Code travels in the URL fragment, never in a request line or log | ## Inside the repo ```text apps/ios/ SwiftUI app, Xcode project, tests packages/dsh-plugin-phone-bridge/ lib/ Host plugin, proxy, pairing, QR, Settings UI test/ 80 node:test cases scripts/ install/uninstall for macOS/Linux and Windows docs/banner.png README hero ``` ## Development ```sh node --test packages/dsh-plugin-phone-bridge/test # tests 80, pass 80 cd apps/ios xcodebuild \ -project DSHPhone.xcodeproj \ -scheme DSHPhone \ -sdk iphonesimulator \ -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro Max,OS=27.0' \ -derivedDataPath build \ test # 5 PairingLink tests, 5 pass ``` The plugin has no runtime dependencies. The iOS app has no third-party dependencies. The plugin's tests run without a tailnet, using a mock upstream. ## Status **1.0.0.** Verified on macOS 27 with a physical iPhone 14 Pro Max (iOS 27.0.1) and the iOS 27 Simulator. Known limits: - The listener port is configured in the profile (default `8787`), not exposed in the app. - No push notifications yet; approvals appear when the app is foregrounded. - Windows installers exist but are unexercised. - Forced Tailscale outage and host sleep/wake are not part of the automated test suite. ## License MIT © [Adolanium](https://github.com/Adolanium)

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: DSH 话匣子：让模型边做边说、卡住了就开口、把提问讲清楚，而不是闷头自己扛。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chatterbox（话匣子）

往系统提示里注入一段**常驻互动协议**的 DSH 插件：让「话少、爱自己扛、爱反复自查」的模型回到
**边说边做**的默认节奏。

- **边做边说**：动手前先说要做什么，做完一小段就聊两句，不把话攒到最后。
- **卡住了就开口**：需要人类的东西直接说；换目标、缩范围、弱化结论，都是他的决定，不必一个人扛。
- **把提问讲清楚**：默认在对话里问，先给背景和推荐；只有「挑一个」本身替人省力时才给选项。
- **验证有预算**：一次独立核查通常就够，把「已核对 / 待核对 / 已知风险」分开写。
- **说人话**：中文、短句、先说事实再给判断。

**默认对所有模型生效**（`modelPattern: ''` = 普适模式）；**陪伴模式默认不注入**（`skipPresets`）。

插件的语言刻意是**邀请式**的，不是纠错式：协议里不出现「失误」「悄悄」「废话」这类把人当小孩的词
（`node --test` 里有一条用例专门守这件事）。要求模型「说人话、别表演」，它自己先得是那个语气。

```
安装（本地目录）：plugin_manager action: install_bundle  target: "C:\Users\29411\dsh\插件\dsh-chatterbox"
安装（npm）：     dsh-chatterbox
安装（Release）： https://github.com/Astepluver/dsh-chatterbox/releases/latest/download/dsh-chatterbox.tgz
```

---

## 它解决什么（诊断结论，不是猜测）

「新模型话变少了、爱自己扛、爱反复自查」这三个现象，在本机逐条查过：

| 事实 | 证据 |
|---|---|
| 宿主里**没有任何**按 model id 分支的提示词、工具或 loop 逻辑 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/lib/index.js` 的 `system-prompt/assemble` 监听器只把 `provider`/`model` 当**变量**塞进装配结果，没有 `if (model === …)` |
| 两份 shipped 预设的人设逐字相同 | `dsh-web-app/presets/{standard,ptc}.patch.yml:14` 都是 `You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.` |
| 「1017」是**界面徽章**，不是 model id | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deepseek-model-label-1017`：`lib/client.js` 只在 `provider ∈ {deepseek-account, deepseek-official} && model.id === 'deepseek-flash' && model.name === 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash'` 时加徽章；它的 host 半边是空的 `function apply() {}`。整个 `app.asar`（1.8 亿字节）字节扫描 `flash-1017` 命中 **0** |
| 本机两条 DeepSeek 路由的 model id | 官方 `deepseek-account/deepseek-flash`（界面挂 1017 徽章的那条）与网关 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`——**都不含 1017** |
| shipped 提示词里**没有一条**要求「工具调用之间叙述进展」 | 全仓最接近的只有 `dsh-tool-todo/lib/index.js:21` 的 `… to plan multi-step work and show progress` |

结论：没有一条现成文本把「边做边说」拉住，模型自己的默认脾气一变，行为就直接变了；
而把白名单钉在发布日期上（`1017`）必然过时。所以默认人人有份，`modelPattern` 只留作**排除**某个模型的旋钮。

另外，「反复自查」有一部分来自**用户自己的预设**而不是模型：本 profile 的「分析模式」人设
（`profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）写着「反复检验分析过程」「能对拍就必须对拍」
「报告之前回头对一遍」。本插件**不动别人的预设**，只是把「验证要有预算」放回系统提示，让两种力量互相平衡。

## 机制

```
apply(ctx, config)
  └─ ctx.effect(() => ctx.systemPrompt.section({
        name: 'plugin:chatterbox',      // 全局唯一
        order: 720,                      // dsh-methodology 700 · PTC_ONLY 800
        interpolate: false,              // 关键：见下
        text: (context) => sectionText(...)   // 每个模型步骤前重新求值
     }))
```

- **`interpolate: false` 是必需的**：`section` 默认会做 `{{变量}}` 插值，宿主在渲染期严格解析，
  未知/畸形引用**直接 throw**；那个 throw 发生在 agent-loop 的 `renderPrompt()` 里，
  插件的 try/catch 拦不到，会让**每一轮根会话**以 error 收尾（2026-10-17 实测复现）。
  关掉之后，`extra` 里写 `{{` 也只是字面量。
- 段落文本为空串时宿主直接丢掉这一段（关掉分条不会留下空壳）。
- 每次 `assemble()` 重新求值（在 `agent/pre-step`、`agent/request` 之前），按会话/preset/模型逐步生效。
- 与 `dsh-methodology` 用同一个注册点、同一种零依赖写法（裸 config，不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，
  也不导出 `Config`），order 排在其后，两者不冲突。
- **所有异常路径都兜底**：段落求值、模型读取、诊断写入都不可能影响 prompt 装配；
  求值真的失败时会在诊断文件里留一条 `kind: "error"`，而不是静默消失。

## 配置（在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件行里覆盖）

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；false 时不注册任何东西 |
| `order` | `720` | 段落排序值 |
| `modelPattern` | `''` | **空 = 所有模型**；填子串（如 `deepseek`）或 `/正则/` 即收窄 |
| `matchProvider` | `true` | 收窄时是否连 provider 一起匹配（`provider/model` 整体） |
| `whenModelUnknown` | `'apply'` | 收窄时拿不到模型身份的兜底 |
| `scope` | `'root'` | `root` 只给根会话；`all` 连子代理一起给 |
| `skipPresets` | `['companion']` | 这些 preset 不注入（按会话 header 的 `agentPreset` 精确匹配），比 `scope` 更强 |
| `narrate` / `askInConversation` / `questionBox` / `verificationBudget` / `plainSpeech` | `true` | 五条分条的开关 |
| `extra` | `''` | 追加到协议末尾的文本（字面量注入，不插值） |
| `reassertAfterSilentSteps` | `6` | **连续多少步没出一句文字就重申一次**（0 = 关）。长会话对抗稀释的主力 |
| `reassertOnCompaction` | `true` | 每次压缩之后重申一次 |
| `reassertEveryTurns` | `0` | 另外按轮重申：每 N 轮一次（0 = 关；默认关，上面那条更准） |
| `reminder` | 见 `cordis.patch.yml` | 重申文本（两三行，落在历史末尾） |
| `diagnostics` | `true` | 每次求值记一行 JSON |
| `diagnosticsPath` | `''` | 留空 = 插件目录下 `.state/diagnostics.jsonl`（相对路径按进程 cwd 解析） |
| `diagnosticsMaxLines` | `500` | 超过就丢掉前一半；硬上限 5000 |

模型身份按三来源取，先拿到先用：**assemble 瀑布观测到的 `provider`/`model` → `agent.options`
→ `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`**。普适模式下完全不查模型身份。

## 长会话里为什么会「变淡」，以及重申

朋友反馈「聊久了 chatterbox 就失效，模型重新变沉默」。逐条查过，结论分两半：

**一、不是提示词没送到。** 循环自己的投影函数保证「线上最新一条非空 system 消息 = 当前渲染出来的
提示词」：提示词与线上不一致时，要么原地重写 node 0，要么追加一条新的
（`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:264-282`；压缩的范围永远从 index ≥ 1 开始，`node 0` 不受遮蔽）。
唯一能挡住已注册段落的机制是 `complete: true` 段（`dsh-system-prompt` 收尾只保留那一段），
本机没有任何插件用它。而且 in-history 路由的真实故障模式是**抛错**（`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`），
不是变冷淡。⇒ 「压缩把段落吞掉了」这个解释被证伪。

**二、是模型侧遵守度在衰减。** 本机实测同一台机器上两条装了本插件的会话，助手「带文字」的比例：

```
消息区间    带文字比例
   1- 20        80%
  21- 40        50%
  41- 60        75%
  61- 80        40%
  81-100        35%
 101-120        50%
 121-140        45%
 141-160        65%
 161-180        15%   ← 长取证过程
 181-189        11%
```

关键细节：掉到 11% 的那一整段沉默发生在**同一个 user turn 里**（约 60 步）。所以修法不是
「每 N 轮再说一遍」（那一轮里一次都不会触发），而是**按「连续多少步没说话」触发**：
`reassertAfterSilentSteps`。触发时插件会把一行极短的提醒，作为 runtime-context 快照
**追加到历史末尾**——也就是离模型最近的位置。

代价：每条重申约 110 字；模型只要正常说话就不会触发。

## 怎么确认它真的生效

看诊断文件（默认 `<插件目录>/.state/diagnostics.jsonl`），每次求值一行。**本机实测**：

```json
{"time":"…","kind":"section","sessionId":"session-4aa0a2f4-…","origin":null,"model":"deepseek-flash","provider":"deepseek-account","apply":true,"reason":"no-pattern（普适模式）"}
{"time":"…","kind":"section","sessionId":"e14f9dcf-…","origin":"subagent","model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash","provider":"opencode-go","apply":false,"reason":"scope=root 且本会话是子代理"}
{"time":"…","kind":"reassert","sessionId":"session-…","count":1,"trigger":"silent:6"}
{"time":"…","kind":"prompt-missing","sessionId":"session-…","seq":699,"len":10414,"turns":4}
```

- `kind:"section"`：装配层拿到（或没拿到）文本，附理由。
- `kind:"reassert"`：重申了一次，`trigger` 是 `silent:N` / `compaction` / `turns:N`。
- `kind:"prompt-missing"`：**某个系统提示里没有本段落**。这是「模型没看到」与
  「模型看到了但不照做」唯一客观的分界——朋友那边再出现变淡时，先看有没有这一行。

更强的证据：真实会话日志里，根会话那一步的 system message 依次是
identity(0) → persona(50) → methodology(1969) → **chatterbox(3133)** → sci-viz(750)——
段落确实进了模型看到的内容，不是「注册了但没生效」。

## 已验证 / 未验证

**已验证**：`node --test` 23 例全绿（门控/语气/诊断/异常路径，含「纠错腔词表」、
「注册必须带 `interpolate:false`」两条守卫）；`node --check`；安装结果 `application: applied`
且 `Config.listConfigs` 能查到行；`apply: true`/`false` 两条分支在真实会话里各跑出过；
段落文本在真实 prompt 中的位置已核对；`npm pack --dry-run` 产物齐全；
命名声明过 `validate-names.mjs`；`query-registry.mjs` 查过中央索引（未被登记）。

**重申链路已在真机跑通（2026-10-18，0.2.0）**，四段证据闭合：

```
1) 诊断 {"kind":"loaded","reassertAfterSilentSteps":6,…}                  ← 新版被加载
2) 诊断 {"kind":"reassert","count":1,"trigger":"silent:6"}                 ← 连续 6 步没说话触发
3) 会话日志 seq=1670  user/message  source=runtime-context  894 字         ← 提醒被追加到历史末尾
4) 模型侧：那一轮运行时上下文里确实出现了「（提醒 · 互动习惯）」两行提醒      ← 送到了
```

另外用真实事件流回放新代码：748 个装配点、首次重申落在历史里那段沉默的起点。

**未验证**：让模型**更愿意说话**这件事本身。机制（段落 + 重申 + 触发）可证、「模型因此变得更好聊」
不可证。DSH 自带的市场索引校验器在 `app.asar` 内，Node 无法 import，`market/index.json`
是按校验器源码逐条实现 + 本地 `--check` 保持一致，尚未被官方校验器实跑过。

## 已知限制

- **软引导，不是硬约束**：本插件不拦任何工具调用。需要机器强制的地方（例如子代理只读）
  应该用 `ctx.tools.guard` 另写。
- 不改变 `ask_user_question` 的存在：工作区里明确要求用提问框的流程照旧可用。
- 只给根会话（`scope: 'root'`）：子代理与 Agent Teams 队友拿不到（他们对面不是人；
  队友与一次性子代理共用 `origin: 'subagent'`）。想让队友也有，把 `scope` 改成 `'all'`。
- 同一层里段落名必须唯一：把本 bundle 同时挂进 profile 和某个 preset 会**同步抛错**（不是静默覆盖）。
- **token 成本**：默认配置下段落约 1.1k 字（中文），随每次请求常驻，属于系统提示里的稳定前缀。
- 改 `scope` / 开关会让系统提示前缀变化，从而失效一次提示缓存复用。
- 诊断文件只按行数上限截断，不做轮转；每步一次读+写（实测 ~0.3 ms/次）。

## 发布与收录

本机已有一套跑通过的流程（桌面 `插件发布`，dsh-sci-viz 用过），本仓库配套一份同样的工具包：

| 步骤 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 在 GitHub 建 **Public** 仓库 `Astepluver/dsh-chatterbox`（三个勾都不勾） |
| 2 | 把「上传用」文件夹里的东西全选拖进仓库（网页上传，绕开本机 Git 凭据问题） |
| 3 | About → ⚙️ → **Topics 填这 6 个**：`dsh-plugin`、`dsh-plugins`、`dsh-plugin-desktop`、`dsh-desktop`、`dsh-plugin-market`、`deepseek-harness` |
| 4 | 发 **Release**：tag `v0.1.0`，附件名必须正好是 **`dsh-chatterbox.tgz`** |
| 5 | （可选）双击 `❹ 发布到 npm.cmd`，别人就能用一行包名安装 |

**「收录的 tag 要求」就在这里**：第三方采集程序（`插件\dsh-plugin-mesh\backend\dsh_mesh\config.py:42-49`）
只看**两条**——topic 命中白名单，或**仓库名以 `dsh-` 开头**（`build.py:295-299`）；
无 topic 且描述短于 10 字会被丢弃（`build.py:287-289`）。0 星也能收录。

另外有一套**与上面无关**的机制：DSH 的实验性「自定义插件市场」（Plugins → Discover），
它读的是用户自己加的 index URL，格式为 **format 1**，硬规则见 [`market/README.md`](market/README.md)——
其中 `category` / `labels[]` 必须在索引自己的 `metadata` 里声明过，那是另一层"tag 要求"。

plugins.description: Automatic, versioned backup of your DeepSeek Harness home to your own private git repository. Cross-platform, configurable, never silent about failures.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-sync

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DeepSeek Harness 插件，将 DSH home 目录自动纳入版本控制并推送到用户自有的 git 远端。

插件把 DSH 写入 home 的内容作为工作树管理：会话记录、记忆文件、设置、profile 插件及其依赖树，另可镜像指定的项目目录。目标远端由用户指定；插件不连接本项目运营的任何服务器，也不携带任何凭据。

---

## 目录

- [备份范围](#备份范围)
- [设计约束](#设计约束)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
- [环境要求](#环境要求)
- [安装](#安装)
- [首次运行](#首次运行)
- [`/dsh-sync` 命令](#dsh-sync-命令)
- [设置页](#设置页)
- [配置](#配置)
- [备份线](#备份线)
- [恢复](#恢复)
- [安全模型](#安全模型)
- [运行行为](#运行行为)
- [排错](#排错)
- [开发](#开发)
- [许可](#许可)

---

## 备份范围

| 状态 | 典型位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话记录 | `<home>/sessions/**` |
| 记忆文件 | `<home>/memories/**`、`<home>/memory/**` |
| 配置 | `<home>/settings.yaml` |
| Profile 插件 | `<home>/profiles/<name>/` |
| 项目工作 | 用户指定的目录（可选） |

凭据文件 `<home>/.credentials.yaml` 默认被排除，见[安全模型](#安全模型)。

## 设计约束

1. **存储位置由用户控制。** 远端为普通 git 仓库：私有 GitHub 或 GitLab 仓库、内网服务器、NAS 上的裸仓库。
2. **失败必须可见。** 停止工作却没有提示的备份工具比没有备份更糟。每次运行的结果都会记录；备份线超过 48 小时未成功会在 DSH 日志中报告。

---

## 工作原理

插件经 profile 的 bundle 层注册，运行在宿主进程中。它只负责调度：热备份线在进程内完成小规模提交，完整快照以分离进程运行，避免应用退出截断快照。

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────┐
   turn/end ───────▶│  热备份线（进程内）           │──▶ 分支  dsh-hot
    定时 ───────────▶│  复制 → 提交 → 推送           │
                    └──────────────────────────────┘

                    ┌──────────────────────────────┐
   定时 ───────────▶│  cold-sync.mjs（分离进程）    │──▶ 分支  dsh-snapshot
   关闭 ───────────▶│  镜像 → 提交 → 推送           │
                    └──────────────────────────────┘
                                  │
                                  └───────────────▶ workspace-sync.mjs
                                                    分支  dsh-workspace
```

每条备份线独占一个分支和一份独立的 git 工作区副本，因此任意两条线不会争用同一个 index——这是并发备份产生 `index.lock: File exists` 的原因。退出时的快照不会与热备份提交冲突。

配置按以下优先级读取：

1. profile 补丁中 Cordis 条目的 `config`；
2. `<home>/sync-plugin/config.json`；
3. 内置默认值。

配置文件已声明的键优先于补丁层：插件管理器会重写 profile 补丁，而配置文件由用户维护。

---

## 环境要求

| 组件 | 版本 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` | 声明为可选 peer，不阻止更高版本 |
| Node.js | `^22.19 \|\| >= 24` | 随 DSH 安装提供 |
| git | 2.30+ | 须在 `PATH` 中，启动时探测 |

目录镜像、加锁与进程管理均由 Node 内置模块实现，不调用平台特化工具。

---

## 安装

### 从桌面应用安装

1. 在侧栏打开**插件**页。
2. 选择**添加插件**，填入本目录的绝对路径。
3. 启用 `dsh-auto-sync` 组合包。
4. 重启 DeepSeek Harness。

### 从命令行安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-auto-sync
```

---

## 首次运行

首次启动且无配置时，插件写入一份带说明的模板到 `<home>/sync-plugin/config.json`，并记录一条警告：在设置 `remote` 之前备份处于暂停状态。

设置远端有两种方式。

命令方式（无需重启）：

```text
/dsh-sync setup git@github.com:you/dsh-backup.git
```

编辑配置文件后重启：

```json
{
  "remote": "git@github.com:you/dsh-backup.git"
}
```

下次启动时，插件初始化仓库、为每条启用的备份线创建分支与工作区副本，并开始备份。

---

## `/dsh-sync` 命令

需要 profile 提供 `commands` 服务（Web 与桌面 profile 提供，headless 与 ACP profile 不提供）。

| 命令 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `/dsh-sync` | 报告远端、各备份线及上次成功时间 |
| `/dsh-sync setup [地址]` | 设置远端并执行首次初始化 |
| `/dsh-sync remote <地址>` | 仅修改远端，不改动分支 |
| `/dsh-sync lines` | 列出备份线及其分支 |
| `/dsh-sync workspace <路径>` | 启用项目线并指定目录 |
| `/dsh-sync workspace off` | 关闭项目线 |
| `/dsh-sync run` | 立即安排一次快照 |
| `/dsh-sync doctor` | 诊断 git、仓库、分支与工作区副本 |

命令产生的修改均写回配置文件，结果可 diff。

### 界面语言

命令输出与首次引导支持中文与英文，取值顺序为：配置中的 `locale` → 环境变量 `DSH_AUTO_SYNC_LOCALE` → DSH 界面语言（宿主提供时）→ 默认 `en`。日志信息固定为英文，便于在 issue 中引用。

---

## 设置页

桌面版与 Web 版的「设置 → 插件」提供**自动备份**页签，与斜杠命令读写同一份配置文件：

- 填写或修改远端地址；首次配置保存后立即执行初始化，无需重启；
- 查看各备份线的分支、启用状态、上次成功时间与最后一次错误；
- 指定同时备份的项目目录，清空即关闭项目线；
- 手动触发一次快照。

实现分为两部分：

| 部分 | 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/api.mjs` | 在 `webServer` 上注册路由并校验、持久化 |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | 浏览器脚本，注册 `settings.plugins.tab` 页签 |

客户端为无构建步骤的原生浏览器脚本，经 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 加载并复用宿主提供的 React。

### 接口

| 路由 | 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-auto-sync/status` | GET | 配置、各线状态、git 可用性 |
| `/api/dsh-auto-sync/config` | POST | 校验并保存远端、语言、间隔、项目目录 |
| `/api/dsh-auto-sync/snapshot` | POST | 立即安排快照（未配置远端时返回 409） |

接口只处理页面使用的字段，其余键原样保留。写操作要求 `Origin` 与 `Host` 同源，不一致返回 403。

不提供 `webServer` 的 profile 不注册这些路由，插件其余功能不受影响。

---

## 配置

配置文件位于 `<home>/sync-plugin/config.json`。

### 顶层键

| 键 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remote` | `string` | `""` | 备份远端地址，必填。支持 SSH 与 HTTPS。 |
| `remoteName` | `string` | `"origin"` | `origin` 已指向其他仓库时使用的远端名。 |
| `worktree` | `string` | `<home>-backup` | 各备份线工作区副本的父目录，须位于 home 之外。 |
| `locale` | `string` | `"zh"` | 命令与引导语言：`zh` 或 `en`。 |
| `exclude` | `string[]` | 见下文 | 追加到 home `.gitignore` 的忽略规则。 |
| `userName` | `string` | `"dsh-auto-sync"` | git 未配置身份时使用的提交者名称。 |
| `userEmail` | `string` | `"dsh-auto-sync@localhost"` | 同上，邮箱。 |
| `home` | `string` | `$DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh` | 覆盖 home 目录；显式 `--home` 优先于环境变量。 |

默认忽略规则：

```text
.credentials.yaml
**/node_modules/
*.log
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
sync-plugin/.sync-status.json
memory/memory.db-shm
memory/memory.db-wal
```

### 备份线键

每条线均接受 `enabled` 与 `branch`。

**`lines.hot`**

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | `[".sync-status.json"]` | 每轮对话后提交的文件，相对 home；解析到 home 之外的路径会被拒绝。 |
| `debounceMs` | `30000` | 最后一轮对话结束后的静默期。 |
| `intervalMs` | `900000` | 无条件刷新间隔，保证长时间工具调用期间状态仍能落盘。 |

**`lines.snapshot`**

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intervalMs` | `86400000` | 完整快照间隔。 |
| `profile` | `"desktop"` | 纳入依赖树的 profile。 |
| `includeNodeModules` | `true` | 在快照中重新纳入该 profile 的 `node_modules`。 |
| `files` | 清单文件列表 | 与依赖树一同镜像的 profile 文件。 |

**`lines.workspace`**

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | 未设置 `source` 时该线保持空闲。 |
| `source` | `""` | 要镜像的项目目录绝对路径。 |
| `exclude` | `[".git", "node_modules", "dist", "build", "target", ".cache"]` | 递归时跳过的目录或文件；设置后完全取代默认值。 |

### 示例

```json
{
  "remote": "git@github.com:you/dsh-backup.git",
  "worktree": "/home/you/.dsh-backup",
  "locale": "zh",
  "lines": {
    "hot": {
      "intervalMs": 900000,
      "paths": [".sync-status.json"]
    },
    "snapshot": {
      "intervalMs": 43200000,
      "profile": "desktop",
      "includeNodeModules": true
    },
    "workspace": {
      "enabled": true,
      "source": "/home/you/projects/app",
      "exclude": [".git", "node_modules", "dist"]
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 备份线

### `hot` → `dsh-hot`

频繁变化的小文件。文件复制进该线的工作区副本后提交并推送。默认在对话轮结束后 30 秒触发，并有 15 分钟下限，保证长时间工具调用期间状态仍能落盘。

### `snapshot` → `dsh-snapshot`

home 的完整镜像，附带所配置 profile 的依赖清单与依赖树。`link:` 依赖按清单条目记录，克隆后由包管理器恢复；已发布依赖固化进分支。

运行时机：每日一次、退出时一次，以及启动时发现上次快照早于间隔的补跑。重复重启会重置倒计时，补跑避免了该问题。

### `workspace` → `dsh-workspace`

镜像指定的项目目录，使代码与其描述状态一同版本化。默认关闭。构建产物与依赖缓存被排除，排除列表可配置。

### `release` → GitHub Release 资产

完整备份的另一种形态：将 home 打包为 `tar.gz` 并作为 release 资产发布。

两种完整备份并存的原因：

| | `snapshot`（分支） | `release`（资产） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 存储 | 每个版本进入 git 历史 | 每个版本一个压缩包 |
| 成本 | 每次提交涉及数万文件 | 单个压缩文件 |
| 恢复 | `git checkout` | 下载解压，无需插件 |
| 长期保留 | 历史持续增长 | 保留最近 N 份 |

日常增量使用 `snapshot`，长期归档与灾难恢复使用 `release`。

以 3.4 GB 的 home 实测（排除依赖），归档体积约 369 MiB。

```json
"release": {
  "enabled": true,
  "repo": "",
  "tagPrefix": "dsh-backup-",
  "keep": 5,
  "intervalMs": 604800000,
  "includeNodeModules": false,
  "includeSecrets": false,
  "partSizeBytes": 1500000000
}
```

- `repo` 为空时由 git 远端推导为 `owner/name`。
- 超过 `partSizeBytes` 时分割为 `.part000`、`.part001` 等，并生成记录各部分 sha256 的 `manifest.json`。
- `keep` 限制保留数量；超出时优先删除较早的 tag，且仅考虑带本线 `tagPrefix` 的 tag。
- `.credentials.yaml` 默认排除；`includeSecrets: true` 会将其打入归档，在公开仓库上等同于泄露密钥。

上传前可先预演：

```sh
node release-backup.mjs --dry-run
```

输出归档体积、分片数与目标仓库。

传输在 GitHub CLI 存在时使用 `gh`，否则使用 REST API 加 token。该顺序是必要的：在 TLS 中间人代理环境下，Node 的 `fetch` 会因 `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE` 失败，而 `gh` 使用独立的信任链。REST 路径的 token 依次取自 `DSH_AUTO_SYNC_GITHUB_TOKEN`、`GITHUB_TOKEN`、`gh auth token`。

---

## 恢复

恢复整个 home：

```sh
git clone <远端地址> ~/.dsh
cd ~/.dsh
git checkout dsh-snapshot
dsh plugin --profile desktop install
```

恢复单个文件：

```sh
git show dsh-snapshot:sessions/2026-01-01/....jsonl > restored.jsonl
```

恢复项目：

```sh
git clone --branch dsh-workspace <远端地址> project
```

`git log dsh-snapshot -- <路径>` 给出单个文件的修订历史。

---

## 安全模型

**默认排除凭据。** 首次运行时插件把 `.credentials.yaml` 及以上规则写入 home 的 `.gitignore`。该文件保存服务商 API Key，不应推送。

**接管而非覆盖已有仓库。** home 已是带远端的 git 仓库时，其历史与远端配置原样保留；插件只新增分支与工作区副本，不重写、变基或强推历史，也不修改已指向其他位置的远端。

**从不强推。** 推送被拒绝时合并远端顶端并重试一次，冲突以本地快照为准。历史只增不改。

**配置无法导出 home 之外的文件。** `lines.hot.paths` 相对 home 解析，越界即拒绝。

**对会话失败

plugins.description: DSH plugin: auto-compact long sessions after user idle time, before the KV cache expires.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-idle-compact [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that prepares a compaction of a long session while you are away, before the model provider's KV cache expires, and lets you apply it with one click when you come back.

## Why

Providers cache the prompt prefix of a conversation for a few minutes. While the cache is warm, re-reading a long history is cheap. Once it expires, your next message re-bills the whole history at the full, uncached input price.

If you walk away from a long session, this plugin produces the compaction summary while the cache is still warm, so that summarization request is cheap. Nothing changes in your session until you decide to apply it.

## How it works

1. When a session finishes a turn and waits for you, a timer starts.
2. Any new activity in that session cancels the timer, whether it's you replying or the agent starting work.
3. When the timer fires, the plugin prepares a compaction only if all of these hold:
   - the agent is still idle and its last turn finished normally (not an error or a stop);
   - no background job or subagent is running for the session;
   - the session's context, measured with DSH's token meter, has reached the threshold.
4. Preparing runs exactly the summarization request DSH's `/compact` would make, and keeps the result. Your session is not changed.
5. An **Apply compaction** bar appears just above the message input, showing how many history items it covers.
6. Clicking it runs DSH's own `/compact` command, exactly as if you had typed it, and answers its summarization request with the prepared result, so no new model call is made. The conversation shows the usual `/compact` card with its "Compacted N history items" reply.

The prepared summary is only valid for the conversation it summarized. If you send another message (or the history changes in any other way), it is discarded and the button disappears; the next idle period that qualifies prepares a fresh one. If the conversation somehow differs at the moment you click, `/compact` makes its own model call instead of using a stale summary.

When the plugin starts or is reloaded (a DSH restart, a plugin update), sessions that are already waiting are timed from the end of their last turn. A session idle for less than the idle delay is timed for only the remaining seconds. A session idle for longer is skipped entirely, because the provider's cache has most likely expired and preparing would cost full price. It qualifies again after its next turn.

Subagent sessions are skipped, because they never wait for a user reply. If the agent is busy when the timer fires, nothing is prepared and this is logged.

## Settings

Open **Plugins → Idle Compact** in the DSH Web UI:

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Context length threshold (tokens) | `256000` | Prepare a compaction only when the session context has reached this length. |
| Idle time (seconds) | `300` (5 min) | How long you must go without replying before a compaction is prepared. |

Both fields take whole numbers of at least 1. Changes apply without a restart. A changed idle time takes effect the next time a session starts waiting.

You can also set them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: idle-compact
  config:
    contextThresholdTokens: 200000
    idleSeconds: 240
```

## Install

Requires the DSH Web UI. Tested on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3 and 0.2.1-rc.2; earlier versions are untested. The plugin uses DSH's authenticated `/api` routes, its settings-form components, and the area above the message input (`conversation.input.dock`).

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact
```

Or, in the Web UI, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact` or a local checkout path.

## Token cost

Each prepared compaction makes one summarization call to your model. It's cheap because the cache is warm, but it is spent even if you never click Apply or never return to that session. If most of your idle sessions are ones you abandon, raise the threshold.

Prepared summaries are kept in memory only. Restarting DSH discards them.

## Page endpoints

The browser half talks to the Host over two routes on DSH's own `/api` channel. DSH checks the browser's login and origin before either route runs, so other programs and other websites can't use them.

- `GET /api/idle-compact/events?sessionId=<id>`: a server-sent event stream. The first message is the session's current state, and another follows each change. Each message is `{ "prepared": false }`, or `{ "prepared": true, "items": <history items>, "tokens": <approx. tokens>, "applying": <boolean> }`.
- `POST /api/idle-compact/apply` with JSON `{ "sessionId": "<id>" }` applies the prepared compaction. Responses:

| Status | Body | When |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | `{ "ok": <boolean>, "result": <command result> }` | `/compact` ran; `ok` is whether it succeeded. Its outcome also shows in the chat. |
| 200 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "command-unavailable" }` | The `/compact` command isn't available. |
| 400 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "bad-body" }` | The body isn't a JSON object with a non-empty string `sessionId`. |
| 404 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "no-session" }` | No live session has that id. |
| 409 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "not-prepared" }` | Nothing is prepared, or it went stale. |
| 409 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "applying" }` | An apply is already running for that session. |
| 500 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "failed", "message": "…" }` | Applying failed unexpectedly. |

## Tests

```sh
npm test
```

The tests load the plugin into a real DSH runtime from your local DSH install and fake only the model provider and the browser connection. Set `DSH_RUNTIME_DIRS` (colon-separated `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` directories) to choose which runtimes to test against.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: settings schema, public exports, and wiring of the parts below. |
| `src/idle-scheduler.js` | One idle timer per agent; aborts its work when the agent resumes. |
| `src/prepare.js` | Eligibility checks, and producing the summary on a detached copy of the session. |
| `src/replay.js` | Records the summarization request while preparing; replays it once on apply. |
| `src/prepared-store.js` | What is prepared for each session, and notifying the page when it changes. |
| `src/http.js` | The page's endpoints on DSH's authenticated `/api` channel. |
| `src/constants.js`, `src/util.js` | Shared names, values, and small helpers. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: the settings form on the Plugins page and the Apply bar above the message input. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the `idle-compact` row. |
| `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Display metadata for the plugin manager. |
| `test/` | Tests that run the plugin inside a real DSH runtime. |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 一键快捷输入：在消息输入框旁边放一排可自定义的快捷指令按钮，点一下就把预设文字直接发送到当前对话，省去重复打字。名称、字号、透明度、模块化形状与发送内容均可就地编辑。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 一键快捷输入（DSH Quick Send）

> 在消息输入框旁边放一排**可自定义的快捷指令按钮**，点一下就把预设文字直接发进当前对话 —— 省掉重复打字的时间。

标准 DSH bundle 插件：`dsh plugin` 一键安装，纯 JavaScript 无构建步骤，无需任何会话令牌。

---

## 它解决什么问题

和模型对话时，总有些话要反复打：

- 「继续」
- 「请总结当前进展」
- 「按方案 A 改，别动其它文件」
- 一大段固定的审查要求 / 代码规范

每次都手打一遍很费时间。这个插件把这些固定说法变成按钮，**点一下就发送**。

---

## 特性

### 一个按钮组，不遮挡任何内容

| 组成 | 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔘 **快捷按钮** | 输入框**下方**那一行，默认在上下文进度**右侧** | 每个按钮一条指令，点一下即发送 |
| ⚙ **齿轮** | 紧挨快捷按钮，同一组内 | 点开是配置面板 |

整组走**正常流式布局**（不是浮层），所以**不会盖住对话正文**。

### 右键拖动换位置

**右键**按钮组即可进入移动模式（出现提示条 + 高亮边框）：

- 按住左右拖动，松开后**吸附到上下文进度的左侧或右侧**；
- 按 `Esc` 取消，不改变位置；
- 选择会记住（`localStorage` 键 `dsh-quick-send.placement.v1`），刷新后保持。

### 每条快捷指令都能单独定制

| 可调项 | 范围 / 选项 |
|---|---|
| **按钮名称** | 任意文字，显示在按钮上 |
| **发送文字** | 任意多行文本，即点击后真正发出去的内容 |
| **大小** | 字号 10 – 22px |
| **透明度** | 20% – 100%，可让不常用的按钮低调一些 |
| **模块化形状** | 方形 / 圆角 / 胶囊 / 圆形 |
| **顺序** | 上移 / 下移，可增删任意条数 |

编辑器里每条指令右侧的 **▶** 可以**直接试发**，不用切回输入框。

### 面板不会撑坏页面

配置面板渲染在框架级浮层 `shell.overlay` —— 它在所有列之上、**所有滚动容器之外**，因此：

- 不会被对话滚动区**裁剪**；
- **不会把页面撑高溢出**（之前的版本在输入框下方展开大表单就会溢出）；
- 输入框在屏幕下方，**默认向上展开**，空间不足时自动调整；
- 浮层本身点击穿透，只有面板自己接收指针事件。

### 不干扰你的草稿

发送走的是与官方输入框**同一条**客户端 API：

```js
ctx.sessions.binding(sessionId).session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')
```

以 **queue** 模式投递文本，**不会写入草稿框** —— 所以你正在编辑的内容原封不动。

### 中英双语 · 主题跟随

内置英文与简体中文文案，跟随宿主语言切换；样式只使用宿主主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`），自动适配明暗主题。

### 配置持久化

快捷指令保存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-quick-send.shortcuts.v1`），
**无需 Host 桥接**，重启后依然在。默认自带两条示例（「继续」「总结」）。

---

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-quick-send
```

> 把 `<你的profile>` 换成你的 profile 名，例如 `web` 或 `desktop`。

装完**重启 DSH**（或重载 Web 页面）即可看到按钮。

### 方式二：从 GitHub 仓库安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add github:1250589385/DSH-Quick-Send
```

⚠️ 两种方式是**同一个包名**，请勿混用；已经用 `github:` 装过想换 npm 名的，先执行
`dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> remove dsh-quick-send`。

### 方式三：本地目录安装（开发用）

把本仓库放到任意工作目录，然后：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add /绝对路径/DSH-Quick-Send
```

---

## 使用

1. **配置**：点输入框**右上角的 ⚙** → 打开面板
2. **增删**：面板顶部「添加」新增一条，「✕」删除某条
3. **编辑**：改名称、改发送文字、调字号 / 透明度 / 形状
4. **排序**：用 ↑ ↓ 调整按钮在下方那一行的先后
5. **发送**：点**输入框下方**的按钮即发送；或在面板里点该条的 ▶ 试发

发送成功/失败都会在触发器旁显示一行提示（例如「已发送：继续」，
或会话已关闭、内容为空的失败原因）。

---

## 兼容性

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DSH | 带 `conversation.input.overlay` / `conversation.composer.dock` / `shell.overlay` 三个 slot 的版本（0.2.x 实测通过） |
| 平台 | DSH Web UI（`"platform": "web"`） |
| Node | 仅安装期需要，运行时无 Node 依赖 |
| 构建 | **无** —— 直接加载源码，不需要打包 |
| 依赖 | 无第三方运行时依赖 |

---

## 工作原理（给开发者）

插件分两半：

- **Host 半边**（`index.js`）：仅 `export function apply() {}`，不注册任何 Host 能力，
  只让 bundle 解析出一个 Loader 行。
- **Client 半边**（`client.js`）：纯 JS，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})`
  注册一个惰性工厂，内部用两个 slot 注入：

| Slot | 注册 id | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `conversation.composer.dock` | `quick-send-dock` | 快捷按钮 + 齿轮组成的整组，含移动模式与状态行 |
| `shell.overlay` | `quick-send-panel` | 框架级浮层中的配置面板 |

**为什么能排在上下文进度右侧**：宿主把 dock 渲染为
`[renderSlot("conversation.composer.dock")][ContextMeter]` 的居中 flex 行，
所以槽内容天然在 ContextMeter 左侧。本插件给按钮组加 `order: 1` 移到右侧，
再用 `margin-left: auto` 贴住行尾，使其与上下文进度相邻而不是漂在中间；
移动模式把 `order` 在 `0` / `1` 之间切换。

配置状态放在一个模块级 store（`useSyncExternalStore` 订阅），
由 `dock` 与 `panel` 共享，因此任一处修改在另一处立即生效。
面板位置通过齿轮的 `getBoundingClientRect()` 用 `requestAnimationFrame`
跟随（只在坐标真正变化时才 setState，空闲时零开销）。

**资源释放**：样式以 React `<style>` 元素渲染在组件树内，卸载即移除；
Escape / 外部点击监听器在 `useEffect` 中注册并返回清理函数，随面板卸载一并注销。

---

## 仓库结构

```
DSH-Quick-Send/
├── package.json          # 包清单：exports、files、dsh.bundle / dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 插入 quick-send Host 行
├── index.js              # Host 半边（空 apply）
├── client.js             # 客户端半边：按钮组、齿轮、浮层编辑器、发送、拖动换位
├── locale/
│   ├── en.json           # 插件列表标题与描述（英文）
│   └── zh.json           # 插件列表标题与描述（中文）
├── icon.svg              # 插件列表图标（原创）
├── README.md             # 本文件
├── CHANGELOG.md          # 版本变更
├── PROVENANCE.md         # 素材来源与许可范围
├── LICENSE               # MIT
└── .gitignore
```

---

## 许可

代码与文案按 **MIT** 授权，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。
图标为原创作品，一并按 MIT 授权。详见 [`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md)。

---

## 致谢与反馈

欢迎提 issue / PR：<https://github.com/1250589385/DSH-Quick-Send/issues>

反馈问题时请注明 **插件版本、DSH 版本、系统与复现步骤**，并**勿粘贴密钥或未脱敏日志**。

plugins.description: Structured web search, page fetch and one-call research for DeepSeek Harness, powered by the official DeepSeek Search/Fetch API.
plugins.readme_text:
# @vfvrpq/dsh-search

DeepSeek 官方 Search / Fetch 接口的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：三个工具、一个配置项、零运行时依赖。

给 agent 的是**结构化**网页结果——rerank 分、权威度、发布时间、模型友好长摘要——而不是一坨 HTML。
比内置 `web_search` / `web_fetch` 多出来的东西：搜索语法、条数与正文可控、成本可推算。

## 装

```sh
# 从 npm（已发布版本）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @vfvrpq/dsh-search@0.1.0

# 或从源码包（插件 import 了 @deepseek-ai/*，必须走 tgz，目录软链会让宿主包解析不到）
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /绝对路径/vfvrpq-dsh-search-0.1.0.tgz
```

装完工具即出现在工具表里，**不用重启**（升级才需要重启）。

## 三个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 | 计费请求数 |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek_search` | 搜索，返回标题/URL/snippet/summary/可选正文/日期/权威度/rerank 分 | 1 |
| `deepseek_fetch` | 单页转 Markdown（标题 + 正文） | 1 |
| `deepseek_research` | 搜索 + 抓前 N 页正文，一次给结论 | 1 + N |

`deepseek_search` 支持的操作符，写在 `query` 里或用参数：`site:`、`-site:`、`-词`、`-"短语"`、`"精确"`、`lang:`、`after:`、`before:`。

```text
deepseek_search  query="llama.cpp 安装" site="github.com" after=2025 count=5
deepseek_fetch   url="https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/search"
deepseek_research query="DeepSeek V4 上下文长度" count=5 top=2
```

判读口径：`rerankScore >= 1.5` 为优质（渲染里标 ★），`authority >= 3` 为高权威。
`summary` 是二手摘要，版本号/日期/价格/API 字段一律 `deepseek_fetch` 原文核实；引用给原始 URL。

## 配置

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | `""` | 空则运行时按下面四层解析，**不要把 key 写进 profile** |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | 仅兼容代理时才改 |
| `defaultCount` | `5` | 调用没给 `count` 时的条数 |
| `maxContentChars` | `8000` | `deepseek_search` 每条正文上限 |
| `fetchMaxChars` | `20000` | `deepseek_fetch` 正文上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单请求超时 |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | 408 / 429 / 5xx 重试次数 |
| `promptEnabled` | `true` | 是否向系统提示贡献用法章节 |
| `promptOrder` | `55` | 该章节排序 |

key 解析顺序（**key 不落 profile**）：

1. 插件配置 `apiKey`
2. `$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`
3. `~/.secrets/keys.env` 里的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=...`
4. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: sk-...`

## 成本

- 5 元 / 1000 次成功请求 ≈ **0.005 元 / 次**；Search 与 Fetch 同价。
- 只有 HTTP 200 且产生结果才计费；空结果、失败、超时不计费。
- `count` 不影响单价——一次取够，别拆成多次小请求。
- 限速：Search 与 Fetch **各自** 5 QPS（账号级）；超过抛 429，插件按退避重试。

## 结构

```
lib/index.js     入口：只接线（校验配置、持有 client、注册工具、贡献提示章节）
lib/config.js    Config schema + 代码侧默认值 + 加载期校验
lib/keys.js      四层 key 解析
lib/query.js     query 拼装与 site: 展开
lib/client.js    HTTP：超时 / 重试 / 错误翻译
lib/format.js    结果归一化与渲染
lib/prompt.js    系统提示章节
lib/tools/       一能力一文件（search / fetch / research / shared）
```

## 开发

```sh
node --test test/*.test.js     # 单测：mock fetch，不联网、不花钱
node scripts/live-selftest.js  # 真机自测：1 次搜索 + 1 次抓取（约 0.01 元）
```

## 已知边界

- 抓不了需要登录态、点击交互、或返回非 HTML 的页面 → 用浏览器自动化插件。
- SPA 文档站可能对不存在的路径返回 200 + 站点壳内容而不是 404；正文里出现首页标语即说明是 fallback。
- Fetch 返回的 Markdown 会把 `\/`、`\.`、`\#` 等标点反斜杠转义，属上游产物，按需 unescape。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-sidebar-restart One row in the sidebar foot, beside the settings gear: restarts the DSH desktop app in a single click, instead of quitting from the tray and relaunching by hand. ![The Restart row above Settings in the desktop app](docs/usage-desktop.png) ![The same row in the mobile drawer, label included](docs/usage-phone.png) [![三种形态](docs/placement-options.png)](docs/placement-options.png) ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sidebar-restart # once it is on npm ``` or straight from the repository: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:DONGBIN007/dsh-sidebar-restart ``` Then restart the app once by hand so the plugin loads — which is the last time you have to do that, since this button is what you use from then on. **Desktop only.** On a plain `dsh web` profile the row renders disabled and says why; there is no desktop process to replace there. If you wanted the *Web server* restarted, that is a different plugin ([`dsh-restart-button`](https://github.com/hadesybil-hub/dsh-restart-button)). ## What it does, in one line Adds a **Restart** row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings. Clicking it asks the Host to restart; a detached helper kills the Electron main process and the Host by PID, waits until both are gone, starts the app again, and the tab reloads itself once the replacement answers with a new boot id — so a plugin you installed a moment ago is actually running afterwards. ## What it looks like | Desktop app (wide sidebar) | Mobile drawer | |---|---| | ![desktop](docs/usage-desktop.png) | ![mobile](docs/usage-phone.png) | Both follow the host's own rule rather than a breakpoint of mine: the label appears exactly where the host shows one for the gear, i.e. when the sidebar is wide. In the narrow 56px rail the row stays icon-only and keeps the gear's 36×36 target. ## The control is a copy of the gear row next door The seat is `sidebar.footer.action` — "optional actions beside Settings at the sidebar foot". The shipped sidebar renders it as `footerActions`, a flex row that `footArea` lays out **above** `settingsArea` (the gear row). So in the plain host footer this control sits directly above the gear. It is deliberately styled as the gear's twin, with every value read from the shipped `.wCInkW_trigger` (ui-settings-general) and the seat's own sibling `.dsh-mobile-control__trigger`, which agree: | Property | Value | Why | |---|---|---| | colour | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | the gear uses the **primary** label colour; a secondary-coloured icon beside it is a visible mismatch | | height | `42px` | the footer row height both host controls use | | padding | `0 10px 0 8px`, `gap 8px` | the gear's own padding and icon/label gap | | radius | `--dsw-radius-md` | the gear's radius, not the small one | | label | `14px / 22px`, `font: inherit` | the gear label's typography | | row box | `calc(100% + 4px)`, `margin 4px -2px` | the gear's row is `.wCInkW_triggerRow{width:calc(100% + 4px);margin:4px -2px}` — it bleeds 2px past the column on each side, so its content begins at `parentLeft − 2 + 8 = +6`. Without the same bleed this row's icon **and** label sit 2px to the right of the gear's, and the two never line up. This button *is* its own row, so it carries both the bleed and the padding. | Verified on a **real phone screenshot** (1216×2640, so ≈3.5 device px per CSS px), measuring the dark ink of each row directly: | row, on the device | icon ink left | label ink left | icon ink | row centre | |---|---|---|---|---| | before the bleed: 重启 | `73` | `157` | 50 | `2356.5` | | before the bleed: 设置 | `67` | `150` | 48 | `2531.5` | | after the bleed: 重启 | `66` | `150` | 50 | — | | after the bleed: 设置 | `67` | `150` | 48 | — | So the old geometry sat **+6 device px (≈2 CSS px)** right of the gear — the 2px the CSS predicted — and the shipped geometry lands within **1 device px** on the icon and **exactly 0** on the label. The two row centres are 175 device px apart, which is `175 / 3.5 = 50.0` CSS px — precisely the designed `21 + 4 + 4 + 21`. [![真机对齐：橙色线为齿轮图标左缘](docs/row-alignment-device.png)](docs/row-alignment-device.png) The orange line is the gear's own icon left edge. Before, the ↻ icon and the 重启 label both sit to its right; after, they land on it. The equivalent check against the host's shipped CSS in a controlled 340px column gives the same result to the hundredth: | row | icon left | label left | |---|---|---| | the gear | `5.67` | `29.67` | | this button, before the bleed | `7.67` (**+2.00**) | `31.67` (**+2.00**) | | this button, after the bleed | `5.67` (**0.00**) | `29.67` (**0.00**) | [![受控 CSS 校验](docs/row-alignment.png)](docs/row-alignment.png) One residual is **not** a CSS mismatch and is deliberately left alone: on the device the ↻ ink is 50px against the gear's 48px. Both icons are the host's own primitives at the host's own `wide ? 16 : 18`, drawn on the same 16px box with the same 1.3 stroke — a near-full circle simply carries more ink than a compact gear. Making the two inks match would mean drawing the shipped artwork below the size the host asks for, which is the one thing this row must not do. **The label follows the host's own `wide` convention** — no invented breakpoint. The gear's `TriggerContent` renders `wide ? + label : `, and `dsh-mobile`, the seat's other occupant, does `wide ?

plugins.description: DSH 侧栏网页批注：真浏览器跑在宿主里，指向元素就地批注，汇总成结构化指令。In-sidebar web annotation with real element picking for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-annotate

在 DSH 侧栏里跑一个真实浏览器，指向页面元素就地写批注，汇总成结构化指令。

Point at a live element inside the DSH sidebar, drop a comment on it, and get back a structured instruction list.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.1%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0284c7.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> 装不上、报错、或者行为和文档对不上，直接发邮件到 **1992335297@qq.com**，比开 Issue 更快被看到。

---

![侧栏网页批注](docs/annotate.png)

> 图为界面示意，按插件 `lib/client.js` 的工具栏、拾取高亮、元素信息与批注列表样式渲染，页面内容为假数据，不是运行截图。可用 `node scripts/make-screenshots.mjs` 重新生成（源码在 `scripts/demo/annotate.html`）。

## 它解决什么问题

改界面最累的不是改，是指路。「左边那个卡片的边距大了点」——模型得猜是哪个卡片；截一张图贴进去——又得反复圈。批注把指路变成点一下：鼠标停在哪个元素上，它的标签、尺寸、背景色、字体就摆在那儿，点一下写一句人话，最后汇总成一份带选择器的清单。

## 功能

- **真实浏览器**：宿主侧用 Playwright 起 Chromium，页面是真跑的，不是画出来的缩略图。
- **画面推流**：CDP `Page.startScreencast` 出帧，SSE 推到侧栏，页面一有变化就刷新。
- **元素拾取**：开启批注模式后，鼠标指向哪里，就高亮哪个元素并显示 `标签 / 尺寸 / 背景色 / 字体 / 字号 / 字重`。
- **就地评论**：点元素弹出输入框，回车即存；批注列表在下方可逐条删除。
- **框选区域**：按住拖动可以框一块区域批注，适合「这一整块间距不对」这类说不清是哪个元素的意见。
- **一键回填**：点 **↩** 把汇总直接写进对话输入框，不用复制粘贴。
- **快捷键**：`Ctrl+Shift+.` 切换批注模式。
- **交互转发**：退出拾取后，点击、滚轮、方向键、Enter、Tab、Esc、Backspace、PageUp/PageDown 都会转发给页面。
- **批注留得住**：按页面地址存在 `localStorage`，关掉 tab 再打开还在；删完自动清空。
- **穿透 iframe**：页面里嵌的 iframe（含跨域）也能点进去拾取，信息浮层会标出所在层级。
- **页面内输入**：工具栏 `⌨` 把一段文本（含中文）送进页面当前焦点元素，绕开键盘布局与输入法。
- **导出成文件**：`⤓` 把汇总写成 Markdown，存到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/` 下。
- **手动入口**：对话输入框左侧有一个 **◱ 网页** 按钮，随时点开面板自己输地址，不用等模型触发。
- **可被 DSH 接管**：浏览器启动时暴露 CDP 端点，`playwright-mcp` 能以 `mode: attach` 接上同一个浏览器，模型操作的就是侧栏里看得见的这个。

## 让 DSH 在侧栏里操作浏览器

默认情况下 DSH 的浏览器工具启动的是独立的 headless Chromium，你看不见它在做什么。可以改成接管本插件的浏览器：

1. 先打开一次「网页批注」面板，让浏览器起来（`GET /api/web-annotate/health` 里 `cdpEndpoint` 不为 null 即就绪）。
2. 修改 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里 playwright 提供方的配置：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: browser-use
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use"
    - id: browser-use-playwright-mcp
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp"
      config:
        mode: attach
        endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9222
```

3. 重启 DSH。之后模型每次调用浏览器工具，操作的都是侧栏里那个浏览器。

**注意**：`attach` 模式下浏览器必须先在跑。如果插件没启动浏览器（没打开过面板、或插件被禁用），模型的浏览器工具会直接失败。想退回独立浏览器，把 `mode` 改回 `launch`、删掉 `endpoint` 即可。端口可用环境变量 `DSH_ANNOTATE_CDP_PORT` 改；端口被占用时插件会自动退化为不开调试端口，此时 `cdpEndpoint` 为 `null`。

## 汇总长这样

```markdown
## 网页批注

页面：http://localhost:5173/

1. `#card-a`（div，936×54）
   卡片内边距太大，收到 12px

2. `#card-b.accent`（div，936×54）
   强调色换成主题蓝
```

## 用法

1. 点右侧栏 tab 条的添加按钮，选 **网页批注**。
2. 地址栏输入 `localhost:5173`，回车。首次启动浏览器要等几秒。
3. 点工具栏的 **◱ 批注**（或按 `Ctrl+Shift+.`）进入拾取模式。指向元素看信息，点一下写评论；按住拖动可以框一块区域。
4. 点 **↩** 把汇总回填到输入框，或点 **⧉** 复制到剪贴板。

退出拾取模式后，点击和滚轮会正常传给页面，可以当普通预览用。

## 与 dsh-web-preview 的分工

| | dsh-web-preview | dsh-web-annotate |
|---|---|---|
| 渲染 | iframe 直出 | CDP 画面流 |
| 速度 | 接近原生 | 帧流，有几十毫秒延迟 |
| 能否批注 | 否（跨域拿不到 DOM） | 能 |
| 依赖 | 无 | 需要 Playwright（复用 DSH 自带的那份） |

两个插件可以同时装，各自一个 tab 类型。

## 技术实现

```
宿主 lib/index.js
  ├─ 从 DSH profile 目录解析 playwright，复用 DSH 自带的 chromium
  ├─ 每个地址一个 page 会话，CDP screencast 出帧
  ├─ SSE  GET  /api/web-annotate/frames?session=<id>
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/session      创建会话
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/input        鼠标 / 滚轮 / 键盘转发
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/pick         坐标 → 元素信息（elementFromPoint）
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/reload       重新加载
  └─ DEL  /api/web-annotate/session/<id> 关闭
```

没用 WebSocket：DSH 的 `webServer` 只暴露路由注册，不保证能拿到 http server 的 `upgrade` 事件。SSE 是普通响应，稳定可控；输入事件走 POST，量级完全够。

选择器生成走 `id` → 类名 → `nth-of-type` 的降级链，最多上溯 6 层。

## 权限与安全边界

这个插件比纯前端插件权限大，装之前请明确知道它做了什么。

- **会启动本地浏览器进程**：使用 DSH 自带的 Playwright 与 Chromium，不额外下载。
- **会访问你输入的地址**：只放行 `http` / `https`，拒绝 `file://` 与其它协议，不能读取本地文件。
- **不注入任意脚本**：页面内只执行一个固定的取元素信息函数，不执行页面返回的内容。
- **不写入文件**：批注只存在客户端内存里，复制由你自己触发。
- **会话隔离**：每个地址一个 page，关闭 tab 即销毁；无客户端连接且空闲 5 分钟后自动回收。
- `dependencies` 为空，无 `preinstall` / `install` / `postinstall` / `prepare` 生命周期脚本。

## 已知限制

- 画面是帧流，快速滚动或动画多时会有轻微延迟。
- 拾取模式会拦截点击与滚动，要操作页面（点按钮、输入）需先退出拾取。
- 键盘只转发导航键与编辑键（方向键、Enter、Tab、Esc、Backspace、PageUp/PageDown）；可打印字符走 `⌨` 面板的整段输入，逐字键入不转。
- 回填依赖 DSH 的 `conversation.input.left` 插槽存在。该插槽没挂上时自动退回复制到剪贴板。
- iframe 穿透最多 4 层；超出的部分会被当成普通 iframe 元素本身。
- 导出固定写到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/`，不写项目目录。
- 批注存在 `localStorage`，按页面地址分键；换浏览器 profile 或清理站点数据会丢。
- 只在 Windows + DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` 桌面端验证过。

```bash
node scripts/smoke.mjs    # 端到端：起站点、起 chromium、取帧、拾取、输入、刷新、关闭，8 项
```

# dsh-model-picker · 模型速选器（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness 会话窗口右下角 **模型下拉框的左侧** 添加一个小按钮。
点击按钮弹出全量模型选择窗口：按提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、
真实能力标签、推理徽章、当前选中高亮，加载 / 失败 / 会话占用等状态都有清晰呈现。
**选择模型后立即回写模型下拉框并生效** —— 因为它与原生下拉框共用同一条
per-session 模型目录与 `selectModel` 提交路径（"任一端切换，另一端立刻显示"）。

## 效果

![模型速选窗口（深色主题，中文界面）](screenshot_zh.png)

![模型下拉左侧的触发按钮](button.png)

    点一下即切回常用模型；

  - **底部**：当前模型摘要 + **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器** + 关闭按钮；
  - **状态**：加载中（spinner）、加载失败（重试）、提供商加载失败（逐条提示）、
    当前模型已不可路由（警告）、会话被占用（专用文案）。

### 能力标签是真实数据

行内的 `📝 文本` / `🖼️ 图像` 标签**不是**从模型描述文字里猜的，而是读
**用户自己配置里声明的 `input` 列表**（pi-ai 提供商配置，如
`providers.<id>.models[].input: [text, image]`）。实现走 DSH 已有的
`settings` Remote 读取 settings 文档，扫描各命名空间的 `providers → models[].input`
建索引；配置里没写 `input` 的提供商就不显示标签（如实反映配置，不做臆测）。
增删配置里的 `input`，标签随之变化。

> **契约说明（已验证）**：能力标签用 `group.id` 查询索引，而 `group.id` 与
> settings 中 `providers` 的**配置 key 同命名空间**（DSH 的 modelCatalog 以
> `provider.id` 作为分组 id、`provider.name` 作为显示名）。因此
> `providers.volcengine-agent-plan` 这类配置 key 能被可靠匹配；若未来 DSH
> 改变这一命名约定，标签会安静地不显示（不会报错），插件其余功能不受影响。

> **为什么只能从配置读（已验证）**：浏览器侧拿到的 `modelCatalog` RPC 返回的
> 模型对象**只有 `id` / `name` / `description` / `reasoning`，不含 `input`** ——
> DSH 的 Host 侧在构建浏览器目录时把 `input` 字段投影丢弃了（见
> `buildModelCatalog`）。因此插件无法从模型目录兜底读取能力，配置是浏览器侧
> 唯一的 `input` 来源。想给某个模型显示能力标签，就在 pi-ai 提供商配置里为它
> 写 `input`：
>
> ```yaml
> # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml，llm-pi-ai 提供商配置内
> models:
>   - id: deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731
>     input: [text, image]   # 声明后插件即显示「文本 / 图像」标签
> ```
>
> 这也解释了为什么**同一个模型 id 在不同用户那里标签可能不同**——它如实反映
> 各自配置，而非模型本身的客观能力。

## 工作原理

1. 注册进 composer 的 **`conversation.input.right`** slot —— 这是一个
   `kind: list`、`scope: session` 的官方扩展点，composer 栏在渲染模型
   seat（`conversation.input.model`）之前渲染它，因此按钮天然出现在
   模型下拉的**左边**。
2. 通过 `ctx.inject(['slots', 'modelDirectories'], …)` 拿到
   `ctx.modelDirectories`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`
   注册的共享服务），对当前会话解析出与原生下拉**同一个**
   `ModelDirectory` 实例。
3. 弹窗里选择模型 → `directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`
   → 走与原生下拉完全相同的 `selectModel` RPC。成功后共享 store 更新，
   原生模型下拉的标签**自动回写**，会话模型切换立即生效。
4. 能力标签由 `ctx.inject(['…', 'remote', 'remote.settings'])` 注入的
   `settings` Remote 读取：`settings.describe()` 返回各命名空间的合并配置，
   从中提取 `provider → model → input[]`。注意 **`remote.<namespace>` 必须显式
   写进 inject 列表**（cordis 规则），只注入根 `remote` 会在访问时报
   `cannot get property "remote.settings" without inject`。
5. 子代理（subagent addressed）会话没有模型目录，按钮自动隐藏。

# dsh-video-grab —— 让 Agent 真的"看"视频（免 ffmpeg）

> 给 DSH 用的 host 插件。核心不是"能抓帧"，而是**用得起**：一条 33 秒的视频，
> 逐帧读完约 61 万 token（爆），拼成一张联系表约 2200 token（一次读图看完整条）。

## 一、它解决的问题

Agent 看视频有个硬约束：**读一张图的成本 ≈ 宽×高÷750 token**。

| 做法 | 33 秒 / 720×720 / 883 帧 |
|---|---|
| 逐帧读原图 | 883 × 约 690 ≈ **61 万 token**（任何上下文都装不下） |
| 一张联系表（20 格） | 1440×1152 ≈ **2200 token，一次读完** |

所以「看完一条视频」的正确姿势是**联系表**，不是抽一堆帧再一张张读。

第二个约束：这台机器上**没有 ffmpeg，也没有 yt-dlp**。解法是借本机已有的
**Electron**（`electron.exe` 自带 `ffmpeg.dll`，即 Chromium 的解码器）：
插件拉起一个隐藏窗口播 `<video>`，seek 到采样点，`drawImage` 到 canvas，导出 PNG。

## 二、四个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `video_probe` | 只读容器结构：轨道、编码、分辨率、样本数、时长（不解码，毫秒级） |
| `video_sheet` | **主力**：按时间点采样拼一张联系表，返回 PNG 绝对路径（用 `read_image` 读） |
| `video_frames` | 均匀抽 N 帧存 PNG（只在需要逐帧细看时用，token 贵） |
| `video_fetch_bilibili` | 匿名取 B 站**公开**视频直链并下载到本地（不需要账号/登录） |

典型流程：

```
video_fetch_bilibili { bvid: "BV1WLpA6uEB1" }   → 本地 mp4 路径
video_sheet          { path: "<上一步的路径>" }  → PNG 路径
read_image           { file_path: "<PNG 路径>" } → 真的看到内容
```

## 三、实测数据（2026-10-12，本机）

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `video_probe` 33 秒片 | 0.0s，`720x720 avc1 32.7s 883 样本`（音频轨 mp4a 1407 样本） |
| `video_sheet` 12 格 | 23.9s，成图 `1440x864`，2.1 MB |
| `video_sheet` 20 格 | 41s，成图 `1440x1152`，2.9 MB |
| `video_frames` 4 帧 | 8.8s |
| `video_fetch_bilibili` | 1.8s，下回 1571 KB |

耗时几乎全花在 seek 上：**格数越多越慢**（约 1.5-2s/格）。20 格 ≈ 40s 是常态。

## 四、⚠️ 六个实测过的坑（别"简化"掉）

1. **`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 会让 electron 变成纯 Node**：它是 DSH 宿主注入给子进程的，
   一旦存在，`electron.exe` 不建窗口、不跑应用代码、静默退出（exit=1，约 100ms）。
   本插件**显式构造子进程环境**（只保留 Electron 需要的键），这个变量根本不在里面。
   注意：Windows PowerShell 5.1 里 `Remove-Item Env:` 实测**清不掉**它。
2. **`"type": "module"` 会连累 Electron helper**：本包 host 侧是 ESM，所以 package.json 有
   `"type": "module"` —— 这个 type 会一并套到 helper 上。helper 必须叫 **`main.cjs`**，
   否则 `require('electron')` 抛 `ReferenceError: require is not defined in ES module scope`，
   表现为"启动即退、没有任何输出"。
3. **带值开关会吃掉入口脚本**：`electron --disable-gpu main.cjs ...` 里，
   electron 把入口脚本当成了 `--disable-gpu` 的值（`--disable-gpu=main.cjs`），
   argv 整体位移。所以参数按**"第一个 `.cjs`/`.js` 之后的"**来取，不按位置取。
4. **`app.exit()` 可能抢在文件落盘前**：回执一律写文件（`_result.json`），退出前留 300ms。
5. **不要捕获子进程 stdio**：往被关闭的管道写日志会 EPIPE，Electron 把它升级成
   用户桌面上的模态错误框。插件的 `stdio` 固定 `'ignore'`，进度写 `<outDir>/_sheet.log`。
6. **MP4 里 VisualSampleEntry 的宽高偏移**：从 box 起点算 +32/+34（8 头 + 6 保留 + 2 dataRefIdx
   + 16 预定义 + 4 宽高）。写成 +24/+26 会**稳定读出 0x0**，且不报错 —— 实测踩过。

排查顺序建议：先看 `<outDir>/_sheet.log`（每步都有时间戳），再看 `_result.json`，
最后才怀疑环境。**"没有日志"本身就是结论**：说明进程没进到应用代码。

## 五、依赖与边界

- **零 npm 依赖**（只用 node: 内置模块 + 本机 `electron.exe`）。
- Electron 位置：`DSH_ELECTRON` / `VIDEO_GRAB_ELECTRON` 环境变量优先，
  否则找 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\electron\electron.exe`。
- **只支持 Chromium 能解的编码**（H.264/H.265/VP9/AV1…）。本机是精简版 Electron，
  **专有编码可能缺失**；遇到解不了的情况会如实报"没有可解码的画面"，不会假装成功。
- **音频听不到**：只处理画面。台词要靠视频自带的字幕/画面文字，或另行转写。
- **只能看定格**：联系表是N 张静态图，运动过程、节奏、音效都拿不到。
- B 站下载**只处理公开视频**，付费/仅登录可见会如实失败；文件名里的非法字符会被替换。

## 六、安装 / 卸载

```powershell
$dsh = "C:\Users\Elysia\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add    D:\workspace\workplace2\dsh-video-grab-0.1.0.tgz
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-video-grab
```

装完要**重启 / 开新会话**才会出现这四个工具（host 侧的 JS 是加载时进内存的）；
helper 的改动则立即生效（每次调用现读磁盘）。

## 七、许可与出处

- MIT。解码借用本机已安装的 Electron，不随包分发任何运行时。
- B 站接口按公开页面所见的调用方式使用，仅取公开视频、匿名访问；请自行遵守平台条款。
